title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Job Description** 




**HR Head – Manufacturing Plant (Pithampur)** 




**Company** 




 Alankaram is one of India’s leading premium furniture brands, known for design\-led solid wood furniture that blends craftsmanship, innovation, and contemporary aesthetics. With integrated manufacturing operations in Pithampur and expanding retail/showroom presence across India, Alankaram is building a professionally managed, process\-driven, and people\-centric organization for long\-term scale.
 



**Position** 




 HR Head – Manufacturing Plant
 



**Location** 




 Pithampur, Madhya Pradesh
 



**Reporting To** 




 Founder \& CEO
 



**Department** 




 Human Resources
 



**Role Summary** 




 The HR Head will lead the complete Human Resources function for Alankaram’s manufacturing operations at Pithampur and support organizational scale\-up across factory, corporate, and showroom teams.
 



 This role requires a strong combination of:
 


* factory HR operations,
* labour law compliance,
* industrial relations,
* talent management,
* culture building,
* performance systems,
* and leadership capability.



 The ideal candidate must be capable of building a disciplined yet people\-first organization while supporting Alankaram’s transition into a professionally managed premium manufacturing company.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. HR Strategy \& Organization Building** 



* Build and strengthen HR systems, processes, and policies aligned with business growth.
* Drive organizational structure planning, manpower planning, and workforce productivity.
* Partner with leadership on long\-term people strategy and succession planning.
* Support the company’s scale\-up from current operations toward future multi\-location expansion.



**2\. Manufacturing HR Operations** 



* Lead end\-to\-end HR operations for the Pithampur manufacturing facility.
* Ensure smooth management of:
* attendance,
* payroll inputs,
* leave management,
* contract labour,
* onboarding,
* employee records,
* shift coordination,
* statutory registers.
* Supervise HR Generalist and plant HR/admin teams.



**3\. Labour Law \& Statutory Compliance** 



* Ensure full compliance with:
* Factories Act,
* Industrial Disputes Act,
* Shops \& Establishment,
* PF,
* ESIC,
* Gratuity,
* Bonus,
* CLRA,
* POSH,
* labour welfare requirements.
* Coordinate inspections, audits, documentation, and legal notices.
* Maintain HR documentation discipline and audit readiness.



**4\. Industrial Relations \& Workforce Management** 



* Handle worker grievances, disciplinary matters, and conflict resolution.
* Build strong shop\-floor relationships and maintain workforce stability.
* Prevent and proactively manage industrial relations risks.
* Drive employee engagement, welfare, communication, and retention initiatives.



**5\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition** 



* Lead hiring across:
* factory workforce,
* supervisors,
* designers,
* sales/showroom staff,
* managers,
* leadership positions.
* Build recruitment partnerships with institutes and industry networks.
* Improve hiring quality, onboarding experience, and retention outcomes.



**6\. Performance Management \& Culture** 



* Drive implementation of:
* KPIs,
* PMS,
* appraisal cycles,
* performance reviews,
* PIPs,
* manager capability building.
* Help establish a high\-performance yet fair and respectful work culture.
* Coach managers on people leadership and team management.



**7\. Training \& Capability Development** 



* Build structured training systems for:
* induction,
* machine safety,
* POSH,
* behavioural skills,
* leadership development,
* supervisory capability.
* Drive skill development initiatives for factory workforce.



**8\. Compensation \& HR Systems** 



* Support compensation benchmarking and incentive structures.
* Improve HR analytics and reporting systems.
* Help implement and strengthen HRMS and people data systems.



**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




**Experience** 



* 15–18 years of HR experience.
* Minimum 5\+ years leading HR for a manufacturing plant.
* Strong exposure to factory HR and industrial relations is mandatory.
* Experience in furniture, manufacturing, engineering, consumer products, retail, or allied industries preferred.



**Education** 



* MBA / PGDM in HR preferred.
* Additional labour law qualifications are an advantage.



**Required Skills** 




**Functional Skills** 



* Factory HR
* Labour law compliance
* Industrial relations
* Performance management
* Recruitment
* Payroll coordination
* HR operations
* Employee engagement
* Policy implementation
* Workforce planning



**Leadership Skills** 



* Strong ownership mindset
* Process\-oriented
* High integrity
* Calm under pressure
* Strong interpersonal capability
* Ability to balance discipline with empathy
* Excellent communication and managerial maturity



**What Success Looks Like** 




 The HR Head is expected to:
 


* build a stable and scalable workforce,
* reduce operational HR chaos,
* improve retention,
* strengthen managerial discipline,
* institutionalize people processes,
* and help Alankaram evolve into a professionally managed organization without losing its entrepreneurial culture.



**Compensation** 




 Competitive compensation aligned with experience and capability.
 



**Why Join Alankaram** 



* Opportunity to build HR systems from the ground up
* Direct exposure to founders and leadership
* High\-growth premium manufacturing environment
* Long\-term leadership opportunity
* Chance to shape culture, systems, and organization at scale



 To apply:
 


* hr@alankaram.in

 Work Mode: Virtual / Remote

 Internship Duration: 1–3 months

 About the Opportunity
 



  





 Skillzenloop is offering a Data Science Internship for freshers and aspiring data professionals who want to explore data preparation, statistical analysis, Python programming, visualization, and machine learning.
 



  





 This internship is designed for candidates who want to understand how raw datasets can be transformed into meaningful insights and predictive solutions. Interns will work on analytical and data\-focused assignments while developing their technical and problem\-solving abilities.

 • Collect and prepare datasets for analysis and modeling.

 • Perform exploratory data analysis to understand important patterns and relationships.
 



 • Use Python to manipulate and analyze datasets.
 



 • Apply basic statistical methods to assigned data problems.
 



 • Create charts and visualizations to communicate findings.
 



 • Work with structured datasets using Pandas and NumPy.
 



 • Assist in preparing data for machine learning models.
 



 • Implement basic machine learning algorithms under project requirements.
 



 • Evaluate model results using appropriate performance measures.
 



 • Research datasets, analytical methods, and technical approaches when required.
 



 • Document data\-processing steps, findings, and project observations.
 



 • Assist in testing different approaches and comparing results.
 



 • Present analytical findings in a simple and understandable manner.
 



  





 Who Can Apply
 



  





 • Freshers and recent graduates.
 



 • Final\-year students interested in Data Science or Analytics.
 



 • Candidates from Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Information Technology, BCA, B.Tech, B.Sc, MCA, or related fields.
 



 • Candidates who have completed data\-science courses, certifications, academic projects, or personal projects.
 



 • Applicants looking to develop careers in Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Analytics, or Artificial Intelligence.
 



  





 Required Skills
 



  





 • Basic knowledge of Python programming.
 



 • Familiarity with Pandas and NumPy.
 



 • Understanding of basic statistics and probability.
 



 • Knowledge of data cleaning and preprocessing concepts.
 



 • Basic understanding of data visualization.
 



 • Familiarity with SQL fundamentals.
 



 • Ability to analyze information and identify patterns.
 



 • Basic understanding of machine learning concepts.
 



 • Good mathematical and logical reasoning.
 



 • Strong interest in learning data technologies.
 



  





 Preferred Skills
 



  





 • Experience with Matplotlib or similar visualization libraries.
 



 • Familiarity with Scikit\-learn.
 



 • Knowledge of regression and classification concepts.
 



 • Understanding of exploratory data analysis.
 



 • Familiarity with Jupyter Notebook or Google Colab.
 



 • Basic knowledge of MySQL or PostgreSQL.
 



 • Exposure to Power BI or Tableau.
 



 • Familiarity with model evaluation techniques.
 



 • Experience working with Kaggle or other public datasets.
 



 • Academic or personal Data Science projects.
 



  





 What You Will Learn
 



  





 • Practical data preparation and preprocessing.
 



 • Exploratory data analysis using Python.
 



 • Statistical techniques used in data analysis.
 



 • Data visualization and presentation of findings.
 



 • Using Pandas and NumPy for data manipulation.
 



 • Fundamentals of machine learning workflows.
 



 • Training and evaluating basic predictive models.
 



 • Feature preparation and dataset selection.
 



 • Working with notebooks and data\-science tools.
 



 • Communicating technical findings effectively.
 



  





 Ideal Candidate Profile
 



  





 We are looking for candidates who are:
 



  





 • Curious about data and interested in discovering patterns.
 



 • Comfortable working with numbers and analytical problems.
 



 • Interested in Python, statistics, and machine learning.
 



 • Willing to experiment with different analytical approaches.
 



 • Patient when cleaning and preparing datasets.
 



 • Interested in learning new data\-science libraries and technologies.
 



 • Able to explain findings clearly.
 



 • Comfortable researching technical concepts independently.
 



 • Able to manage project assignments in a remote environment.
 



  





 Why Join Skillzenloop?
 



  





 • Full\-time remote internship opportunity.
 



 • Exposure to practical Data Science workflows.
 



 • Opportunity to work with Python, SQL, statistics, and machine learning concepts.
 



 • Experience working with real\-world\-style datasets and analytical assignments.
 



 • Opportunity to create data\-science projects for your portfolio.
 



 • Suitable for freshers beginning their career in data and technology.
 



 • Skills relevant to Data Scientist, Data Analyst, Machine Learning, AI, and Business Intelligence career paths.

 You'll report to the Engineering Manager, Quality Engineering, depending on your skill set — Mobile or Web.
 



  





 As part of the QA team, you will actively contribute to identifying bugs across the entire production cycle. Our goal is to reduce bugs in the production environment to zero. * Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
* Comfort debugging across the stack: application, API, and data



  





*Nice to Have* 



* Exposure to API testing and accessibility testing (WCAG, TalkBack/VoiceOver)
* Domain experience in the airline or emergency response system space
* Experience integrating AI/LLM\-based tools into engineering or QA workflows



  





**Education** 



* Over 85% in 12th Boards (CBSE)
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science Engineering, with a CGPA above 8\.0


- 


**Experience \& Qualifications** 



* **Education:** 
 B.E. / B.Tech or higher degree in CSE, CE, BCA, or MCA, with a strong academic track record from a renowned Tier\-1 institution
* **Overall Experience:** 
 2–3 years of demonstrated professional engineering experience in QA/Frontend Development
* **Team Collaboration:** 
 Proven experience successfully working with and resolving issues alongside cross\-functional teams — mainly AI, UI/UX, new feature development, and ticket resolution — under a tight deadline, given our strict five\-week Agile build process



  





**Growth** 




 You will be working on a Gartner MQ product with a top\-tier engineering team, developing a no\-code platform for process digitization that incorporates GIS and a full communication suite. Please visit our website for more information.
 



  





**Compensation \& Benefits** 




**Salary:** 
 We are looking for top\-tier talent, and compensation will not be an issue for the right candidate.

 i. We shortlist candidates based on their resumes and a short form sent based on LinkedIn AI results. This form will not contain any exercises, but you will need to upload a short video of yourself explaining why you believe you are qualified for this job and how it will contribute to your career goals.
 



 ii. Based on the forms and your video, we will call selected candidates for a face\-to\-face technical interview. This will take a minimum of four hours and will be conducted at our Noida office in Sector 63\.

 Please apply only if you are technically very sound in the stack mentioned above.
 



 We advise you to apply

 Wishing you the best.

title: Information Technology Hardware Technician
description:
**Company Description** 
 At Nallam Digitals, we deliver tailored information technology services that address the specific needs of modern enterprises. Our core expertise includes cybersecurity, system optimization, and cloud integration, helping organizations operate efficiently and securely. We focus on building long\-term partnerships by providing reliable support and robust technical solutions. Applicants joining Nallam Digitals can expect to work with an experienced team that values professionalism, continuous improvement, and technical excellence.
 



  





**Job Summary** 





 We are looking for a skilled and responsible IT Hardware Technician to handle computer hardware, networking, operating system, and software\-related technical issues. The candidate should be capable of diagnosing and resolving both routine and critical hardware and software problems efficiently.
 




  





**Role Description** 
 The Information Technology Hardware Technician is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Hyderabad. This role is responsible for installing, configuring, and maintaining desktops, laptops, servers, and peripheral devices such as printers, routers, and switches. The technician will diagnose and resolve hardware issues, replace faulty components, and perform routine preventive maintenance to reduce downtime. Daily tasks include responding to support requests, documenting hardware configurations and repairs, coordinating with vendors for hardware procurement and warranty services, and ensuring that all equipment complies with company security and performance standards. The role may also involve assisting with hardware upgrades for system optimization and supporting project rollouts across the organization.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong knowledge of computer hardware components, peripherals, and basic networking devices (desktops, laptops, printers, routers, switches).
* Experience with hardware installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance in an enterprise or small business environment.
* Familiarity with operating systems (Windows, Linux), basic system setup, and hardware\-related OS configuration tasks.
* Ability to diagnose issues using hardware diagnostic tools and interpret logs or error codes to identify root causes.
* Understanding of safe handling practices for electronic components and adherence to IT security and data protection guidelines.
* Effective communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues in clear, accessible language to non\-technical users.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple on\-site support requests.
* Relevant technical certification (such as CompTIA A\+, hardware\-focused diploma, or equivalent) is preferred.
* Previous experience in an IT support or hardware technician role, particularly within a corporate or service\-provider environment, is an advantage.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 





 \* Diagnose and repair desktop computers, laptops, printers, and other IT hardware.
 





 \* Troubleshoot critical hardware issues, including motherboard, RAM, hard disk/SSD, power supply, display, and peripheral problems.
 





 \* Install, configure, and maintain Windows operating systems and required software.
 





 \* Troubleshoot software errors, application issues, driver problems, and system performance issues.
 





 \* Perform hardware upgrades, replacements, and preventive maintenance.
 





 \* Troubleshoot basic LAN, Wi\-Fi, internet, and networking\-related issues.
 





 \* Install and configure printers, scanners, and other peripherals.
 





 \* Perform data backup, system formatting, OS installation, and software configuration when required.
 





 \* Identify the root cause of recurring technical problems and implement suitable solutions.
 





 \* Maintain records of hardware, software, repairs, replacements, and service activities.
 





 \* Provide technical support to employees/users and resolve issues within the required time.
 





 \* Escalate issues to senior technical teams or vendors when necessary.
 




  





**Required Skills** 





 \* Strong knowledge of computer hardware and troubleshooting.
 





 \* Good knowledge of Windows operating systems and software troubleshooting.
 





 \* Ability to diagnose and resolve critical hardware failures.
 





 \* Knowledge of hardware installation, replacement, and maintenance.
 





 \* Good problem\-solving and analytical skills.
 





 \* Ability to work independently and handle multiple technical issues.
 





 \* Good communication and customer/user\-support skills.
 




  





**Educational Qualification** 





 \* Diploma / ITI /
 
 B.Tech
 
 / B.E. /
 
 B.Sc
 
 . / BCA / relevant technical qualification in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or a related field.
 




  





**Preferred Experience** 





 \* 1–3 years of experience in IT hardware support or technical support is preferred.
 





 \* Freshers with strong practical hardware troubleshooting knowledge may also be considered.
 




  





**Additional Requirements** 





 \* Willingness to handle urgent and critical technical issues.
 





 \* Willingness to travel to client/branch locations if required.
 





 \* Valid driving licence would be an advantage, if field support is part of the role.
 




  





**Key Performance Expectations** 




*The selected candidate will be expected to:*

We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education \& Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.
   

  

 ,
   

  

 The Associate, Retail Store Systems Support provides dedicated technical support for Ralph Lauren Retail Stores, covering POS computer systems, hardware, and software via telephone, email, and chat tools. Strong expertise in Windows systems and the ability to confidently troubleshoot over the phone are essential to success in this role.

* Participate in product and process updates, and create documentation for the same.
* Proactively drive issues to closure and collaborate with peers to resolve them.
* Communicate problems clearly to your team and colleagues, and understand how issues affect other areas of the organization beyond IT.
* Acknowledge and action proactive monitoring alerts as a first responder, escalating where required.
* Take independent action – do things before being asked or forced by events – and contribute creative solutions and innovative ideas.


**Operational**

* Increase Retail Store satisfaction by improving the First Contact Resolution (FCR) rate.
* Review open ticket queues and close tickets upon resolution daily.
* Triage and prioritize issues appropriately, and escalate problems to management when needed.
* Stay current with system information, changes, and updates.


 Applications \& Technology Expertise
   

  

**Must Have**
* High expertise in Windows 10 troubleshooting, with a strong overall understanding of both Windows and iOS platforms.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot over the phone and through remote support channels.
* Azure Active Directory – hands\-on experience.
* Networking – basic knowledge (connectivity, Wi\-Fi, and store network fundamentals).

* Microsoft 365, Outlook, and SharePoint – working knowledge, with strong Excel skills.


**Good To Have**

* Adyen and payment device troubleshooting – basic knowledge.
* Intune MDM – basic knowledge.
* IBM iSeries – foundation skills.
* TrueVue / RFID – basic knowledge.
* Exposure to connected retail applications such as Mad Mobile, Concierge, RetailNext, or Yoobic.
* SQL / Oracle – basic query and troubleshooting knowledge.


 ,
   

  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to support store users across global regions over the phone.
* Strong customer service orientation and sound decision making in a fast\-paced, multi\-task environment.
* Logical problem\-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
* Collaborative team player who builds strong working relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.
* Proactive mindset with a “can do” attitude.
* Strong time management and prioritization skills.


 Mandatory Requirements
   

  

* Minimum 1 year of experience in ITES operations.
* Adaptability to work in rotational shifts as part of a 24x7 support model, which can include nights and weekends.

title: OT Network Engineer – L1
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a motivated OT Network Engineer (L1\) to support our industrial network infrastructure. The candidate will assist in implementing and maintaining firewalls, SCADA systems and ensuring basic operational continuity in OT environments. This role requires frequent travelling to the plants for network activities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Assist in the installation, configuration, monitoring and maintenance of SCADA servers, desktops, and network devices (including routers, switches, and firewalls) across multiple site locations, ensuring compliance with project specifications and adherence to industry standards.
* Perform basic troubleshooting for SCADA systems and OT network connectivity issues.
* Ensure network security best practices in collaboration with IT \& OT Security team.
* Monitor firewall logs and raise alerts for anomalies.
* Track network changes, ensure change management process is followed. Regularly maintain and update documentation related to network architecture.
* Track/maintain documentation related to license expiry and renewals, asset details.
* Ensure the network infrastructure is aligned with the existing IT and cybersecurity policies and procedures.
* Coordinate with vendors and OEMs for L1\-level support and issue escalation.
* Follow SOPs for all the updates/upgrades in OT environments.
* Undertake mandatory travel to site locations for new projects and for ongoing projects, ensuring timely and efficient deployment and support.


**Key Skills \& Qualifications**
* Basic understanding of SCADA network architecture / IT network architecture and OT protocols (Modbus, OPC, etc.).
* Familiarity with firewall technologies (FortiGate, Sophos, Palo Alto, or equivalent).
* Good understanding of IP networking (VLANs, subnetting, routing basics).
* Exposure to industrial automation systems is a plus.
* Willingness to work in plant/industrial environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Computer Science, or related field.

title: Customer Success & Onboarding Specialist – AI SaaS
description:
**Role:** 
 Customer Success and Onboarding Specialist
 



**Company:** 
 StepsAI
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
 



**Work Mode:** 
 In\-office
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 1–3 years preferred
 



  





**About StepsAI** 




  





 StepsAI builds AI agents that help businesses sell, support, capture leads, book appointments, recommend products, answer questions and automate customer conversations.
 



  





 Our agents work across channels including websites, Shopify, WhatsApp, Instagram and other customer touchpoints.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who can help every new StepsAI customer get set up properly, see value quickly and continue getting better results over time.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 This is a customer\-facing role combining
 **Customer Success, Onboarding, and Implementation** 




  





**Technical Support** 
 .
 


1. You will own the early customer journey.
2. When a customer signs up, you will understand their business, identify what they want the AI agent to accomplish, configure the agent, connect the required channels, test it thoroughly and help them go live.



  





 But your job doesn't end at onboarding.
 



  





 You will continue to monitor how the agent is performing, talk to the customer, identify areas for improvement, tune the setup and make sure they are getting real value from StepsAI.
 



  





**Customer happiness is the highest priority.** 




  





 We want customers to feel that there is someone at StepsAI who understands their business and genuinely wants them to succeed.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**Customer Onboarding** 




  





 Own the onboarding process from signup to successful go\-live.
 



  





 You will:
 


* Conduct approximately
 **5–6 customer onboarding sessions per day** 
 .
* Understand each customer's business, customers, goals and use cases.
* Identify what they want their AI agent to accomplish.
* Help customers set up their StepsAI account.
* Build and configure AI agents based on their business requirements.
* Train the agent using their website, product information, FAQs, documents and other business knowledge.
* Configure instructions, workflows and agent behaviour.
* Test the agent before launch.
* Help customers understand how to use the StepsAI platform.
* Make sure every customer has a clear path to going live.



  





 The objective is not simply to complete an onboarding call.
 



  





 The objective is to get the customer to their
 **first successful outcome as quickly as possible.** 




  





**Build \& Configure AI Agents** 




  





 You will work hands\-on with StepsAI to create effective agents for customers.
 



  





 This may include:
 


* Understanding the customer's business and customer journey.
* Identifying the most important questions customers ask.
* Structuring the right knowledge for the agent.
* Configuring agent instructions and behaviour.
* Setting up lead\-capture flows.
* Setting up product recommendation flows.
* Setting up customer\-support workflows.
* Configuring appointment or meeting booking.
* Setting up order\-tracking experiences.
* Configuring automation and workflows.
* Testing different customer questions and scenarios.
* Identifying gaps in the agent's responses.
* Continuously tuning the agent for better performance.



 You should enjoy experimenting until the agent works well.
 



  





**Integrations \& Channel Setup** 




  





 Help customers connect StepsAI to the channels and tools they already use.
 



 Depending on the customer, this could include:
 



  





**Websites** 



* WordPress
* Custom websites
* Other website platforms



  





**E\-commerce** 



* Shopify
* WooCommerce



  





**Messaging \& Social** 



* WhatsApp
* Instagram
* Facebook / Messenger



  





 You do not need to be a software engineer.
 



  





 But you should be
 **technically curious and comfortable learning how integrations work.** 




  





**Troubleshooting \& Customer Support** 




  





 You will be one of the first people customers contact when something isn't working.
 



  





 You will:
 


* Understand the problem clearly.
* Reproduce issues whenever possible.
* Identify whether the issue comes from configuration, data, integration or the product.
* Solve problems that can be handled directly.
* Guide customers through fixes.
* Escalate product or engineering issues with clear documentation.
* Coordinate with the technical team until the issue is resolved.
* Keep the customer updated throughout the process.
* Follow up after resolution to ensure everything is working properly.



  





 We care about
 **ownership** 
 , not simply forwarding tickets.
 



  





 If a customer has a problem, you should feel responsible for making sure it reaches a resolution.
 



  





**Customer Success** 




  





 Onboarding is only the beginning.
 



  





 After customers go live, you will proactively check how things are going.
 



  





**You will:** 



* Touch base with customers regularly.
* Understand whether StepsAI is achieving what they expected.
* Review conversations and agent performance.
* Identify unanswered or poorly answered questions.
* Identify opportunities to improve the agent.
* Recommend new features or workflows that could help them.
* Help customers adopt more of the platform.
* Identify customers who are not using the product effectively.
* Proactively reach out before customers become unhappy.
* Celebrate customer wins and understand what created them.



  





 Your goal is to move customers from:
 



  





**"We bought StepsAI."** 




 to:
 



**"StepsAI is actually helping our business."** 




  





**Monitor \& Improve Agent Performance** 




  





 AI agents need continuous improvement.
 



  





 You will regularly review how customer agents are performing and ask:
 


* Are questions being answered correctly?
* Where is the agent getting confused?
* What questions are customers asking repeatedly?
* Are leads being captured properly?
* Are products being recommended appropriately?
* Are integrations working correctly?
* Are workflows triggering as expected?
* Where are conversations dropping off?
* What additional knowledge should be added?
* What can we change to create a better customer experience?



  





 You will make changes and recommendations based on what you observe.
 



  





**Be the Voice of the Customer** 




  





 You will work closely with the Product and Engineering teams.
 



  





 You will:
 


* Collect recurring customer feedback.
* Identify common onboarding problems.
* Identify recurring bugs.
* Document feature requests.
* Surface friction in the product.
* Explain customer use cases to the product team.
* Identify opportunities to simplify onboarding.
* Suggest features or improvements based on real customer behaviour.



  





 Because you will speak with customers every day, you will have some of the best insights in the company about what customers actually need.
 



  





 We expect you to share them.
 



  





**Improve Our Systems** 




  





 We don't just want you to follow the onboarding process.
 



  





 We want you to help us
 **improve it** 
 .
 



  





 If 20 customers ask the same question, we shouldn't answer it manually 20 times forever.
 



  





 You will help us create:
 


* Better onboarding checklists.
* Standard implementation templates.
* Industry\-specific agent templates.
* Setup guides.
* FAQs.
* Troubleshooting guides.
* Video tutorials.
* Customer training material.
* Internal documentation.
* Standard operating procedures.
* Better follow\-up processes.
* Customer health tracking.
* Automated onboarding wherever appropriate.



  





 The goal is to make every future customer easier to onboard and more successful than the previous one.
 



  





**What a Typical Customer Journey Might Look Like** 




  





 A Shopify brand signs up for StepsAI.
 



  





 You:
 



**1\. Understand the business** 




 What do they sell?
 



 Who are their customers?
 



 What do they want StepsAI to accomplish?
 



**2\. Build the agent** 




 Train it on their products, policies, FAQs and website.
 



 Configure how it should respond.
 



 Set up product recommendations, support and lead\-capture use cases.
 



**3\. Connect the channels** 




 Install StepsAI on Shopify.
 



 Connect WhatsApp or Instagram if required.
 



 Test everything.
 



**4\. Go live** 




 Make sure the customer understands the platform and feels confident using it.
 



**5\. Monitor** 




 Review real conversations and performance.
 



**6\. Improve** 




 Tune responses, fix gaps and recommend improvements.
 



**7\. Follow up** 




 Talk to the customer and understand whether they are seeing value.
 



 That's the role.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys helping customers.
 



  





 You should be:
 



  





**Customer\-obsessed** 




 You care whether the customer actually succeeds.
 



 You don't think:
 



*"I finished my call."* 




 You think:
 



*"Did this customer get what they needed?"* 




  





**A strong communicator** 




 You should be comfortable speaking with business owners, marketers, e\-commerce teams and non\-technical customers.
 



 You should be able to explain technical concepts in simple language.
 



  





**A problem solver** 




 When something doesn't work, your first reaction should be:
 



**"Let me figure out why."** 




  





**Technically curious** 




 You don't need to code, but you should be comfortable understanding software, integrations, AI agents, websites and business tools.
 



  





**Organized** 




 You may work with multiple new and existing customers every day.
 



 You should be able to manage onboarding sessions, follow\-ups, open issues and customer commitments without losing track.
 



  





**Proactive** 




 You should not wait for customers to complain.
 



 If you see that something isn't working well, reach out and fix it.
 



  





**Comfortable with a fast\-moving startup** 




 Processes will improve.
 



 Products will change.
 



 New integrations will launch.
 



 New customer use cases will appear.
 



 You should be comfortable learning continuously.
 



  





**Preferred Background** 




  





 We would ideally like someone with
 **1–3 years of experience** 
 in one or more of the following:
 


* Customer Success
* SaaS Customer Onboarding
* Implementation
* Technical Support
* Product Support
* Client Success
* Customer Experience



 Experience with B2B SaaS, e\-commerce, Shopify, WhatsApp, chatbots is a strong advantage.
 



 Fresh graduates with exceptional communication, problem\-solving ability, and technical curiosity may also be considered.
 



  





**Skills That Will Help** 



* Strong customer communication.
* Troubleshooting and problem\-solving.
* Basic understanding of SaaS products.
* Ability to learn technical products quickly.
* Understanding of e\-commerce workflows.
* Familiarity with Shopify or WordPress.
* Familiarity with WhatsApp Business or Meta products.
* Strong documentation skills.
* Comfort working with AI tools.



  





**How Success Will Be Measured** 




  





 We care about both
 **speed and customer outcomes** 
 .
 



  





 Key metrics may include:
 


* Customers onboarded per day.
* Time from signup to go\-live.
* Successful onboarding / activation rate.
* Customer satisfaction after onboarding.
* First response and issue\-resolution time.
* Product and feature adoption.
* Customer engagement after onboarding.



 Agent performance and quality.
 



  





 If you think this role sounds like you,
 **we’d love to hear from you. Apply and tell us why you’d be a great fit for StepsAI.**

title: Robotics Developer Internship
description:
**Company Description** 
 Humanoid Robotics Limited (HRL) is an Indian robotics and intelligent automation company specializing in AI\-powered humanoid robots, autonomous service robots, and industry\-focused robotic solutions. HRL integrates Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Autonomous Navigation, IoT, Embedded Systems, Mechanical Engineering, and Robotics to build intelligent machines that assist humans and automate repetitive or hazardous tasks. The company’s mission is to develop affordable, dependable robotics that improve productivity, workplace safety, resource efficiency, and operational performance. Led by a multidisciplinary leadership team, HRL collaborates with government bodies, industries, universities, research institutions, investors, and technology partners to develop and commercialize next\-generation robotics. HRL is committed to positioning India as a global hub for advanced robotics and building solutions “from India for the world.”
   

**Role Description** 
 The Robotics Developer Intern will support the design, development, and testing of robotic systems and automation solutions in a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include assisting in coding and integrating software modules, working on sensor integration and control algorithms, and contributing to the development of prototypes and proof\-of\-concept robotics applications. The intern will collaborate with engineers to debug and optimize robotic behaviors, document technical work, and participate in team discussions on system architecture and product improvements. The role also involves researching emerging robotics and AI technologies, preparing reports, and helping with demonstrations and trials for internal teams and external stakeholders.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong foundation in Robotics and Process Automation, with the ability to apply these concepts to real\-world systems and projects.
* Solid Analytical Skills for problem\-solving, debugging, and optimizing robotic performance and system reliability.
* Proficiency or hands\-on experience in Software Development, preferably with languages and frameworks commonly used in robotics (e.g., Python, C/C\+\+, ROS).
* Effective Communication skills to collaborate within multidisciplinary teams, document technical work clearly, and present findings.
* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Robotics, Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* Familiarity with AI, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or Embedded Systems is an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site in Mumbai, learn quickly in a fast\-paced environment, and contribute to hands\-on lab and field testing.
* Interest in advanced robotics, human–robot collaboration, and building innovative solutions for industrial and societal applications.

 At Orica, it’s the power of our people that leads change and shapes our futures. Every day, all around the world, our people help mobilise vital resources essential to progress. Established in 1874, we have grown to become the world leader in mining and civil blasting with a diverse of team of more than 13,000 across the world.
 



  





 It’s an exciting time to join us – we are shaping the future of mining through digital and automated technologies, embracing new ways of thinking, pioneering innovation and reimagining the way we work.
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 At Orica, we work closely with some of the world's leading mining operations to deliver safe, reliable, and innovative blasting solutions.
 



  





 As an Account Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting customer outcomes through commercial coordination, business analysis, forecasting, reporting, and cross\-functional collaboration. Working alongside operational, technical, commercial, supply chain, and finance teams, you will help ensure the efficient delivery of products and services while contributing to customer satisfaction and business performance.
 



  





 This role offers a unique opportunity to combine engineering knowledge with commercial and business exposure. You will gain insight into how mining operations, customer relationships, forecasting, business planning, and commercial performance come together to support successful customer outcomes. In addition, you will provide technical and commercial support to the Account Business Manager (ABM), gaining valuable exposure to customer engagement, account management, business planning, and operational coordination. Working with experienced professionals and leading mining customers, you will develop a broad understanding of the mining value chain while building capabilities that can open future career pathways across commercial, operational, technical, and business leadership roles.
 



  





**What you will be doing** 




  




* Coordinate customer\-facing commercial and operational activities to support the safe, efficient, and reliable delivery of products and services.
* Analyse customer consumption, operational, and commercial data to identify trends, insights, and opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate forecasting and planning activities to support customer requirements and business objectives.
* Prepare and maintain KPI reports, commercial analysis, customer performance reporting, and business dashboards.
* Maintain customer, contract, pricing, and master data within business systems, ensuring accuracy and data integrity.
* Monitor contract performance, customer commitments, and key commercial metrics.
* Provide technical and commercial coordination support to the Account Business Manager, including the preparation of reports, presentations, customer information, and business performance insights.
* Support customer onboarding activities and contribute to process improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate CSR activities and assist with stakeholder engagement initiatives within the region.
* Track customer feedback, service\-related issues, and improvement opportunities to help drive positive customer outcomes.
* Collaborate with Commercial, Technical Services, Operations, Supply Chain, and Finance teams to support customer and business needs.
* Contribute to budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives across the region.



  





**What you will bring** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Commerce, or a related discipline.
* Mining Engineering, Mineral Engineering, or other engineering qualifications will be highly regarded.
* Engineering graduates and early\-career professionals are strongly encouraged to apply.
* Experience in mining, mining services, technical services, commercial support, account management, planning, business analysis, or customer\-facing roles is advantageous.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret operational and commercial data.
* Understanding of mining operations, drill and blast activities, production environments, or resource industries will be highly regarded.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and confidence working with data, reporting, and performance metrics.
* Experience with SAP, ERP systems, Power BI, or similar business systems is advantageous.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* A proactive mindset and willingness to build a career at the intersection of operations, customer engagement, and commercial performance.



  





**What we offer** 




  





 As part of a truly global company, you will have the ability to grow and learn in a diverse, collaborative culture. We foster relationships and learning through connected global and local teams, promote flexible and diverse career paths and support the development of your knowledge and skills.
 



  





 You will be paid a competitive salary, learn from talented individuals across multiple disciplines and be able to thrive in a safe workplace within a collaborative culture. Ignite your career at a place where your distinct potential can find its home.
 



  





**We respect and value all** 




  





 Orica promotes and fosters a culture of inclusion and Equal Opportunity Employment everywhere we operate. We treat our people and applicants with fairness, dignity, and respect, getting the best of everyone’s contributions. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, nationality, age, military or veteran, marital or disability status.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Company Description** 
 MindLytics is a next\-generation data and analytics company that helps organizations turn raw data into actionable intelligence. The team specializes in building scalable data infrastructure, advanced analytics solutions, and modern visualization platforms to support faster, smarter decision\-making. MindLytics partners with both startups and growing enterprises to enable data\-driven cultures through reliable data pipelines, cloud\-based architectures, and business intelligence solutions. The company’s mission is to convert raw data into real business value by delivering practical, impact\-focused data solutions to its clients.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time remote Data Scientist role focuses on designing and implementing data\-driven solutions that address complex business problems. The Data Scientist will work closely with cross\-functional stakeholders to collect, analyze, and model data, and to translate findings into clear, actionable insights. Daily responsibilities include building and validating statistical and machine learning models, performing exploratory data analysis, and developing dashboards or visualizations that communicate key metrics and trends. The role also involves maintaining clean, reliable datasets, contributing to scalable data pipelines, and documenting methodologies to support reproducibility and ongoing improvement.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Data Science and Statistics for modeling, experimentation, and inference.
* Candidates should possess skills in Data Analytics and Data Analysis for interpreting complex datasets and generating insights.
* Candidates should possess skills in Data Visualization for building clear dashboards and visual reports.
* Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in data science (such as Python or R) and experience with SQL or other query languages.
* Familiarity with machine learning libraries, cloud\-based data platforms, and version control tools.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts to non\-technical audiences and collaborate effectively in a remote environment.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering) or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience working with business intelligence tools and building end\-to\-end analytics solutions is beneficial.

description:
**Location:** 
 Sector\-132, Noida, (involves travelling with the team to various test sites across India)
   

  

**Salary (CTC):** 
 ₹6\-8 LPA
   

  

**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time, On\-site
   

  

**About Zoid\-**
 ZOID is a deep\-tech R\&D startup developing advanced defence and aerospace technologies for the Indian Military and UAV manufacturers. Our work spans AI, electronics, robotics, autonomous systems and UAV platforms.
   

  

 Our current projects include AI\-based FOD detection for naval air stations, GNSS\-denied navigation, aerial intelligent mapping, reusable off\-board missile decoys, vision\-based kinetic strike systems and drone swarming solutions.
   

  

**Role Overview\-**
 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Systems Engineer** 
 to support the end\-to\-end design, integration, testing, flight operations and deployment of UAV systems.
   

  

 The role requires strong practical knowledge of drone hardware, avionics, flight controllers, power systems, communication links, payload integration and field testing. The candidate must be comfortable manually flying small to medium\-category UAVs and travelling to test locations across India.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities\-**
**UAV Systems \& Integration**
* Lead, design and assemble end\-to\-end integration of UAV subsystems: propulsion, avionics, control, payload and power.
* Hands\-on with various frame designs — Quad/Hex/Octa copters, fixed\-wing, VTOL, etc.
* Select suitable drives, electronic components, sensors and hardware.
* Knowledge of motors, ESCs, propellers — their specs and configuration.
* Configure, integrate, calibrate and auto\-tune flight controllers (Pixhawk, Cube Orange\+, PX4, etc.).
* Analyse flight logs using Mission Planner, QGroundControl or MAVLink tools for pre\- and post\-flight debugging.
* Knowledge of standard flight modes (stabilize, althold, poshold, loiter, land, rtl, guided, auto), fail\-safes (RC, GCS, battery, geofence, EKF) and mission planning.
* Familiar with standard Pixhawk Cube parameters and setting them via Mission Planner.


**Communication \& Networking**
* Ability to configure IP networks — IP addressing, subnet masks, gateways, routing — and get companion computers, flight controllers, payload processors, routers and ground stations talking on the same network.
* Knowledge of serial communication protocols: UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, RS\-232, including baud rates and debugging.
* Understanding of telemetry radios, RC links, video links, mesh networks, Ethernet, LTE/5G modems, VPN/routing and IP\-based payload communication.
* Understanding of MAVLink routing, UDP/TCP endpoints, packet loss, latency and link redundancy.


**Basic RF knowledge** 
 — understanding of what a signal is and the fundamentals behind it.
   

  

**Power System Design**
* Understanding of Li\-ion/LiPo packs, C\-rating, discharge curves, BMS, cell balancing and safe charging/discharging.
* Ability to calculate power Budget, current draw, endurance, payload power and voltage rail requirements.
* Knowledge of PDBs, DC\-DC converters, BECs, fuses, connectors, wire gauge selection and grounding.
* Troubleshoot brownouts, voltage drops, ESC desync, power noise and overheating.


**Sensor \& Payload Integration**
 Integrate EO/IR cameras, gimbals, LiDAR, rangefinders, GNSS/RTK modules, IMUs, magnetometers, payload controllers and RF payloads.
   

  

* Read sensor datasheets and understand interfaces, power needs, mounting constraints and calibration.
* Test payload data flow from sensor → onboard computer → ground station.
* Ability to read datasheets, schematics, pinouts and reference manuals to bring up and test embedded boards.


**Software \& Development**
* Python skills are mandatory for development, log analysis / visualization, automation and tooling.
* Working knowledge of Ubuntu / Linux is required, including basic commands (SSH, SCP, mkdir, cd, rm, etc.) and day\-to\-day use of a Linux environment.
* Basic firmware development, flashing, debugging and peripheral interfacing on microcontrollers such as STM32, ESP32, Arduino or similar.


**Qualifications**
**Education:** 
 Diploma or degree in Electronics, Mechanical, Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or a related field. Equivalent experience also considered.
   

  

**Experience**
* Minimum 3 years in a Avionics Systems Engineer preferably in a startup, R\&D or defence\-tech setup.
* Prior experience in defence/aerospace product testing and deployment.
* Experience building and operating drones from scratch and running day\-to\-day autonomous/semi\-autonomous flights.


**Hands\-on Skills**
* Integrating flight controllers with ESCs, GPS, power modules, telemetry, RF systems and onboard computers.
* Familiarity with aviation regulations and military standards for UAV development is a plus.


**Core Skills\-**
* Proficiency in MS Office, Canva, AI Tool like Claude.
* Strong problem\-solving — able to think critically and creatively about complex engineering challenges.
* Good communication skills for working with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in English is mandatory.


**Additional Requirements**
* Willingness to travel to test sites across India.
* Comfortable working outdoors for extended durations.


**Preferred Skills**
 Beyond the requirements above, any of the following is a big plus:
   

  

* Advanced software experience with C\+\+, ROS and Gazebo.
* Familiarity with embedded processors beyond standard computers — microcontrollers, SBCs, SoCs and FPGA\-based development boards.
* Basic familiarity with FPGA / SoC\-FPGA workflows: HDL, synthesis, bitstream generation, programming and hardware validation using tools like Vivado/Vitis or similar.
* Awareness of different RF architectures, with the judgement to do design and analysis of the subsystems in an RF chain.

title: User Experience Analyst
description:
**Role:** 
 UI/UX Analyst (D2C Product)
 



**Reports To:** 
 Lead D2C
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai (Work from Office)
 



  





**Nature of Business \& What You'll Own** 




 As UI/UX Analyst, you'll
 **diagnose friction, design better user experiences, and validate improvements through data.** 




 You're not a pure designer. You're not a pure analyst. You're the
 **bridge** 
 – using session recordings, heatmaps, and funnel data to identify
 *why* 
 customers drop off, and designing solutions to test.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



1. Session recording analysis \- watch session recordings 2–3x/week to spot friction and user behavior patterns
2. UX friction diagnosis – combine session data, heatmaps, and GA4 to build a prioritized list of improvements
3. A/B test variant design – sketch solutions in Figma based on your findings; collaborate with the product and design teams on testing strategy
4. Design system maintenance — collaborate with the design strategy team to document components and ensure consistency across the website
5. Insight reporting – weekly conversion updates to the team; monthly deep dives on major findings
6. Tool evaluation – research and recommend new UX testing tools (UserTesting, Maze, etc.) as you identify gaps in our workflow



 You'll collaborate closely with the product and engineering teams to drive user\-centric improvements across the platform.
 



  





**Technical Capabilities Required:** 




**Design Tools \& Prototyping:** 



* **Figma proficiency** 
 (non\-negotiable) – component\-based design, design systems, interactive prototypes
* Ability to create A/B test variants quickly and hand off clean specs to engineering
* Understanding of mobile\-first design



**Analytics \& Data Tools( good to have):** 



* **GA4** 
 –funnel visualization, event tracking, custom reports (not deep SQL, but comfortable navigating the tool)
* **Session recording tools** 
 – session recording, heatmaps, and user behavior identification
* Ability to interpret data and translate findings into design improvements
* Basic statistical thinking (correlation vs. causation, sample size matters)



**Platform \& E\-Commerce Context:** 



* Familiarity of
 **e\-commerce platforms** 
 – enough to know what's possible and what's a technical constraint
* Familiarity with
 **conversion funnel** 
 – browse → add\-to\-cart → checkout → payment → confirmation



**Tools You Can Learn \& Suggest:** 



* You're encouraged to research and recommend new tools that fit your workflow –
 **UserTesting, Maze, Hotjar, Pendo** 
 , etc.
* You should stay current on UX testing and session recording tools



  





**Functional Capabilities Required:** 




**Conversion Psychology:** 



* Understand micro\-interactions that drive decision\-making (button color, copy, social proof, urgency)
* Know how to reduce friction (form fields, payment options, trust signals)
* Apply JTBD (Jobs to Be Done) thinking – what job is the customer hiring this product for?



**UX Research \& Data Literacy:** 



* Can read a session recording and identify 3–5 UX issues
* Can spot patterns in heatmap data (click clusters, scroll depth, attention areas)
* Comfortable asking "why" – always validate assumptions with data before designing



**A/B Testing \& Iteration:** 



* Design test variants based on hypothesis, not guesswork
* Understand statistical rigor (sample size, test duration, confidence levels)
* Iterate based on results – learn from losses, compound wins



**Communication \& Collaboration:** 



* Sketch ideas quickly in Figma and get feedback early
* Present findings to product and design teams in a structured way
* Comfortable with ambiguity — you'll be expected to own problems, not just execute specs



  





**Required Skills \& Experience:** 



* **2–3 years** 
 of UX/UI design or product analytics experience (agency, SaaS, e\-commerce, or D2C preferred)
* **Figma expertise** 
 \- can create designs, components, and interactive prototypes; not a designer by training, but by fluency
* **Conversion psychology** 
 – understand how small UX changes impact user behavior
* **Data literacy** 
 – comfortable with GA4 funnels, segment analysis, and session recording tools
* **Mobile\-first thinking** 
 – design for phones first, then desktop
* **India D2C context** 
 – nice\-to\-have but not mandatory. Understanding of Indian customer behavior, payment methods, and logistics is valuable
* **Written communication** 
 — can document findings clearly and present to non\-designers



  





**To apply , please complete the following 2 questions:** 




  





**Task 1 Description:** 




 Audit The Whole Truth Foods' website (thewholetruthfoods.com), specifically the
 **product browse → add\-to\-cart → checkout flow** 
 . Identify 4\-5 friction points or UX issues that could impact conversion rate. For 2 of these issues, design a proposed improvement in Figma or any free design tool (Penpot, Excalidraw, Figma free tier). Include a written analysis explaining:
 


* What friction you identified (and why it matters)
* How you'd measure the impact of your proposed change
* Hypothesis for what conversion lift you'd expect



  





**Task 2 Description:** 




 Your GA4 shows that 42% of users land on the homepage, but only 18% click into a category page. Of those who do, only 8% complete a purchase. Heatmap data shows the category navigation menu has low click\-through \- users instead using the search bar. Session recordings reveal users are confused about the difference between similar products (e.g., Whey Protein vs. Plant Protein, or different protein bar flavors). The exit rate on category pages is 35%."
 



**Candidate's Task:** 



1. **Diagnose the issue** 
 – Write 150–200 words on why category navigation is underperforming and how it impacts the funnel (consider: information overload, product differentiation, filtering options, trust signals)
2. **Propose 3 design/UX changes** 
 — Could include: improved category page layout, better filtering, comparison tools, simplified navigation, product badge/labeling, etc.
3. **Design 1 variant** 
 – Redesigned category page or navigation menu in Figma/free tool
4. **Testing \& insights plan** 
 – How would you test? What secondary metrics matter (e.g., time on category page, filter usage, comparison tool clicks)?

description:

 Dunbar \& Boardman (D\&B), founded in the UK in 1981, is an independent specialist consultancy focused on Vertical Transportation and Façade Access advisory services across the UK, Middle East, India, and international markets. With over four decades of experience, D\&B supports clients throughout the building lifecycle, from feasibility and concept design through construction, commissioning, and ongoing asset management. The consultancy provides expert guidance on lifts, escalators, moving walkways, façade maintenance, and specialist access systems, integrating safety, performance, and maintainability from early design stages. D\&B works across sectors including high\-rise, residential, commercial, hospitality, healthcare, airports, transport infrastructure, and mixed\-use developments. As a manufacturer\-neutral firm, D\&B’s recommendations are driven by safety, operational efficiency, lifecycle needs, and client interests, helping create safe, efficient, future\-ready buildings.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Graduate Engineering Trainee will support senior engineers and consultants in delivering vertical transportation and façade access projects, with a focus on technical analysis, design coordination, and documentation. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include assisting with data collection, technical calculations, report preparation, and reviewing drawings and specifications for lifts, escalators, and façade access systems. The role involves collaborating with project teams, attending internal and external meetings, and contributing to project planning, tracking, and quality assurance activities. The Trainee will also help with research on standards, codes, and emerging technologies relevant to vertical transportation and façade access, and support site visits and inspections under supervision. This is a full\-time hybrid role, based in Bengaluru, with a combination of office\-based work and some work\-from\-home flexibility.

* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, including clear written reporting and effective interpersonal communication in multidisciplinary teams.

* Ability to work in a hybrid environment based in Bengaluru, demonstrate attention to detail, and maintain a proactive, learning\-oriented approach is highly desirable.

title: Software Development Engineer (SDE) – Frontend Focused
description:
**Software Development Engineer (SDE) – Frontend Focused** 




*Steps AI  ·  On\-Site, Hyderabad, India  ·  Full\-Time, Paid* 




  





**Only apply if:** 

 You have at least 1–2 years of production frontend experience, you have shipped scalable React / TypeScript (Next.js preferred) interfaces, and you can point us to live, deployed products that show your UI craft \- not only a repository.
 




  






 This is a full\-time, on\-site role in Hyderabad, India. Occasional travel is required. This includes travel to on\-premises deployment locations and travel to client sites in Hyderabad for implementation, go\-live, reviews, or production support.
 




  





**Who We Are** 





 Steps AI is a product company building intelligent, AI\-powered software for modern businesses. We design and ship production systems that combine strong user experience, reliable backends, and data\-driven intelligence. We work with real customers, deploy to both cloud and on\-premises environments, and move from prototype to production with a high bar for security, access control, and operational quality.
 




  






 We are growing, shipping every week, and looking for engineers who can own a problem end to end \- interface, API, data, security, and deployment \- rather than a single layer of the stack.
 




  





**The Role** 





 We are hiring a Frontend\-focused SDE to own the quality of the product experience: structure, visual clarity, interaction, and performance. You will spend most of your time on the interface, but you will not throw work over the wall. You will integrate with real APIs, respect authentication and role\-based visibility, and help take a working demo to a polished, deployable product.
 




  






 You will work with full\-stack peers on the API and data model. You should be comfortable reading backend contracts, flagging when the UI needs a different API shape, and making design decisions when there is no finished Figma file.
 




  





**What You Will Do** 




**Core Frontend Development** 



* Build production\-grade applications using React, TypeScript, and modern CSS (Tailwind or equivalent). Next.js (App Router) is strongly preferred.
* Create reusable components and a consistent design language: type, spacing, density, and interaction states.
* Implement application shells, navigation, filters, tables, forms, and empty / error / loading states that hold up in daily use.
* Optimize performance: code\-splitting, list virtualization where needed, caching, and careful rendering.
* Ship responsive, accessible interfaces across common devices and browsers.



  





**Product UI \- Dashboards and Workflows** 



* Build complex operational UIs: dashboards, data\-heavy tables, charts, and interactive workflows.
* Implement map or location\-aware views when the product needs them, with clear legend, hover, and drill\-through behaviour.
* Build AI\-assisted surfaces when required (chat or assistant panels, streaming text, citations, structured actions) without sacrificing clarity.
* Ensure every view respects role\-based visibility: what a user can see and click must match their permissions.



  





**Design Responsibility** 



* Translate requirements and rough sketches into a coherent interface. Pixel\-perfect when a design exists; disciplined taste when it does not.
* Own visual consistency across the product. You are accountable for the look and feel, not only for “making it work”.
* Use industry\-standard UI tools (Figma or equivalent) to communicate proposals when that saves engineering time.
* Raise issues early when a workflow is confusing, overcrowded, or unsafe (for example, a destructive action without confirmation).



  





**APIs, Auth, and Working With the Rest of the Stack** 



* Integrate with REST APIs from Node or Python services. Handle pagination, errors, and stale data correctly.
* Work with session or JWT authentication and render the product differently by role without leaking privileged UI.
* Use TanStack Query (or equivalent) for server state and a small, explicit store for client state.
* Partner with backend engineers on contract changes. You should be able to read an OpenAPI spec or a FastAPI router and reason about it.
* Contribute to the last mile of deployment: environment\-specific configuration, build pipelines, and verifying the UI on staging and on\-premises installs.



  





**Engineering Quality** 



* Write maintainable TypeScript. Prefer explicit types and small components over large files.
* Participate in code review and keep the frontend testable (component tests and critical\-path E2E).
* Instrument the UI enough to debug production issues (meaningful errors, not silent empty screens).
* Travel occasionally to client or on\-premises locations in Hyderabad for UAT, go\-live support, or on\-site reviews.



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's in Design, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 1–2\+ years of production frontend experience (more is welcome).
* Strong React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript.
* Confidence with CSS layout and a utility or design\-token approach (Tailwind or equivalent).
* Experience integrating authenticated APIs and handling real\-world data, not only mock JSON.
* A portfolio that shows visual judgement: spacing, hierarchy, and polish you personally shipped.
* Willingness to work on\-site in Hyderabad and to travel to client or on\-premises sites as required.



  





**Location, Work Mode, and Travel** 





 This is a full\-time, on\-site role in Hyderabad, India. You will work in person with the engineering team.
 





 Occasional travel is required. This includes travel to on\-premises deployment locations and travel to client sites in Hyderabad for implementation, go\-live, reviews, or production support. Travel is typically short\-duration and planned; willingness to travel within Hyderabad (and occasionally nearby) is a condition of the role.
 




  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive salary with a clear growth path.
* High\-ownership work: you will influence architecture, security, and how the product is shipped.
* Exposure to AI\-assisted products, enterprise\-grade access control, and real production deployments.
* Fast execution cycles and a culture that values demonstrated capability over credentials alone.
* Learning budget for courses and certifications.
* Collaborative in\-office engineering culture in Hyderabad.

title: Human Resources Lead
description:
**Note** 
 : This is an in\-office role based out of Mumbai, 6 days a week. An ideal candidate should have 4\-8 years of experience. Please apply if you meet the above criteria.
 



 HR Lead.
 



  





 Luma is building the future of fertility care in India — patient\-first, tech\-enabled, and unapologetically different from the clinical, impersonal experience that defines the category today. Backed by Peak XV, founded by a second\-time entrepreneur who has built and scaled before, Luma is past the idea stage and into the work of building a real organization around a real mission: better, more human healthcare for women, at scale.
 



 This role builds the people function from the ground up, inside a company trying to change what fertility care looks like in this country.
 



  





**What this role actually is** 




 Someone who can go from zero to one. You’ve built policy from nothing, set up payroll, made hiring work under real pressure. This is a hands\-on operator role — you do the work, not just direct others to do it. You’ll manage a small, growing team of your own.
 



 You’ll also design how the organization runs as it grows: clear roles, KRAs that mean something, a real sense of what good performance looks like at each level, and outcomes tied to the business as Luma expands into new clinics. Managing HR across a lean central team and a distributed, multi\-clinic footprint is core to this role, not an edge case.
 



  





**What you’ll own** 




     •    HR infrastructure — policy, process, and systems built from scratch
 



     •    Payroll and compliance, run cleanly and on time
 



     •    Hiring — sourcing, screening, and closing roles fast, across head office and clinical functions
 



     •    Organization design — role clarity, KRAs, and performance frameworks that hold up as the company scales across multiple clinics
 



     •    Training and learning calendars, including clinical staff training
 



     •    Employee engagement across a central team and a clinic floor with a different operating rhythm
 



     •    Onboarding and the day\-to\-day discipline that keeps a growing, multi\-location team functioning
 



  





**What we’re looking for** 




 Real experience building HR inside an early\-stage, scaling startup, run lean and hands\-on. Healthcare, fertility care or clinic\-floor HR experience is a strong plus and will be prioritized.
 



  





**Why this role matters** 




 Fertility care in India has historically been clinical, transactional, and disempowering for the women going through it. Luma exists to change that — and the team you build, and the culture you set, will shape whether that mission is deliverable at scale. This is the chance to build the people foundation of a category\-defining, women\-led healthcare company early, not join one after the interesting decisions are already made.

title: SENIOR MANAGER – HUMAN RESOURCES  & PEOPLE OPERATIONS
description:
**Delhi NCR \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| 4–6 Years Experience**




 We are looking for a sharp, ambitious and highly dependable 
 **Senior Manager – Human Resources \& People Operations** 
  to establish and run the core HR operating systems of our Delhi NCR headquarters.
 



 This is a broad, hands\-on management mandate covering 
 **recruitment, payroll management, employee lifecycle, HR systems, international personnel administration, work\-authorisation coordination, performance processes, HR compliance, employee records and management reporting** 
 .
 



 The person joining us will not simply inherit an existing HR desk. They will help build a disciplined and scalable People Operations function capable of supporting a growing Indian and international workforce.
   





 The Senior Manager – Human Resources \& People Operations will be responsible for establishing and operating the 
 **Delhi HQ HR infrastructure** 
  and ensuring that employee administration is accurate, controlled, responsive and scalable.
 



 The role will include:
 


1. Establishing the core 
 **HR operating framework for the Delhi NCR headquarters** 
 , including HRIS, employee master data, personnel files, joining systems, attendance, leave, payroll controls, probation, performance\-cycle administration and separation processes.
2. Managing 
 **end\-to\-end payroll administration and payroll coordination** 
 , including monthly employee data, attendance and leave inputs, salary changes, approved deductions, reimbursements, variable\-pay inputs, new joiners, exits and payroll reconciliation.
3. Working with Finance, payroll vendors and management to ensure that payroll records reconcile with approved employment terms and employee master data.
4. Maintaining payroll calendars, change\-control records, salary/CTC documentation and payroll exception trackers.
5. Coordinating statutory and employee\-related payroll documentation with the appropriate Finance, Legal, payroll and professional advisers.
6. Managing end\-to\-end recruitment across multiple concurrent managerial, specialist, technical and administrative mandates.
7. Managing RPOs, recruitment agencies, LinkedIn, job portals, direct sourcing and referral channels.
8. Coordinating candidate assessment, interview scheduling, approvals, compensation discussions, offers and joining.
9. Managing BGV, references, pre\-employment documentation and controlled onboarding.
10. Creating and maintaining accurate employee records, organisation data, reporting relationships, designation/grade records and employment\-history documentation.
11. Managing attendance, leave, probation, confirmation, promotions, approved compensation changes, transfers and employee status changes.
12. Operationalising Board\- and management\-approved HR, workplace, travel, employee and administrative policies.
13. Maintaining policy acknowledgements, training evidence, compliance registers and HR audit documentation.
14. Supporting performance\-management administration, including 
 **30/60/90\-day reviews, probation reviews, confirmation documentation, performance records and management follow\-up** 
 .
15. Handling employee grievances, disciplinary documentation, difficult employee matters, resignations, handovers, separation processes and final\-clearance coordination.
16. Maintaining appropriate confidentiality and access controls for sensitive personnel and compensation data.
17. Coordinate 
 **international employee mobility** 
 , including visa/work\-authorisation, immigration, FRRO/FRO and renewal documentation through Legal/authorised advisers.
18. Maintain complete 
 **passport, visa, permit, registration and expiry controls** 
  for foreign personnel and international specialists.
19. Coordinate 
 **invitation letters, supporting documentation, relocation, accommodation and joining logistics** 
  for international employees.
20. Maintain an 
 **International Personnel \& Mobility Register** 
  covering status, expiries, pending actions and responsible owners.
21. Ensure required documentation and internal clearances are complete before international personnel commence regulated or approval\-dependent activities.
22. Support overseas deputation, travel and assignment documentation for Indian employees where required.
23. Establish and maintain the 
 **Delhi HQ HR operating system** 
 , including Employee Master, HRIS, recruitment pipeline, offers, BGV, joining, personnel files, attendance/leave and payroll controls.
24. Maintain 
 **compensation\-change, probation, confirmation, performance\-review, policy\-acknowledgement and training records** 
 .
25. Maintain 
 **grievance, disciplinary, separation, clearance, HR\-vendor and management\-MIS systems** 
 .
26. Own the 
 **HR\-side payroll process and reconciliation controls** 
  in coordination with Finance and authorised service providers.



  




 WHAT WE EXPECT IN THE FIRST 90 DAYS
 
 Within the first three months, the successful candidate should be able to demonstrate:
 


* a functioning Delhi HQ HR operating system;
* complete employee master and controlled personnel files;
* recruitment dashboard covering all approved vacancies;
* functioning HRIS or controlled interim HR database;
* reliable attendance and leave administration;
* documented monthly payroll process and reconciliation controls;
* BGV and onboarding tracker;
* probation and confirmation calendar;
* approved policy implementation and acknowledgement records;
* management HR dashboard;
* international personnel / visa / work\-authorisation tracker where applicable;
* HR vendor and recruiter controls;
* defined employee joining, lifecycle and separation workflows.


 THE PERSON WE WANT
 
 We are looking for somebody who can 
 **build systems and then operate them** 
 .
 



 A strong candidate will be equally comfortable interviewing a senior candidate in the morning, resolving a payroll discrepancy before lunch, checking the documentation of an international employee in the afternoon and preparing a concise management dashboard before the day ends.
 



 That breadth is intentional.
 



 The role suits an HR professional who wants genuine ownership and institutional\-building responsibility — not somebody looking for a narrowly defined recruitment, HRBP or employee\-engagement position.
 


 Particularly valuable experience
 
 Candidates who have previously helped establish a 
 **new corporate office, regional headquarters, business unit, plant, international office or rapidly expanding operation** 
  will be particularly relevant.
 



 Exposure to any combination of the following will be valuable:
 



***HRIS implementation • Payroll management • Multi\-agency recruitment • International employees • Employment visas / mobility administration • BGV • Employee lifecycle • HR compliance • Performance administration • Office mobilisation • Regulated or industrial environments***




 This addition makes the position substantially stronger. It now reads as the 
 **person responsible for establishing the Delhi HQ People Operations infrastructure** 
 , rather than simply a Senior HR recruitment manager.
