title: Senior Manager, HR and Business Operations
description:
**Role: Senior Manager, HR and Business Operations** 




  





**Company:** 
 STEPS Talent Consulting Private Limited
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana
 



**Position Type:** 
 Full\-time · Remote, based in Delhi NCR
 



**Reports to:** 
 Director of India Operations, with direct work for the CEO (US)
 



**Manages:** 
 People \& Operations Specialist; the operations function as it grows
 



**Hours:** 
 India business hours with a fixed daily overlap into US morning hours (Arizona)
 



**Start:** 
 immediate
 



  





 STEPS Talent is an enterprise technology staffing company operating in the United States and India. We hire for the hardest roles in ERP, Cloud, Data and AI, Cybersecurity, and Engineering. Our India business runs its own client delivery alongside the work we do for clients in the US.
 



  





 We are looking for an operations leader to own HR and business operations for our India company, and the staffing back office behind our client delivery in both markets. You will set the processes, manage one direct report, and be accountable for compliance, payroll, invoicing and the monthly close being right and on time. You will have run this full cycle yourself, month after month, and you will know where it breaks.
 



  





**What you will own:** 




  





**People operations** 



* First point of contact for employees on all HR matters, handled confidentially and documented properly.
* HR policy and process: handbook, leave, probation and confirmation, performance documentation, exits.
* Indian statutory compliance: Provident Fund, Employees' State Insurance, Shops and Establishments, Professional Tax, Gratuity, POSH and the Maternity Benefit Act. You own the compliance calendar and manage the external firm that prepares and files.
* Onboarding and offboarding for employees and interns, the HRMS, attendance and the leave calendar.
* Managing and developing one direct report.



  





**Staffing operations** 



* Onboarding of billing consultants and contractors: agreements, background checks, work authorization documents and client portal registration.
* Consultant timesheets every cycle: collection, entry, tracking and follow\-up before gaps become billing problems.
* Placement records in the system of record, and communication with employer\-of\-record partners and vendors.



  





**Billing and India finance operations** 



* Client invoicing on each client's cycle, including through client portals, and receivables follow\-up.
* Accounts payable with TDS applied correctly.
* India payroll cycle and inputs.
* India books in Zoho Books, bank and card reconciliations, and the monthly close with our Chartered Accountant.
* Monthly intercompany invoicing under our services agreement, and the supporting documentation behind it.



  





**Required experience** 



* 8 to 12 years in HR operations and business operations.
* **Has run a full back office end to end** 
 : HR, compliance, payroll, invoicing, vendors and books, at a company of roughly 30 to 150 people. You will have done these yourself rather than managed people who did them. If each of these sat in a separate department where you have worked, this is likely not the right seat.
* At least 4 years running the back office of a staffing company serving US clients. Corporate HR alone does not qualify for this seat.
* At least 2 years managing a direct report whose work you were accountable for.
* Has personally run monthly payroll and month\-end close for an Indian entity, working directly with a Chartered Accountant.
* Has managed Provident Fund and Employees' State Insurance registrations and the monthly filing cycle.



  





**Required skills** 



* **Indian labor law, hands\-on:** 
 registrations, monthly and annual filings, inspections, notices and assessments, and which obligations are triggered by headcount, wage thresholds and worker classification.
* **TDS:** 
 deduction at the correct section and rate, deposit, quarterly returns and certificates.
* **US staffing back office:** 
 consultant timesheets, W2 and C2C consultants, client invoicing cycles, and client portals such as SAP Ariba or SAP Fieldglass.
* **Zoho, hands\-on.** 
 Zoho Books and Zoho People at a minimum, configured and used day to day rather than viewed. Zoho Recruit is an advantage.
* Written English that is plain and precise.
* Discretion with confidential information, and the confidence to say no when the process says no.
* **Based in Delhi NCR** 
 , or relocating there before you start. We work remotely, and this role includes in\-person work in Gurugram as needed, typically a few days a month, for banking, our Chartered Accountant and statutory matters. You schedule that yourself. Able to work a daily overlap with US morning hours (Arizona).



  





**Good to have** 



* QuickBooks, Tally, employer\-of\-record platforms, or operations across two related companies in different countries working under an intercompany services agreement.
* US HR basics: I\-9, the W\-2 and 1099 distinction, workers' compensation.



  





**What we offer** 



* A defined path to Associate Director at six months, measured against criteria agreed with you on day one, covering both the operations half of the job and the people half.
* Remote working, as the whole of our India team does.
* A direct working relationship with the founder and the India leadership team.
* Compensation matched to your experience.



  





**How to apply** 




 Apply on LinkedIn, or email your resume to Sunny.Patel@stepstalent.com with the subject line "Senior Manager, HR and Business Operations \- \[Your Name]".

We focus on a collection of organisational technology capabilities, including business intelligence, data management, and data assurance that help our clients drive innovation, growth, and change within their organisations in order to keep up with the changing nature of customers and technology. We make impactful decisions by mixing mind and machine to leverage data, understand and navigate risk, and help our clients gain a competitive edge.
   

  

 Creating business intelligence from data requires an understanding of the business, the data, and the technology used to store and analyse that data. Using our Rapid Business Intelligence Solutions, data visualisation and integrated reporting dashboards, we can deliver agile, highly interactive reporting and analytics that help our clients to more effectively run their business and understand what business questions can be answered and how to unlock the answers.

 Faster, better, and stronger finance functions significantly contribute to organization\-
   

 wide agility, results and effectiveness. Finance has been in the midst of a digital
   

 revolution coupled with new\-age operating models and capabilities. These value levers

 Transformation. We believe these are irreversible trends in the medium term and
   

 finance teams must take advantage of this opportune time to transform. We work
   

 closely with finance leaders and draw on industry trends, insights, accelerators, and our

 way that builds confidence and buy\-in from all stakeholders. We work in small cross\-
   

 functional and efficient teams and run iterative sprints to enable incremental and rapid
   

 change delivering fast results.
   

 Managing business performance in today’s complex and rapidly changing business
   

 environment is crucial for any organization’s short\-term and long\-term success. But
   

 ensuring compliance with the continual changes to regulatory requirements, and the
   

 ability to plan and monitor performance against plans and budgets, is quite challenging.
   

 As part of the Technology Consulting –Data \& Analytics Practice, we leverage

 our clients .

 working closely with client teams for defining business requirements, understanding

title: Transformation Officer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 The Transformation Officer is an intellectually curious, analytically driven role at the foundation of the Transformation Office. Working as a core member of a transformation program team, this individual supports the delivery of discrete workstreams by conducting structured business analysis, gathering and synthesising operational data, mapping processes, engaging with subject matter experts, and producing clear outputs that drive informed decision\-making and program progress.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for an early\-career professional with the mindset of a consultant — someone who is energised by problem\-solving, takes initiative to dig into the detail, and takes pride in producing high\-quality, rigorous work. The Transformation Officer will work closely alongside global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business, gaining broad exposure to the firm's operations and technology landscape while contributing meaningfully to real transformation outcomes from day one.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**Analysis \& Research**
* Conduct structured current\-state analysis to understand existing processes, workflows, roles, and operational pain points, through interviews, workshops, and data review
* Gather, clean, and analyse quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement
* Develop and maintain process maps, data models, and analytical frameworks that underpin workstream findings and recommendations
* Analyse interdependencies between people, process, technology, and governance elements of the operating model, under the guidance of the Senior Officer or Program Lead
* Proactively research best practices, benchmarks, and comparable approaches to inform solution design
* Contribute to the development of business cases, options papers, and other analytical outputs that inform senior decision\-making


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Requirements Gathering**
* Engage day\-to\-day with global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business to gather information, validate analysis, and support the change process
* Support the facilitation of workshops and interviews with stakeholders across functions to capture requirements, surface pain points, and gather input
* Assist in translating business needs into clear, structured requirements and user stories for technology and process workstreams
* Support change impact assessments and stakeholder mapping activities
* Build constructive working relationships with subject matter experts and operational counterparts across the business
* Communicate findings and workstream updates clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing, in a manner appropriate to the audience


**Technology\-Enabled Transformation**
* Support work with Global Process Owners, Tech, Product, and Operations teams to understand technology solutions and their implications for the operating model
* Contribute to the definition of functional requirements and business logic for tech\-enabled tools, workflows, and automation opportunities
* Develop an active awareness of AI and agentic AI tools and their potential to create value within transformation workstreams, in line with Alter Domus's AI governance framework
* Assist in ensuring alignment between business processes and system capabilities, flagging gaps and inconsistencies for resolution


**Workstream Support \& Delivery**
* Support the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned workstreams, taking ownership of defined tasks and deliverables within the broader program plan
* Maintain up\-to\-date workstream documentation, including process maps, trackers, issue logs, and meeting notes
* Assist with data analysis, reporting, and insights to inform program governance and decision\-making
* Participate in testing, user acceptance, and validation activities to ensure solutions meet business needs
* Identify and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies promptly, with an initial view on potential solutions
* Demonstrate a self\-starter attitude — proactively progressing work without waiting for direction, and consistently delivering to a high standard


**Change Management \& Documentation**
* Support the design and delivery of change activities, including communications, training materials, and readiness assessments
* Help identify change resistance and contribute to strategies that build engagement and adoption across impacted teams
* Produce clear, well\-structured documentation of current\-state and future\-state processes, including standard operating procedures (SOPs), playbooks, and knowledge assets to enable smooth transition to new ways of working
* Contribute to knowledge transfer activities and ensure workstream outputs are thoroughly recorded and accessible for BAU teams


**Essential**
**Skills \& Experience Required:**
* 3\-4 years of professional experience in management consulting, business analysis, operations, financial services, or a related analytical field; exceptional recent graduates will also be considered
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — able to structure problems clearly, analyse data rigorously, and draw well\-reasoned conclusions
* High attention to detail with a commitment to producing accurate, high\-quality work
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information in a structured and compelling way
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to build clean models and well\-structured presentations
* A proactive, self\-starting mindset — intellectually curious, eager to learn, and comfortable taking initiative in ambiguous situations
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* High levels of personal drive, ownership, and accountability


**Desirable**
* Domain knowledge in one or more of the following:
+ Fund Administration (e.g., NAV production, investor reporting, transfer agency, custody operations, or related middle/back\-office processes)
+ Financial Services Technology (e.g., platforms, infrastructure, system implementations, or digital transformation)
+ AI Enablement (e.g., GenAI adoption, process automation, AI\-assisted workflows, or data\-driven transformation)

* Sound understanding of how regulated financial services entities operate, with some exposure to fund administration, private equity, alternative investments, or wealth management
* Exposure to regulatory change programmes or compliance\-driven transformation
* Experience with service design, customer journey mapping, or lean/six sigma methodologies
* Prior exposure to process improvement, project delivery, or transformation activity in any context (professional or academic)
* Familiarity with process mapping or collaboration tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, Confluence, Jira)

title: Product Analyst
description:
**Position Summary**
 The Product Analyst supports the Product Team and their client business processes and operations by maintaining and enhancing existing products and creating new ones. This role requires a strong analytical mindset and technical expertise to work with large datasets, derive insights, and deliver value to stakeholders as well as product management and development experience. The Product Analyst combines operational, technical, and analytic skills with problem\-solving and communication abilities. You will collaborate with and work closely with Senior Data Analyst and/or Product Owner(s) to ensure successful project execution.
   

  

**Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:**
* Operational Execution:
+ Understand and communicate client business needs and issues, operating rules, data structures, and standard operating procedures.
+ Execute and suggest improvements to pre\-defined operational procedures.
+ Implement process improvement in operational workflows, working with Senior Data Analysts and Product Owners.
+ Assist Product Owners to streamline the ideas to development processes, and the technical requirements processes.

* Product Development:
+ Enhance and maintain data products by understanding the data, product(s)/offering(s), client needs, and business goals.
+ Collaborate with stakeholders regarding business objectives.
+ Support product management with product development, and execution.
+ Partner with Product management to create, maintain and update roadmap documentation
+ Assist teams towards common objectives and document the solutions/decisions made.
+ Create technical requirements, user stories and test plans as part of an Agile methodological approach.

* Data Analysis:
+ Compare datasets / various inputs to ensure data quality and derive actionable insights.
+ Apply quality checks and validations to the product delivery, reporting results and elaborative summary for internal team and important stakeholders.

* Stakeholder collaboration:
+ Coordinate with stakeholders across different time zones to ensure smooth working within timelines.
+ Assist engineering teams with knowledge transfer and testing of new operational procedures and enhancements.
+ Facilitate knowledge transfer and overall product knowledge for engineering, Engagement and other teams.
+ Partner with stakeholders e.g. Engagement and Product Owners to understand client business needs and pain points with the intention to write user stories that address those needs.
+ Work closely with product team: Owners, developers and testers to ensure that written requirements are clearly stated, and comprehensive.

* Knowledge development:
+ Build subject matter expertise in operational processes, data tools, content, and necessary technology, and Scrum / Agile methodologies
+ Remain updated on tools, techniques, and working models to enhance processes.
+ Develop functional understanding of the product offering via the technology and deployment stack, to facilitate writing effective user stories, requirements and user acceptance criteria.

* Project Management:
+ Work on multiple client tasks simultaneously, strengthening analytical, task management, and communication skills.
+ Keep track of unplanned internal and clients’ tasks arising from any developments to existing or new products.
+ Maximize time management skills to balance workload in order to complete multiple deadline driven projects with a minimum of supervisory input.

* Coordinate meetings and prepare status update documentation / meetings for ongoing projects Research and Problem\-Solving

+ Coordinate and co lead design sessions to document feature requirements and guide stakeholders towards decision\-making.
+ Investigate issues and recommend solutions to improve processes.

* Detail orientation with a strong focus on quality, analytics, and operations.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals, Managed Markets Consulting or Analytics Consulting with broad based experience in, managed care, and/or analytics will be an advantage.

title: Digital HR Product Analyst
description:
**Job Title: Digital HR Product Analyst**
**Career Level: C**
**Introduction To Role**
 Are you prepared to transform complex HR needs into clear, scalable digital solutions that power hiring and talent growth across a global enterprise? In this role, you will sit at the heart of how we evolve our Talent Acquisition and Talent Management products, ensuring every change is grounded in real user needs and delivers measurable outcomes for the business and, ultimately, for patients.
   

  

 You will be the first line of clarity for product demand, shaping ideas into actionable requirements and guiding them through delivery in collaboration with Product Managers, HRIT, process experts and technology vendors. Could you translate a flood of requests into a coherent, prioritised backlog that improves user journeys and accelerates our impact? With exposure to platforms such as Workday, Eightfold and specialist tools including HireVue, Radancy, LinkedIn and Fieldglass, you will help create a consistent and reliable experience for HR users worldwide.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
 Tickets and Demand Triaging: Bring structure to incoming queries, incidents, access requests and enhancement ideas by clarifying the problem, user groups, urgency and impact; route each item correctly and recommend whether it progresses, is redirected or addressed via guidance or training.
   

  

 Requirements and Impact Assessment: Convert validated needs into detailed problem statements, requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria; assess implications across processes, user journeys, data, integrations, access, privacy and security; identify gaps, dependencies and risks and involve specialists where required; maintain traceability from need to validation outcome.
   

  

 Maintain complete and auditable records in ServiceNow and other tools. De\-duplicate and link related items. Clarify readiness and provide evidence for prioritisation. Ensure ownership, next actions, and partner communications are clear. Monitor progress and raise blockers through governance.
   

  

 Evaluate options with HRIT and vendors based on original requirements and the broader product landscape. Coordinate business validation and end\-user testing, including scenarios, acceptance criteria, participation, results, and defect management. Confirm outcomes and ensure gaps are detailed and addressed. Support release readiness and change planning.
   

  

 Provide timely and transparent updates on status, decisions, and next steps. Explain product and technical details in accessible language. Set realistic expectations while building confidence that requests are understood and managed consistently.
   

  

 Collaboration and Portfolio Support: Build strong working relationships across product, process, HRIT and vendor teams; develop broad knowledge of the portfolio to provide flexible support across products as priorities shift; supply to team resilience through knowledge sharing, documentation and coverage.
   

  

**Essential Skills/Experience**
* Practical experience in product analysis, business analysis or HR technology, including requirements, demand assessment,or product support in an enterprise environment.
* Ability to investigate a business or user problem, ask thoughtful questions and translate collaborator input into clear, structured and proportionate requirements.
* Ability to assess scope, impact, priority, dependencies and risk, and to recognise when specialist product, process, technical or business input is needed.
* Experience supporting user acceptance testing, including defining scenarios and success criteria, engaging users, recording results, capturing defects and confirming whether a solution meets the intended outcome.
* Strong organisation and attention to detail, capable of handling multiple requests at different stages, maintaining accurate records and following through on agreed actions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including proficiency at explaining product or technical considerations in a clear, practical and accessible way.
* Effective relationship\-building skills and experience working collaboratively across business, product, process and technology teams.
* A curious, customer\-focused and practical outlook, with the rigor to ensure requests are accurately analysed and managed in a global, matrix environment.


**Desirable Skills/Experience**
* Experience with Workday and/or Eightfold or any other HR System
* Familiarity with Talent Acquisition or Talent Management technologies, including platforms similar to HireVue, Radancy, LinkedIn, or Fieldglass, is a plus
* Experience using ServiceNow or a comparable service\-management platform to track demand, manage workflows, maintain records and provide collaborator updates.
* AI and Digital Fluency, Demonstrable curiosity and confidence in using AI\-enabled tools to improve analysis, productivity and stakeholder support. Able to critically evaluate AI\-generated outputs, apply appropriate human judgement, and use AI responsibly in line with data privacy, security and organisational standards.
* Understanding of HR data, access, privacy, security and integration considerations within enterprise HR systems.
* Awareness of candidate, employee, recruiter and manager journeys, and how digital products support these user groups.
* Experience analysing product\-support trends, user feedback, adoption information or service data to identify insights and improvement opportunities.
* Experience working with collaborators across multiple countries, cultures and time zones.
* Familiarity with technology releases, vendor roadmaps and the evaluation of new product functionality.


**Why AstraZeneca**
 Join a global team that blends ambition with support, where unexpected combinations of expertise come together to solve complex challenges and speed smarter decisions. You will work alongside talented colleagues, leverage modern platforms and data\-driven practices, and help reimagine how work gets done so our scientists and clinicians can focus on discovery that changes patients’ lives. We value curiosity as much as rigour, encourage thoughtful challenge, and provide the tools, networks and learning opportunities to build a diverse career while making a tangible impact.
   

  

**Call To Action**
 If you are ready to turn insight into outcomes and shape how digital HR products fuel our growth, take the next step and make your mark with us today!

title: Product Operations Analyst
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI\-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world\-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
   

  

 At our labor marketplace tech company, we believe that even in the age of AI, the core of success comes down to good people doing honest work. We're seeking a detail\-oriented and automation\-savvy Product Operations Analyst to help us optimize our operational processes and ensure data accuracy across our platforms. This is a fantastic opportunity to grow your career at the intersection of operations, data, and intelligent automation.
   

  

**Who You Are:**
* Automation Enthusiast: You're passionate about eliminating manual work through automation. You've built workflows using tools like n8n, Zapier, or Make.com, and you're always looking for the next process to optimize.
* AI\-Powered Problem Solver: You actively leverage AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or other LLMs to enhance your productivity, solve complex problems, and generate insights. You see AI as a powerful co\-pilot in your daily work.
* Data\-Driven \& Analytical: You're comfortable diving into databases using SQL, analyzing trends in Excel or Google Sheets, and creating dashboards to visualize operational metrics. You use data to drive decisions and measure impact.
* Technical Tinkerer: You enjoy building solutions using no\-code/low\-code platforms like Replit, Retool, or similar tools. You're not afraid to write simple scripts or work with APIs to connect systems and automate workflows.
* Process Optimizer: You have a natural instinct for identifying inefficiencies and redesigning processes. You're organized, detail\-oriented, and obsessed with creating scalable, repeatable systems.
* Self\-Starter \& Collaborative: You can work independently to manage multiple projects while also partnering effectively with cross\-functional teams including Biz\-Ops, product, sales, and payroll.


**What You'll Do:**
* Own Data Quality \& Integrity: Implement and maintain robust processes for validating and verifying data accuracy, consistency, and completeness across all platforms. Develop and enforce data quality standards that become the foundation of operational excellence.
* Build \& Deploy Automation Solutions: Design and implement automation workflows using N8n, Zapier, or custom scripts to eliminate repetitive manual tasks. Identify bottlenecks in current processes and create scalable automation solutions that improve team efficiency.
* Leverage AI for Operational Excellence: Utilize AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and other LLMs to automate data processing, generate insights, create documentation, and enhance decision\-making. Experiment with new AI capabilities to continuously improve operational workflows.
* Manage End\-to\-End Projects: Own short\-term and long\-term operational projects with comprehensive documentation and strict adherence to timelines. Define performance metrics, accuracy benchmarks, and provide proactive updates to stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Drive Process Improvements: Continuously identify opportunities to streamline operations through automation, better tooling, and process redesign. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to implement solutions that reduce manual work and improve data accuracy.
* Partner Across Functions: Work closely with Biz\-Ops, product management, engineering, billing ops, and sales teams to understand data requirements and operational needs. Collaborate on initiatives that enhance data accessibility and usability for all stakeholders.


**Nice To Have:**
* Bachelor's Degree: Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field is preferred but not required if you have equivalent practical experience.
* Scripting \& Development Skills: Experience with Python, JavaScript, or other scripting languages for building custom automation solutions and data processing scripts.
* API \& Integration Expertise: Hands\-on experience working with REST APIs, webhooks, and system integrations to connect disparate platforms and automate data flows.
* Data Visualization Skills: Experience creating dashboards and reports using Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar visualization tools to communicate insights to stakeholders.
* Startup Experience: Previous experience working in a fast\-paced startup environment where you wore multiple hats and adapted quickly to changing priorities.


**Our Values**
* Empathy, Trust \& Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high\-velocity decision\-making, clear\-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.


**About Instawork**
 Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI\-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
   

  

 Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest\-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
   

  

 Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in\-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face\-to\-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

description:

 Challenging. Meaningful. Life\-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual.  Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more careers.bms.com/working\-with\-us.
   

  

 The Software Engineer of Analytics Engineering provides hands\-on technical support to help develop and maintain core data models and the core data layer, working closely with and under the guidance of senior team members. This role is ideal for an early\-career engineer who is eager to build foundational skills in developing robust, scalable, and well\-documented data models and pipelines, while supporting self\-service analytics across the organization.
   

  

 We are seeking a motivated Analytical Engineer with 1\-3 years of experience to join our team. This role bridges the gap between data engineering and data analytics, focusing on transforming raw data into structured, business\-ready datasets. The ideal candidate will support the design, development, and implementation of analytical workflows, helping ensure that data is clean, well\-modeled, and optimized for business intelligence and decision\-making. This role requires foundational technical skills in data transformation, modeling, and pipeline optimization (preferably using DBT). Additionally, a successful candidate is an effective communicator who is comfortable learning to explain technical information to a variety of stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Major Duties**
* Collaborate with the business to gather requirements and deliver data\-products to enable data\-informed decision\-making.
* As a member of the team, develop a centralized data\-layer to deliver data\-products at scale to the business.
* Use ELT framework to help transform raw or semi\-structured data into a contextualized data model (preferably using DBT), supporting architectural solutions (preferably AWS) to drive efficiency.
* Partner with AI and ML teams to deliver the data skeleton for AI\-enabled internal tools.
* Work within DBT to deliver documented, tested, and DRY (“don’t\-repeat\-yourself”) code.
* Follow analytical lifecycle process and quality frameworks to deliver accurate data to internal consumers on\-time.
* Focus on innovative solutions to increase speed\-to\-delivery and accelerate business decision\-making.
* Support gathering of business requirements, help track measurable outcomes, and assist in developing analytical product plans, learning to translate complexity for various stakeholders.


**Qualifications/Degree/Certification/Licensure**
* Computer Science, Physics, Math, Data Science, Pharmaceutical Science, or Engineering area of study preferred
* 1\-3 years of experience in analytical engineering, data modeling, or a similar role
* Some hands\-on experience with or exposure to dbt(Not mandatory)
* Proficiency with SQL, SPARK and Python
* Knowledge of data engineering tools (AWS, Airflow) and visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker)

title: AI Engineer - Healthcare
description:
We're Hiring: AI Engineer – Clinical AI for MedOrbit, an AI\-Native Hospital Platform
 



  





 This isn't a "learn on a toy dataset" role. MedOrbit is already live with paying hospitals and already runs 11 AI agents in production under clinician control. You'll join to build the next ones – starting with lab\-report intelligence and X\-ray analysis – and see your models used by real doctors within weeks.
 



  





**Role Details** 




 Position: AI Engineer (Healthcare AI) – MedOrbit.ai
 



 Location: Nagarabhavi, Bangalore (On\-site, 5 days a week)
 



 Type: Full\-time
 



 Experience: 0 – 2 years
 



 Joining: Immediate joiners strongly preferred
 



 Mandatory: hands\-on experience on at least one real healthcare AI project (academic, internship or personal, with a working demo)
 



  





**About MedOrbit** 




 MedOrbit (by AI Nexus Innovations Hub) is a multi\-tenant hospital management platform built for Indian healthcare. One product serves 24 facility types – from a solo doctor's clinic to a 500\-bed super\-specialty hospital, a pathology lab, an imaging centre, a dialysis chain, a blood bank.
 



  





 It runs the full clinical and operational spine: OPD, IPD, OT, Emergency, NICU, maternity, LIS / RIS / PACS, teleradiology, telemedicine, pharmacy, billing, revenue\-cycle management and insurance / TPA.
 



  





 It is ABDM\-integrated (ABHA, consent, HIP/HIU, FHIR R4\), NHCX\-connected for claims, HL7 and DICOM interoperable, and carries the Indian regulatory surface – NABH/NABL evidence, DPDP consent and data\-erasure.
 



  





 And it is AI\-native: 11 production agents already run under clinician control – an ambient scribe, pre\-consult briefs, consult summaries with draft prescriptions, a result explainer for patients, referral triage, a claim\-denial guard, a queue concierge, medication reconciliation, and voice agents on the front desk and in aftercare.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You will build clinical AI features that sit inside the doctor's consultation workflow – not a side dashboard. Your first two charters are already defined, and both ship into a live product:
 



  





**1️⃣ Lab Report Intelligence** 




 → Build a pipeline that reads a patient's last 3 lab reports (digital and scanned PDFs) and extracts test values, reference ranges and units – across the report formats Indian labs actually produce
 



 → Generate a concise, doctor\-ready summary so the doctor doesn't have to open every past report during consultation
 



 → Build predictive summaries: trend lines across visits, deteriorating markers, cross\-panel correlations and early\-risk indicators that are easy to miss when reports are read one at a time
 



 → Produce AI\-assisted consultation suggestions – discussion points for the patient, follow\-up tests to consider, and what to monitor next
 



 → Wire the output into MedOrbit's existing pre\-consult brief and consult\-summary agents so it appears where the doctor already looks
 



  





 2️⃣
 **AI\-Assisted X\-Ray Analysis** 




 → Train and fine\-tune deep learning models on chest and other X\-ray datasets to detect abnormalities and flag likely conditions
 



 → Build a "second pair of eyes" for the doctor – regions of interest, confidence scores and explainability (Grad\-CAM / saliency maps), with clear "clinician must review" handling
 



 → Integrate with the RIS / PACS module so findings appear on the imaging report inside the HMS, with DICOM in and structured findings out
 



  





  





**What You Bring** 




 Must\-Have:
 



 → B.Tech / B.E. / M.Tech / M.S. in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, Biomedical Engineering, or related field (2024–2026 batches welcome)
 



 → Hands\-on experience on at least one real healthcare AI project – lab/medical report extraction, medical imaging (X\-ray / CT classification or segmentation), clinical NLP, or EHR / HMS data. 
 



 → Strong fundamentals in Python and at least one ML framework (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit\-learn)
 



 → Understanding of ML concepts: supervised/unsupervised learning, CNNs, transfer learning, NLP basics, evaluation metrics (precision/recall, AUROC, calibration)
 



 → Familiarity with Generative AI, LLMs, prompt engineering or RAG
 



 → Comfort reading an API contract and integrating a model into a service someone else built
 



 → Solid problem\-solving skills, a builder's mindset and excellent communication – you'll talk to doctors, not just engineers
 



 → Self\-starter mentality – comfortable in a fast\-paced startup shipping continuously to production
 



  





**Nice\-to\-Have (Bonus Points!):** 




 → Experience with OCR / document AI tools (Tesseract, PaddleOCR, AWS Textract, Azure Document Intelligence, LayoutLM / Donut)
 



 → Familiarity with public medical imaging datasets (NIH ChestX\-ray14, CheXpert, MIMIC\-CXR, VinDr\-CXR) and medical imaging libraries (MONAI, torchxrayvision, pydicom)
 



 → Experience with LangChain / LangGraph, Hugging Face, OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini APIs, vector databases
 



 → Exposure to speech / voice AI (ASR, TTS) or Indian\-language NLP
 



 → AWS, Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines
 



 → Kaggle competitions, open\-source contributions, or published work in medical AI
 



  





**How We Work** 




 Small team, short decision path, direct access to the founders. Specifications are written down and taken seriously. We ship continuously to a live production platform, and AI features are validated with clinicians in hospitals, not in a conference room.
 



  





**Why Join AI Nexus?** 




 ✅ Skip the corporate queue: build production clinical AI from Day 1 on a platform that is already live – no waiting for "the product" to exist
 



 ✅ Real stakes – your models assist real doctors and real patients across 24 facility types
 



 ✅ A mature AI stack to build on: 11 agents in production, ABDM / FHIR / DICOM integration already done
 



 ✅ High\-end MacBook provided
 



 ✅ Fast\-track career growth in a high\-potential deep\-tech startup
 



 ✅ Build products that improve healthcare delivery across India
 



  





  





 Ready to Launch Your AI Career in Healthcare?
 



 Send your resume to: raju@thenexushub.ai
 



 Website: https://www.ainexushub.ai/ \| https://medorbit.ai

 Don't just graduate. Build clinical AI that doctors rely on. Transform healthcare. Grow exponentially.

title: MLOps Engineer
description:
**Overview**
 Job Description
   

  

 At Airbus, we are leveraging artificial intelligence to boost efficiency and quality across our value chain. Our team brings together technologists and business leaders dedicated to innovation and excellence.
   

  

 We are looking for an MLOps Engineer with 0\-2 years of experience to join our Advanced Analytics and Artificial Intelligence PSL. In this high\-growth AI team, you will help develop, maintain, and scale our centralized ModelOps platform. You will work at the intersection of software engineering, DevOps, and Machine Learning operations to keep our AI infrastructure robust while independently delivering feature enhancements.
   

  

 Collaborating with senior engineers, you will focus on improving the ModelOps platform, building MLOps deployment pipelines for both traditional Machine Learning and Generative AI models, exploring modern ML services, automating operational workflows, and developing serverless internal tools.
   

  

**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
* Experience: 0\-2 years of hands\-on experience in Software Engineering, DevOps, MLOps, and Cloud. Fresh graduates with strong project experience or internships in these areas are welcome to apply.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Platform Operations \& APIs: Design, build, and maintain high\-performance, serverless microservices and RESTful APIs for model inference and platform operations. Ensure high availability, reliability, and smooth day\-to\-day operations.
* CI/CD \& Pipeline Automation: Build, configure, and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (using platforms like GitHub and GitLab) with Infrastructure\-as\-Code to automate testing and deployment. Implement automated checks to prevent operational downtime.
* MLOps \& Model Management: Use native AWS AI/ML platforms to deploy, monitor, and manage the lifecycle of Machine Learning and Generative AI models. Set up basic observability for model drift, inference latency, and performance metrics.


 Technical Requirements
   

  

* Core Programming: Strong proficiency in Python and hands\-on experience with FastAPI. Basic knowledge of Vue.js (or similar modern JavaScript frameworks).
* Cloud \& Infrastructure: Solid understanding of core AWS services (Lambda, S3, SageMaker, Bedrock, IAM, ECS, API Gateway, etc.) and hands\-on experience with AWS CDK for defining infrastructure as code.
* DevOps \& Containerization: Practical experience creating and managing Docker containers, utilizing version control systems (GitHub, GitLab), and configuring deployment pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Jenkins).
* Databases: Experience working with both relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (AWS DynamoDB) databases.


 Soft Skills \& Behavioral Attributes
   

  

* Fast Learning Curve: Demonstrated ability to quickly master new technologies, tools, and frameworks.
* Adaptability \& Agility: Willingness to wear multiple hats, building an API one day and tweaking ML pipelines the next.
* Problem\-Solving Mindset: Strong logical reasoning, analytical skills, and attention to detail.
* Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills to articulate ideas effectively within a team environment.


 Nice\-to\-Have / Added Advantages
   

  

* AWS or GCP Cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner / Developer, GCP Associate Cloud Engineer).
* Active GitHub profile, Kaggle participation, or personal projects demonstrating end\-to\-end full\-stack or computer vision implementations.

We build data\-driven decision tools that optimize workforce allocation, reduce hiring friction, and improve clinician retention — all through scalable analytics powered by SQL, Python, and modern BI platforms. * Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover hidden patterns — e.g., drop\-off points in hiring, regional staffing gaps, or clinician retention drivers.

**(THE ROLE)**
**Role Overview**
 The Solution Quality Analyst is accountable to test and sign off on the quality of CBA solutions, ensuring that delivery meets client requirements and acceptance criteria. The role leverages deep domain expertise, test design discipline, realistic test data setup, defect analysis, and stakeholder communication to identify quality risks and support production\-ready releases. This updated role also requires responsible use of AI as a productivity accelerator for data quality analysis, test design, SQL validation, issue summarization, and documentation.
   

  

**AI capability requirement**
 Candidates must demonstrate practical, responsible use of generative AI to accelerate data profiling, data quality rule design, test case creation, SQL analysis, and issue summarization. AI\-generated checks, summaries, or SQL must be validated, corrected, and explained before use.
   

  

**(responsibilities)**
**Primary Responsibilities**
* Participate in requirements meetings to understand client impact, acceptance criteria, testing coverage, environment needs, non\-functional requirements, and testing effort.
* Participate in sprint planning by reviewing user stories, identifying testing tasks, providing estimates, and confirming readiness of test data and environments.
* Create, document, execute, track, and report manual and automated test cases for assigned projects, enhancements, and defects.
* Create realistic participant, provision, configuration, and environment data needed for development, functional testing, regression testing, and UAT preparation.
* Capture, analyze, log, and retest defects; identify quality risks; and partner with developers, product owners, and solution leaders to resolve issues or prioritize backlog items.
* Execute functional and non\-functional testing, including regression, data validation, configuration validation, and release\-readiness testing.
* Support UAT by preparing environments and test participants, validating test scenarios, and documenting results, risks, and required follow\-up.
* Use AI\-assisted QA and data analysis tools to accelerate test design, data quality checks, SQL validation, issue summaries, and documentation while independently validating outputs.


**(requirements)**
**Required Skills and Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Engineering, Math, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 3\+ years of software quality assurance, data testing, or related experience.
* Experience with SQL\-based testing and data validation.
* Experience creating and executing manual tests, with exposure to test automation or automated data\-validation approaches; familiarity with Agile testing methodologies, test planning, test case creation, defect management, and release validation.
* Experience with QA automation frameworks, test\-management tools, or automated SQL/data\-quality validation is a plus.
* Strong knowledge of CBA domain, product behavior, environment setup, test data preparation, client impact, and quality risk analysis.
* Ability to analyze requirements, identify edge cases, distinguish true defects from expected business variance, and communicate findings clearly.
* SQL and data quality fundamentals, including joins, aggregations, exception queries, duplicate detection, null analysis, referential integrity checks, record\-count validation, and trend analysis.
* Strong secure data handling discipline, including preventing confidential, proprietary, client, colleague, production, PII, or PHI data from being entered into public AI tools.


**AI Required And Preferred Skills**
**Skill Area**
**Requirement / Posting Language**
**AI\-assisted data analysis**
 Experience using generative AI tools to accelerate data profiling, SQL analysis, data quality rule design, query explanation, documentation, and issue summarization.
   

  

**Prompt engineering**
 Ability to write clear prompts for data validation scenarios, anomaly detection logic, SQL troubleshooting, reconciliation checks, and data quality reporting.
   

  

**AI output validation**
 Ability to critically review AI\-generated SQL, data quality rules, test cases, and summaries for accuracy, completeness, privacy, and business relevance.
   

  

**Data analysis and RCA**
 Ability to profile datasets, identify patterns, isolate root causes, document evidence, and recommend corrective actions.
   

  

**Preferred AI Usage**
 Experience with ETL validation, source\-to\-target reconciliation, data lineage, data observability, BI/report validation, data governance, and automated data quality checks.

You will be notified during the hiring process which checks are required by the position.
   

  

 Alight requires all virtual interviews to be conducted on video. Please be aware that Alight is a camera\-on culture and may require occasional travel to one of our physical office locations.

 We celebrate differences and believe in fostering an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. We know that diverse teams are stronger, more innovative, and more successful.

title: Associate Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
Why it’s worth it:
   

  

 ReliaQuest’s Quality Engineering team is evolving quality from a test\-execution function into a platform capability focused on automation, reliability, and production safety. As an Associate Software Development Engineer in Test, you will help build automated testing and continuous integration capabilities across backend services, web applications, and mobile platforms.
   

  

 This is a code\-first, automation\-focused engineering role—not a manual testing or documentation\-only position. You will gain hands\-on experience with production\-level systems, test automation, CI/CD, failure analysis, and AI\-assisted engineering practices. Training, pairing, and guidance will be provided, with attitude and aptitude valued over previous job titles.
   

  

 The everyday hustle:
   

  

* Build and maintain automated API smoke and regression tests for backend services.
* Contribute to UI automation using Playwright and, based on interest and business needs, mobile automation.
* Improve test reliability, test data setup, and environment stability.
* Develop and maintain automated tests that run within GitLab CI pipelines.
* Investigate flaky or failing pipelines and, with guidance, determine whether failures are caused by product defects, test code, or environmental issues.
* Analyze logs, metrics, and test reports to identify and troubleshoot failures across services and environments.
* Create clear, actionable bug reports that include reproduction steps and relevant technical details.
* Collaborate with Software Engineering, SRE, and DevOps teams to resolve quality and reliability issues.
* Contribute to test standards, automation frameworks, pre\-commit hooks, engineering helpers, and other quality tooling.
* Help shape how quality is consistently measured and enforced across services.
* Use Claude and other AI\-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test discovery, automation design, code review, failure triage, and technical documentation.
* Identify repeatable Quality Engineering tasks where AI can improve speed, consistency, and effectiveness.
* Carefully validate and refine AI\-generated outputs to ensure they meet engineering, reliability, and security expectations.
* Share useful AI prompts, patterns, and workflows with the broader QA/SDET team.
* Continuously improve automation and quality practices to help prevent incidents rather than only identify defects after they occur.


 Do you have what it takes?
   

  

* Foundational experience reading and modifying code in Java, TypeScript, or a similar programming language.
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP methods, and HTTP status codes.
* Familiarity with Git and branch\-based development workflows.
* A willingness to debug issues across multiple layers, including test code, services, pipelines, and environments.
* An automation\-first mindset and an interest in building reliable, maintainable test solutions.
* Working knowledge of Claude or similar AI\-assisted engineering tools and an understanding of how they can support test design, automation, debugging, failure analysis, and productivity.
* The judgment to validate, refine, and correct AI\-generated recommendations rather than accepting them without review.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly when documenting defects and collaborating with technical teams.
* A collaborative mindset and eagerness to learn through training, pairing, and feedback.


 What makes you uncommon?
   

  

* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines or automated quality gates.
* Experience with test automation frameworks or API testing tools.
* Familiarity with Playwright, Selenium, or mobile automation technologies.
* Experience reviewing logs, dashboards, metrics, or monitoring tools.
* Exposure to production or staging incidents and root\-cause investigation.
* Experience using AI tools to generate or improve automation scripts, test cases, API scenarios, or debugging workflows.
* Familiarity with prompt\-writing techniques for technical work such as log analysis, code explanation, test coverage review, and root\-cause analysis.
* An interest in improving shared automation platforms, developer tooling, and organization\-wide Quality Engineering practices.

title: WLAN Performance Testing - Staff Engineer
description:
**Company**
 Qualcomm India Private Limited
   

  

**Job Area**
 Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Systems Test Engineering
   

  

**General Summary**
 The WLAN Performance Test Engineer is responsible for validating the throughput, latency, RF performance of Wi\-Fi products and Power efficiency under various real\-world and lab conditions. The role ensures compliance with IEEE 802\.11 standards and identifies performance bottlenecks at PHY/MAC layers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Performance Validation
* Conduct throughput testing using tools such as iPerf, IxChariot, octoScope, Spirent, or IXIA.
* Validate performance across different Wi\-Fi standards (802\.11ac/ax/be).
* Measure PHY data rate, throughput, Packet loss, Jitter, Latency, retransmission rate
* RF \& OTA (Over\-the\-Air) Testing
* Perform RF validation including RvR, RSSI, SNR,Adjacent channel interference
* Simulate customer field environment and test performance with different devices including iOS, Mac, Android, Windows
* Execute testing inside shield boxes or anechoic chambers.
* Load \& Scalability Testing
* Validate performance under high client density scenarios.
* Simulate concurrent traffic (VoIP, video streaming, web traffic).
* Interference Testing
* Test performance under co\-channel and adjacent channel interference.
* Evaluate performance in 2\.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands.
* Automation \& Scripting
* Develop automation scripts using C Sharp, Python.
* Automate log collection, KPI extraction and triaging.
* Debug \& Root Cause Analysis
* Analyze packet captures (Wireshark).
* Interpret logs from AP, STA, and driver layers.
* Work with firmware and PHY teams for issue resolution.
* Establish performance benchmarks and release qualification criteria
* Mentor engineers, review test strategy/design and promote testing best practices
* Support customer escalations with in\-depth performance analysis.


**Required Skills \& Qualification**
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
* 10\-15\+ years of experience in WLAN System or performance validation
* Wireless Protocols: Strong understanding of IEEE 802\.11 standards (a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be), OFDM, MIMO, MU\-MIMO, QoS (WMM)
* Tools: Experience with IXIA / Spirent / Keysight test equipment, iPerf, Wireshark
* Networking: Knowledge of TCP/IP stack and preferred experience in Layer 2/Layer 3 networking.
* Analytical tools: Expertise in log analysis tools (Wireshark, tcpdump) for troubleshooting connectivity and performance issues
* Automation framework development experience


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4\+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.


 OR
   

  

 Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3\+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.
   

  

 OR
   

  

 PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2\+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.

title: System Performance Engineer
description:
**Our Company:**
 At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 System Performance Engineers are key members of a specialized technical team focused on diagnosing, analyzing, and improving performance across the Teradata analytics ecosystem. In this role, you will work on complex customer environments to investigate CPU, memory, I/O, network, and query\-processing behavior; identify bottlenecks; and recommend tuning or configuration changes that improve stability, scalability, and throughput. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical problem\-solving skills with hands\-on experience in relational databases, Linux or UNIX systems, and performance diagnostics in enterprise\-scale environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Analyze system and database performance using logs, metrics, and diagnostic tools to identify performance bottlenecks and abnormal behavior
* Work directly with customers and internal teams to investigate performance issues and deliver clear, actionable recommendations
* Apply structured troubleshooting methods to isolate, reproduce, and resolve complex workload, query, and infrastructure performance problems
* Perform root cause analysis for degradation incidents and document findings, corrective actions, and preventive recommendations
* Partner with engineering teams to identify product defects, validate fixes, and improve observability and performance diagnostics
* Track technical actions, tuning recommendations, and ownership across cases to ensure timely follow\-through and high\-quality customer communication
* Deliver a strong customer experience through professional communication, technical depth, and a focus on measurable performance outcomes
* Follow incident and escalation processes for priority issues while maintaining clear status updates and technical case documentation
* Support a 24x7 global environment through participation in on\-call rotations, weekend coverage, or after\-hours escalations as required
* Contribute to proactive performance improvement initiatives, including trend analysis, repeatable diagnostics, and continuous tuning best practices


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline
* 3\+ years of experience in system performance engineering, database administration, technical support, or a related role in enterprise data environments
* Hands\-on experience supporting Linux or UNIX systems in production environments
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret performance metrics and troubleshoot complex technical issues
* Experience working collaboratively across support, engineering, and customer\-facing teams
* Strong communication, prioritization, and time\-management skills in a fast\-paced technical environment
* Experience using ticketing, incident management, or case tracking systems such as ServiceNow


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting performance in complex database or analytics environments at enterprise scale (Teradata experience is a plus)
* Strong knowledge of relational databases, SQL execution plans, indexing strategies, and query optimization
* Exposure to public cloud platforms and performance considerations in cloud\-based data environments
* Experience with scripting or automation using Python, Shell, Perl, or similar languages
* Knowledge of Linux system administration, system resource analysis, and operating system performance tools
* Understanding of network fundamentals and their impact on end\-to\-end system performance
* Experience with workload analysis, benchmarking, trend analysis, or capacity planning is a plus
* Familiarity with storage, I/O, and infrastructure components that influence database and platform performance
* Teradata platform, DBA, or analytics ecosystem experience is strongly preferred


**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
 We prioritize a people\-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well\-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
   

  

 Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for
 *all* 
 .**
 Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
   

  

 As an Electrical Failure Analysis (EFA) Technician within the Non\-Volatile Memory Quality \& Reliability Assurance (NVMQRA) organization at Micron Technology, Inc., you will support electrical characterization, failure analysis, reliability testing, and laboratory operations for NAND Flash memory and Solid\-State Drive (SSD) products.
   

  

 You will work closely with engineers to perform failure screening, electrical testing, data collection, and debug activities supporting product qualification, reliability assessments, manufacturing excursions, and customer\-return investigations. This role requires strong attention to detail, technical capability, and a willingness to learn semiconductor products, storage technologies, and failure analysis methodologies.
   

  

 Responsibilities and Tasks
   

  

 Support Electrical Failure Analysis Activities
   

  

* Implement electrical characterization and screening activities on NAND Flash and SSD products.
* Perform sample preparation, device handling, and test setup following established procedures.
* Run engineering and reliability test programs on characterization and test platforms.
* Collect, document, and organize test results for engineering review.
* Perform visual inspection of devices, components, and hardware to identify abnormalities.
* Assist engineers in reproducing failure conditions and gathering debug data.
* Maintain accurate records of failure symptoms, test conditions, and characterization results.


 Support Reliability and Qualification Testing
   

  

* Prepare samples for reliability evaluation and qualification testing.
* Monitor reliability testing activities and report issues promptly.
* Perform data collection and preliminary result verification.
* Support qualification, engineering, and manufacturing investigations.
* Assist with customer\-return (RMA) sample handling and tracking.


 Support Lab Equipment and Operations
   

  

* Set up, operate, and maintain electrical characterization and debug equipment.
* Perform routine equipment verification, calibration checks, and preventive maintenance.
* Fix basic hardware, software, and connectivity issues.
* Raise equipment problems to engineers or vendors as needed.
* Support installation and qualification of new laboratory equipment.
* Maintain laboratory safety, cleanliness, and organization.


 Support Data Management and Reporting
   

  

* Enter characterization and failure analysis results into databases and tracking systems.
* Generate test logs, reports, and data summaries.
* Verify data accuracy and report discrepancies.
* Assist with data trending and analysis activities.
* Maintain proper documentation according to quality and reliability procedures.


 Support Continuous Improvement and Automation
   

  

* Find opportunities to improve laboratory efficiency and workflow effectiveness.
* Support implementation of automation, scripting, and digital solutions for laboratory operations.
* Apply approved AI\-enabled productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent tools) to improve documentation, data organization, and reporting efficiency while following Micron data governance requirements.
* Participate in team improvement projects and operational excellence initiatives.


 Training and Team Support
   

  

* Learn NAND Flash memory, SSD products, and storage technology fundamentals.
* Participate in on\-the\-job training (OJT) programs.
* Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and safety guidelines.
* Support multi\-functional engineering teams during debug and investigation activities.
* Share technical observations and communicate issues clearly with engineers and team members.


 Education
   

  

**Required**
* Diploma in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Electronics \& Communication Engineering, Computer Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Semiconductor Technology, or related technical subject areas.


 Fresh graduates and early\-career candidates are encouraged to apply.
   

  

 AI \& Digital Skills
   

  

* Ability to use Generative AI and Agentic AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or equivalent platforms) to enhance productivity, improve collaboration, accelerate issue resolution, and streamline documentation and reporting.
* Demonstrated willingness to adopt digital and AI\-enabled workflows to improve efficiency, responsiveness, and data\-driven decision\-making while adhering to company policies and data governance requirements.


**Experience**
 Fresh graduates with strong technical aptitude and laboratory experience are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**Preferred**
 Exposure through internships, laboratory work, academic projects, technical training, or industry experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:
   

  

* Failure Analysis (FA) laboratory operations
* Electronics testing and troubleshooting
* Semiconductor manufacturing or testing
* NAND Flash memory technologies
* Solid\-State Drive (SSD) products
* Reliability or qualification testing
* Automated Test Equipment (ATE)
* Electronics laboratory instrumentation
* Data collection, reporting, and analysis


**Qualifications**
* Basic knowledge of electronics, semiconductor manufacturing, NAND Flash memory, and SSD technologies.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to follow technical procedures and safety requirements.
* Basic troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and data analysis skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Ability to learn new equipment, software, and technologies quickly.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Willingness to utilize digital tools, automation, and AI\-enabled solutions to improve productivity, collaboration, and responsiveness.

 Hyderabad, India (Hybrid — 3 days office / 2 days remote)
   

  

**About Nasuni**
 Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams—and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world’s unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits. As a Vista\-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is transforming how enterprises manage file data with a next\-generation, AI\-ready platform—turning massive file stores into secure, actionable, and AI\-ready data for intelligent automation, analytics, and global collaboration.
   

  

**Why Work at Nasuni (Hyderabad / India)**

* This role focuses on operating and improving the infrastructure that runs our engineering build and testing pipelines, including Jenkins agents, VMware infrastructure, and Linux\-based development environments.

**Release Engineering Support**

**Engineering Infrastructure Support**

**Continuous Improvement**

**AI\-Assisted Workflow Efficiency**

* Experience administering VMware environments including vCenter and ESX hosts
* 2\-4 years of experience in DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, Administration, or Build Engineering
* Hands\-on experience managing Jenkins infrastructure or build systems using Groovy
* Strong Linux systems administration experience
* Experience creating infrastructure automation using Terraform, Ansible, or Packer
* Experience troubleshooting build failures and infrastructure reliability issues
* Experience supporting engineering teams through internal infrastructure services
* Experience automating repetitive operational tasks


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting build and release infrastructure for software engineering teams
* Familiarity with RPM packaging or artifact management workflows
* Experience operating large Jenkins environments with multiple build agents
* Exposure to GitHub Actions, runners, or modern CI systems
* Experience working in environments with VMware clusters supporting development infrastructure


**Ideal Qualifications**
* Experience supporting build infrastructure used by large distributed engineering teams
* Experience improving build reliability and execution performance
* Experience managing virtualized infrastructure at scale (100\+ hosts or VMs)
* Experience migrating build systems toward containerized runners or Kubernetes


**Experience Guidelines**
**Total Experience**
* 2\-4 years in VMware, infrastructure engineering, or build engineering roles.


**Relevant Technical Experience**
* 2\+ years administering Linux infrastructure
* 2\+ years managing Jenkins or build automation systems
* 2\+ years working with VMware infrastructure
* Experience with automation scripting using Terraform, Ansible, or Packer

title: DevOps Engineer II
description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.
   

  

 Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next\-generation skills.
   

  

 People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You’ll be part of a high\-performing DevOps team responsible for evolving our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and observability frameworks across environments. You’ll have the autonomy to design, build, and optimise our infrastructure systems while enabling developer productivity at scale.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for all HackerRank environments from development to production.
* Automate infrastructure using Terraform, Docker, and Kubernetes (EKS), ensuring scalability and reproducibility.
* Lead and evangelise DevOps best practices across engineering teams, CI/CD hygiene, observability, and cost\-efficient architectures.
* Implement and maintain monitoring, alerting, and incident response systems using tools like OpsGenie, New Relic, and ELK.
* Optimise the performance and utilisation of key systems such as Redis, RDS, Redshift, ElasticSearch, and Kafka.
* Partner with security and platform teams to ensure compliance, resilience, and threat protection across cloud environments.
* Contribute to cloud cost optimisation initiatives and infrastructure efficiency projects.


**Who You Are**
* Bring 3\+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Cloud Infrastructure Engineering roles.
* Deep expertise with AWS (and ideally some exposure to GCP), including EKS, EC2, S3, SQS, and IAM.
* Strong experience with Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and Linux (Ubuntu)
* Hands\-on scripting or coding skills in Python or Java.
* Solid grasp of monitoring, alerting, and performance tuning principles.
* Strong collaborator who can partner with developers, QA, and leadership teams to drive platform improvements.


**Even better if you have**
* Experience implementing ArgoCD, Jenkins, or other CI/CD orchestration tools.
* Background in security engineering, threat modelling, or penetration testing.
* Knowledge of observability frameworks and modern APM tools (New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana).
* Proven track record in cost optimisation and infrastructure scaling for high\-traffic systems.
* Experience working with multi\-cloud or hybrid environments.


**You will thrive in this role if**
* Bring a builder’s mindset to automate processes, simplify workflows, and empower others through effective tools.
* Being passionate about reliability, scalability, and developer experience.
* Enjoying owning systems end\-to\-end and solving production challenges hands\-on.
* Balances technical depth with empathy, understanding that infrastructure is successful only when developers can move faster and safer.
* Take pride in creating calm out of complexity and designing systems that just work.
