title: Software Engineer (Fullstack), Collections
description:
**Who Are We?**
 Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million\+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500\. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API\-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.
   

  

 The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore \- where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.
   

  

 P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API\-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.
   

  

**About Us**
 The Collections team owns some of the most foundational features of the Postman platform like Collections, Documentation, and Version Control. These are the building blocks that developers around the world rely on every day to design, test, and deploy APIs. The services powering these features operate at massive scale, and with that scale comes a constant stream of hard engineering problems, from data consistency and storage efficiency to system reliability and performance under heavy load. In addition, the team works on evolving the product through new features shaped by real user needs.
   

  

****The Role****
 We're looking for a Software Engineer who is energized by the challenges that come with scale. If you enjoy solving complex problems that don't have easy answers, have a bias for action, and want to help shape how a high\-scale platform is engineered end to end, this role is for you. You'll also help shape where the product goes next, building experiences used by millions of developers.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Own and build secure, performant, and scalable end\-to\-end experiences for Postman, tackling day\-to\-day challenges around scale, performance, and reliability.
* Work with agility. Move quickly, make pragmatic trade\-offs, and iterate fast to deliver incremental improvements.
* Improve quality and reliability by strengthening test pipelines, and proactively addressing bottlenecks and technical debt.
* Collaborate closely with engineers, designers, and product managers to deliver solutions that meet both technical and user needs.
* Help define and drive engineering best practices including code quality, system design standards, and operational excellence, while contributing to the engineering culture through knowledge sharing, code reviews, and mentoring peers.
* Contribute to new features and product improvements driven by user needs and innovation, including quickly building functional prototypes for internal and external use\-cases.


****What We’re Looking For****
* 2\-4 years of experience, with a track record of building and shipping features at scale.
* Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js and databases (SQL/NoSQL) which preferably includes query optimization and schema design.
* Strong Computer Science fundamentals \- algorithms, networking, and operating systems, along with a genuine curiosity for solving scale\-related challenges.
* A strong sense of ownership and agility. You see problems through from design to production and get things done even under ambiguity or constraints.
* A collaborative mindset. You communicate well, work confidently across teams, and can challenge stakeholders like PMs and EMs when needed.
* An appreciation for product thinking. You love translating user needs into technical solutions and building things that create real value for users.
* A commitment to writing testable, maintainable code, paired with a curiosity to learn new things and explore beyond silos.


****Why Join Us?****
* Build for millions. Work on a high\-velocity team shaping the systems that power Postman for developers around the world.
* Solve problems that actually matter. Scale, reliability, distributed systems \- every day brings a new challenge worth sinking your teeth into.
* Own it, end to end. Be part of a culture that values curiosity, ownership, trust, and winning together, even under constraints.
* We've got you covered. Competitive salary and benefits, a flexible schedule, and real room to grow.


**What Else?**
 In addition to Postman's pay\-on\-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team\-building events will keep you connected, while our donation\-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long\-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.
   

  

 At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in\-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.
   

  

**Our Values**
 At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity**
 Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

* Contribute to and maintain a scalable design system in Figma, ensuring consistency across product experiences.

* Proficiency in Figma, including prototyping, components, and design systems.
* Solid understanding of user\-centered design principles, information architecture, and interaction design fundamentals.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain design decisions and incorporate constructive feedback.
* Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively in an asynchronous environment.
* Comfort working as part of a distributed, remote\-first team.

 Candescent is seeking a thoughtful, detail\-oriented UI/UX Designer to shape the look, feel, and usability of our website and digital experiences from one of our India office locations. You will design intuitive, on\-brand experiences from wireframe through high\-fidelity mockup, working closely with web, marketing, and product marketing teams to bring ideas to life.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on design role for someone who enjoys solving user problems through clean, purposeful design and who wants to see their work built and shipped quickly. You will work closely with the web development team to ensure designs are implemented accurately and responsively.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Deliverables**
*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*
**Design \& Delivery**
* Design wireframes, mockups, and high\-fidelity UI for web pages, landing pages, and digital experiences in Figma.
* Translate business goals and user needs into intuitive user flows and information architecture.
* Design and iterate on landing pages and campaign assets in support of marketing and demand generation initiatives.
* Support A/B testing initiatives by designing test variants for key pages and conversion flows.


**Design Systems \& Consistency**
* Create and maintain a design system and component library to ensure visual consistency across the site.
* Apply Candescent brand standards consistently across all digital work, including typography, colour, iconography, and imagery.
* Ensure designs follow accessibility best practices (WCAG) and are optimised for performance.


**Research \& Validation**
* Conduct or contribute to user research and usability testing, and gather feedback to inform design decisions.
* Use analytics and test results to identify usability problems and prioritise improvements.
* Stay current on design trends, tools, and best practices, and bring fresh ideas to the team.


**Collaboration \& Ways of Working**
* Collaborate closely with the web development team to ensure designs are implemented accurately and responsively, and support a clean handoff.
* Partner with stakeholders across marketing, product marketing, and sales to gather requirements and present design concepts.
* Present and explain design decisions clearly, and incorporate feedback constructively.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs.


**Experience**
*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*
* 3–5 years of experience in UI/UX design, preferably for web or digital marketing.
* Strong proficiency in Figma, including components, auto layout, and prototyping.
* Solid portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, typography, and layout skills.
* Understanding of responsive design principles and designing for multiple breakpoints and devices.
* Working knowledge of UX best practices, user flows, and information architecture.
* Ability to translate business and marketing goals into clear, user\-centred design solutions.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to present and explain design decisions to stakeholders.
* Detail\-oriented, with a strong sense of visual polish and consistency.


**Qualifications \& Preferred Distinctions**
*Additional accomplishments*
* Bachelor’s degree in Design, Interaction Design, Visual Communication, or a related field; equivalent professional experience and a strong portfolio will be considered.
* Hands\-on experience building or editing sites in Webflow is preferred.
* Basic understanding of HTML and CSS and how designs translate to code is preferred.
* Experience with user research or usability testing methods is a plus.
* Familiarity with A/B testing and conversion rate optimisation principles is a plus.
* Experience designing for SEO\-friendly page structures is a plus.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Designs are intuitive, on\-brand, and elevate the overall user experience.
* Design\-to\-development handoff is smooth, with minimal rework needed.
* A well\-maintained, scalable design system that speeds up future work.
* Measurable improvements in usability and conversion on redesigned pages.
* Stakeholders receive clear rationale for design decisions, not just deliverables.


**What Will Make You Successful**
* Genuine curiosity about how users behave, and willingness to let evidence change the design.
* Comfort designing within an established brand system rather than starting from a blank page.
* Strong attention to detail and a high standard of craft and quality.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities without losing momentum.
* Clear, proactive communication with stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* A collaborative, low\-ego working style and a genuine willingness to give and receive feedback.
* Strong organisation, follow\-through, and accountability in a global, fast\-paced environment.


**Portfolio Submission**
*Required with every application*
 A portfolio is mandatory for consideration. Applications submitted without a portfolio link or PDF will not be reviewed. Please include a link to an online portfolio or an attached PDF, with access credentials if the work is password protected, along with three to five selected pieces that best demonstrate your web and digital design work. For each piece, include a short note describing the brief, your specific contribution, and the outcome.
   

  

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
 To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

title: Associate Software Engineer
description:
**Associate Software Engineer (Backend) — Digital Platform \& Engineering** 




**Location:** 
 Noida (work from office, 5 days a week)
 



**Experience:** 
 1–2 years
 



**Team:** 
 Digital Platform \& Engineering (DPE)
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Engineering Manager, DPE
 



  





**Who we are** 




 Over the past 17 years, Medanta has created an unrivalled impact in delivering world\-class multi\-specialty care for patients in India. We have hospitals in Gurgaon, Noida, Lucknow, Patna, Indore and Ranchi. In addition, we have clinics in Defence Colony (South Delhi), Cyber City \& Subhash Chowk (Gurgaon), and at the Delhi Airport. Medanta continues to expand its healthcare ecosystem through diagnostics, pharmacies, homecare services and digital health initiatives.
 



 Digital Platform \& Engineering (DPE) is Medanta's newly built product and technology organization. Modelled on India's leading internet companies, DPE brings together product managers, designers and engineers to build the products and platforms that power patient journeys, clinical care and hospital operations across the Medanta network. We work from our own office in Noida, with strong sponsorship from the CEO and the stability of a profitable, publicly listed healthcare group.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for Associate Software Engineers with strong computer science fundamentals and early hands\-on experience of how real software gets built, reviewed and shipped. You will build backend services and APIs that doctors, nurses and patients rely on every day.
 



 This is a role for engineers who want to learn fast in a small, high\-calibre team. You will work alongside experienced engineering managers and senior engineers, with engineering levels and practices modelled on India's top product companies. We move with startup energy, but in healthcare quality is non\-negotiable, so you will learn to build software that is fast to ship and safe to trust.
 



  





**What You Will Work On** 



* **Seamless patient journeys** 
 — the services behind finding the right doctor, booking a visit, diagnostics, payments, discharge and follow\-up across OPD, IPD, emergency and day care.
* **Products that empower clinicians and caregivers** 
 — technology that assists doctors, nurses and care teams managing heavy patient loads.
* **Platform\-first foundations** 
 — reusable services such as payments, care subscriptions, scheduling and a unified patient record, designed once and used by every product across the network.
* **Voice\-first, touch\-first and AI\-first experiences** 
 — backends for products where people speak instead of type, tap instead of filling forms, and are assisted by AI at every step.
* **A Hospital Information System built from scratch** 
 — the core clinical platform, including EMR, that runs every hospital workflow.
* **Intelligence and interoperability** 
 — AI\-powered services, healthcare data platforms, and integrations with national digital health standards such as ABDM and FHIR.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, build, test and ship backend services and APIs in Java (Spring Boot) or Python (FastAPI), with guidance from senior engineers.
* Write clean, well\-tested and maintainable code; take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.
* Understand the components of the systems you work on — databases, caches such as Redis, message queues such as Kafka — and why each is used.
* Model data and write efficient queries on relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
* Debug and fix issues across development and production, and contribute to monitoring and reliability.
* Work closely with product managers, designers and senior engineers to understand requirements and the clinical workflows behind them, including occasional visits to our hospitals.
* Ask questions, think independently, and constructively challenge designs when something does not add up.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents throughout development — planning, implementing, testing and refactoring — while owning every line you ship, whether you or an AI wrote it.
* Follow secure coding and data\-privacy practices for systems that handle patient data — audit trails, role\-based access control and encryption of sensitive data, in line with regulations such as the DPDP Act — and strict guardrails so patient information is never exposed to unapproved AI tools.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




***Must have***



* 1–2 years of software development experience at a product company, startup or technology services company, with exposure to a real development workflow — version control, code reviews, testing and deployments.
* Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures and algorithms, object\-oriented programming, databases, and operating systems and networking basics.
* Proficiency in Java or Python.
* Hands\-on use of AI coding assistants and agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) in day\-to\-day development — writing effective prompts, breaking tasks down for an agent, and rigorously reviewing and testing what it produces.
* A clear understanding of the project you currently work on — its design, the components used, and the reasons behind those choices.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, and the ability to explain your thinking clearly while solving a problem.
* Good written and verbal communication.
* A builder's mindset: excited to build from the ground up, comfortable with ambiguity, and keen to take ownership.
* A product mindset — curiosity about how hospitals work, and care for the outcome for the user, not just the ticket.
* Depth over frequent switches — we value engineers who have stayed long enough in a role to learn from it.



***Good to have***



* Hands\-on experience with Spring Boot or FastAPI.
* Exposure to Redis, Kafka, or other caching and messaging systems.
* Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms such as AWS.
* Internships, open\-source contributions, or side projects that have been used by real users.
* Personal or internship projects that use LLM APIs or build simple agents.
* Competitive programming experience.
* Exposure to frontend development (React).



  





**Education** 



* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, IT or a related field from a top\-tier institution (IITs, IIITs, NITs, BITS or equivalent).



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Build from the ground up — a Hospital Information System, shared platforms, and voice\-first and AI\-first products — at the scale of one of India's leading hospital networks.
* Learn in a small, flat, high\-calibre team, with close access to engineering leadership and the Chief Digital Officer.
* An engineering bar and career ladder modelled on India's top product companies, with a clear path for growth.
* See your code used by doctors, nurses and patients — and work alongside some of India's most respected clinicians.
* Access to the latest AI coding tools, and a team that is rethinking how software gets built.
* A tech\-first culture: our own office, a flat and informal environment, and open\-door leadership.
* The energy of a startup with the stability of a profitable, publicly listed healthcare group.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
**Full Stack Developer** 




  





 📍
 **Gurgaon** 




**· Full\-time** 




 · Level: Open, we hire the right person first, then decide the level
 



  





**About Enrich Labs** 




  





 We're a venture studio, and we build the products that sales, marketing, and GTM teams run their outreach and operations on. Everything we ship is our own. Three products are live and growing: InboxKit for email infrastructure, Enrich.so for lead data, and our sending platform for running campaigns at volume. More than thousands of customers across the globe use them to find the right people, reach them, and keep the whole machine running.
 



  





 It looks simple on the outside, but it's a hard problem underneath. The infrastructure has to be right the first time, at scale, against systems we don't control, and a single mistake can take weeks to undo. Agencies and outbound teams trust us with infrastructure their business depends on.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 You'll own features from start to finish, both the backend and the frontend. We're a small team, so if you build something, you're also the one who fixes it when it breaks.
 



  





 You'll also have a real say in what gets built. Not just picking up tickets, but helping plan what we ship next across the studio, testing it properly before it goes out, pushing it to production for 10,000\+ customers, and then staying with it long enough to know whether they actually got value from it. A feature that ships and nobody uses is a feature that failed.
 



  





 We're open on experience level. Someone junior who thinks clearly is more valuable to us than someone senior who's coasting.
 



  





**What You'll Work On** 




  




* New features across our products, from a rough idea to something live in front of 10,000\+ customers, including the judgement call about whether it's worth building at all.
* 
* Automation that runs at scale, the systems that do in seconds what would otherwise take a customer days of manual setup.
* 
* Monitoring and reliability, catching problems before a customer notices, and sending alerts that are actually useful rather than noise.
* 
* The interfaces customers live in, dashboards and flows that make something genuinely complicated feel obvious.
* 
* Our public API and integrations, the webhooks and 24\+ tool connections customers build their workflows on.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* You understand how the internet actually works. This is the most important part of the job. You know how DNS, HTTP, proxies, and TLS work, and you understand why things load slowly. You can look at a network trace and figure out what happened, and you've fixed problems that needed this kind of knowledge, not just worked at a level above it.



  




* You're curious about how things break. You think about how a feature could be misused while you're still building it. Maybe you've done CTFs, bug bounties, or authorised security testing, or you just enjoy reading about how things went wrong elsewhere. If you've ever found a bug in someone else's product, you reported it the right way. That matters to us as much as the curiosity itself.



  




* You can build a full feature, start to finish. You've taken something from a blank file to a live product, and kept it running afterward. You're equally comfortable with backend and frontend work, and you don't need someone else to hand things off to you.



  




* You ask why before how. You talk about your work in terms of what it did for users, not just tasks you finished. You've said no to building something before, and you know how to cut scope to ship on time.



  




* You have good taste. You can look at a screen and say exactly what's wrong with it. You think about the boring parts too, the loading, the empty states, the errors, the slow connections, because that's where real products are tested.



  




* You build things on your own, just because you're curious. This isn't about how much free time you have. Plenty of great engineers have full lives outside work. We just want to see that curiosity somewhere.



  





**Good to Have** 




  




* MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node), a good part of our product surface is built on it.
* 
* Next.js or similar modern frontend tools, actually built with them, not just read about them.
* 
* Better Auth, or real work with logins, sessions, and tokens.
* 
* Golang, helpful for our backend, and easy to learn if you think clearly.
* 
* Browser automation like Playwright or Puppeteer, useful for a lot of our setup work.
* 
* None of these are dealbreakers. We'd rather hire someone with strong networking instincts and no Go experience than the other way around.



  





**What We Don't Care About** 




  





 Your degree, or not having one. Where you worked before. How many years you've used a specific tool. GitHub stars. Gaps in your resume. How smoothly you interview, we care about how clearly you think, not how polished you sound.
 



  





**To Apply** 




  





 Share something you've built, and one line on why you built it. A cover letter is optional. That one line isn't.
 



 Send it to
 **hiring@inboxkit.com** 




**Ashmeet@inboxkit.com**

 This is a hands\-on internship within ThoughtSpot's People \& HR Operations team, designed for someone who wants to understand how a fast\-moving, global AI company keeps its people processes running. You will work across the full Hire\-to\-Retire lifecycle — from the moment a new hire joins to the day someone exits — handling the operational work that keeps the employee experience consistent and compliant.
 



 This is a great fit if you are detail\-oriented, comfortable juggling multiple tasks, and want real exposure to how HR Ops works at a Gartner Magic Quadrant\-recognised tech company.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 




  





**1 · Onboarding \& New Hire Administration** 



* Prepare and send new hire welcome emails and Day 1 logistics information
* Create employee profiles in Rippling with all required fields
* Assign and track completion of new hire onboarding task lists in Rippling
* Send and track completion of new hire documentation: offer letter acknowledgement, policy sign\-offs, tax forms
* Coordinate IT provisioning requests for new hires: laptop, system access, tools
* Set up and administer new hire orientation sessions including scheduling and logistics
* Prepare region\-wise new hire checklists, add them to onboarding SOPs, and keep them updated
* Track Day 1 readiness checklist for all incoming hires and flag exceptions
* Monitor and follow up on incomplete onboarding tasks past the due date
* Maintain the new hire tracker and update status fields weekly



**2 · Offboarding \& Exit Administration** 



* Initiate offboarding workflows in Rippling on receipt of termination confirmation
* Send exit documentation packages to departing employees
* Track return of company assets: laptop, ID card, access cards
* Track completion of offboarding tasks and follow up on outstanding items
* Update employee status in Rippling post last working day
* Prepare region\-wise employee\-facing offboarding checklists, link them to existing SOPs, and keep them updated



**3 · Employee Data \& HR Transactions** 



* Process employee data change requests in Rippling: manager changes, title changes, department transfers, location updates
* Generate and send standard employment letters: verification of employment, compensation letters, experience letters
* Process probation confirmation updates in Rippling for non\-US employees
* Update employee records following approval of lifecycle changes
* Maintain the HR transactions tracker and update status on each request
* Follow up on pending approvals and incomplete data change requests



**4 · Compliance \& Audit Support** 



* Run regular audits of new hire task completion and flag non\-compliance
* Maintain and update compliance trackers for onboarding and offboarding
* Run a monthly audit to ensure 100% completion and acknowledgement of all mandatory HR policy sign\-offs and compliance requirements across all regions
* Maintain audit logs and ensure documentation is filed and accessible



**5 · Benefits Operations** 



* Manage additions and deletions of employee benefits data
* Handle first\-level employee benefits queries and escalate where needed
* Follow up with new joiners to ensure completion of benefits enrolment
* Ensure completion of nominations by new joiners
* Coordinate with insurers and brokers on employee queries and follow up through to resolution
* Guide employees through the GMC and OPD claims process and assist with claim rejections
* Manage documentation and system updates for Maternity Leave and Paternity Leave in India



**6 · Ticketing \& Employee Support** 



* Monitor the HR Jira board: triage new tickets, update status, and follow up on overdue items
* Respond to routine employee queries in the \#mypeople Slack channel
* Escalate complex or sensitive queries to senior HR Ops team members
* Log all employee interactions and resolutions in Jira for audit and reporting purposes
* Send acknowledgement and status update messages to employees on open tickets



  





**What You Bring:** 




  




* Pursuing or recently completed a degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field
* Strong attention to detail — you catch things before they become problems
* Comfortable working with tools like Google Sheets, Jira, and Slack — experience with Rippling is a plus
* Clear written communication: you can draft a professional email without much hand\-holding
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and follow up proactively without being reminded
* Discretion when handling sensitive and confidential employee information
* Eagerness to learn how HR Ops actually works inside a global tech company

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a
 **Talent Acquisition Intern** 
 to join our recruiting team and help us hire exceptional talent across both technical and non\-technical roles.
 



 You will work on some of the most challenging hiring problems in the Indian technology ecosystem, finding and evaluating candidates across AI research, computer vision, applied AI, geospatial technologies, signal processing, as well as business and other non\-technical functions.
 



 This is fundamentally a
 **recruiting role, not an engineering role** 
 .
 



 However, the people you recruit may include researchers and engineers working on problems at the level of advanced industry research and PhD\-level specialization, along with candidates across non\-technical functions.
 



 You are
 **not expected to already be a technical expert** 
 . We care much more about your ability to learn quickly.
 



 Over time, you will learn enough about the roles you hire for to conduct meaningful first\-round conversations with candidates across both technical and non\-technical functions.
 



**What You Will Do** 



* Own recruiting pipelines from sourcing to offer for technical and non\-technical roles.
* Conduct structured first\-round interviews and learn how to evaluate candidates for highly specialized technical roles as well as non\-technical roles.
* Work directly with the founding team to refine sourcing strategies, interview questions, candidate profiles, and hiring standards.
* Take ownership of candidate experience and move strong candidates through the process quickly.



**Who We Are Looking For** 



* We are primarily looking for
 **undergraduate students of the 2026 batch** 
 .
* You do not need prior HR or recruiting experience.
* What matters much more is how you think.



**Strong Communication** 




 You can have clear, thoughtful conversations with people across very different levels of seniority, functions, and technical expertise.
 



**What We Are Not Looking For** 




 You do
 **not** 
 need:
 


* Previous HR experience.
* Previous recruiting experience.
* Expertise in every technical or non\-technical domain you will recruit for.
* Knowledge of traditional HR processes or frameworks.



 We are also not looking for someone who sees recruiting primarily as scheduling interviews, coordinating calendars, posting jobs, or moving candidates through an ATS.
 



 The core of this role is
 **finding exceptional people and developing the judgment required to evaluate them well** 
 .
 



**Why Join Auric AI** 



* Recruit for some of the most ambitious technical and non\-technical roles being built in India.
* Work directly with the founding team rather than inside a large HR organization.
* Competitive internship stipend with the opportunity to convert to a full\-time role based on performance.

**Job Description**
 Job Title: HR Manager
   

  

 Department: Human Resources
   

  

 Experience: 6–8 years
   

  

 Employment Type: Full\-time
   

  

**Job Overview**
 We are looking for an experienced HR Manager with 6–8 years of experience to manage and strengthen the organization's HR function.
   

  

 The person will be responsible for KRA \& KPI management, performance management, recruitment, employee lifecycle, HR operations, employee engagement, HR policies, payroll coordination, compliance, and people development.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be capable of independently managing HR processes while working closely with management and department heads to build a structured and performance\-driven work environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 KRA, KPI \& Performance Management
   

  

* Develop and implement KRA and KPI frameworks across departments.
* Work with department heads to define measurable KRAs and KPIs for employees.
* Establish and manage monthly, quarterly, and annual performance review processes.
* Track employee performance against defined KPIs.
* Identify performance gaps and implement improvement plans.
* Manage appraisal, increment, promotion, and performance review processes.
* Prepare performance reports and present relevant insights to management.


 Recruitment \& Manpower Planning
   

  

* Manage recruitment from manpower requirement to employee joining.
* Coordinate with department heads to understand hiring requirements.
* Prepare and update job descriptions.
* Manage sourcing, screening, interviews, selection, and offer processes.
* Maintain candidate pipelines and recruitment trackers.
* Monitor recruitment timelines and hiring requirements.


 Employee Lifecycle Management
   

  

* Manage employee onboarding, induction, confirmation, transfers, promotions, and exits.
* Ensure proper maintenance of employee records and documentation.
* Handle employee queries and concerns.
* Conduct exit interviews and analyze attrition trends.
* Ensure smooth exit and full \& final coordination.


 HR Policies \& Processes
   

  

* Develop, implement, and update HR policies and SOPs.
* Standardize HR processes across departments.
* Ensure effective communication and implementation of HR policies.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve HR processes.


 Employee Engagement \& Retention
   

  

* Plan and implement employee engagement initiatives.
* Develop employee recognition and reward programs.
* Conduct employee feedback and engagement activities.
* Handle employee grievances and workplace concerns.
* Work on initiatives to improve employee experience and retention.


 HR Operations \& Payroll Coordination
   

  

* Oversee attendance, leave, employee records, and HRMS.
* Coordinate payroll inputs with the Finance/Accounts team.
* Ensure accurate HR documentation and employee data.
* Prepare regular HR MIS and reports.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information.


 Compliance
   

  

* Ensure HR processes comply with applicable employment laws and regulations.
* Coordinate with external consultants or statutory partners where required.
* Maintain necessary compliance records and documentation.
* Support HR audits and compliance reviews.


 Management Reporting
   

  

**Job Expectations**
* Prepare and present HR reports to management.
* Track key HR metrics such as:
* Headcount
* Attrition
* Recruitment status
* Performance
* Attendance and leave
* Appraisal status
* Employee engagement
* Hiring timelines
* Provide HR insights and recommendations to management.


 People Management \& Business Support
   

  

* Work closely with management and department heads on people\-related matters.
* Support manpower planning and organizational requirements.
* Identify employee development and training needs.
* Support organizational changes and people\-related initiatives.
* Act as the primary HR point of contact for employees and management.


 Key KRAs
   

  

* Effective implementation of KRA and KPI frameworks.
* Timely completion of performance reviews and appraisals.
* Timely closure of manpower requirements.
* Effective employee onboarding and lifecycle management.
* Employee engagement and retention.
* Accurate and timely HR operations and payroll inputs.
* Effective implementation of HR policies and processes.
* Compliance and documentation.
* Accurate HR MIS and management reporting.
* Continuous improvement of HR processes.


 Candidate Requirements
   

  

* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 6–8 years of relevant HR experience.
* Strong experience in KRA, KPI, performance management, and appraisals.
* Hands\-on experience in recruitment, employee relations, HR operations, and employee engagement.
* Good understanding of payroll processes and statutory compliance.
* Strong knowledge of HR policies and processes.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong leadership, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets and HRMS.
* Ability to independently manage HR operations and work closely with senior management.


**Minimum Qualification**
* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.


**Minimum Job Experience**
 6\-8 Years
   

  

**Reporting To**
 Director
   

  

**Travel**
 Yes

* Excellent planning, co\-ordination, and organizational skills.

Understands the strategic impact of the HR function across the organization.

 The Manager – HR Operations will be responsible for managing core HR operational processes at the corporate level, ensuring compliance, accuracy, and efficiency across employee lifecycle activities (excluding onboarding). **Job Purpose:**

The role will focus on operational excellence, governance, and continuous improvement while leading a team to ensure timely and accurate execution of HR processes.

**HR Systems \& Process Administration**

* Drive automation and digitization initiatives to improve operational efficiency.
* Monitor system workflows and resolve issues in coordination with IT and vendors.


**Compliance \& Governance**
* Ensure adherence to statutory requirements related to employee records and HR processes.
* Maintain compliance with internal policies and audit standards; address any gaps proactively.

* Support implementation of HR policies and procedures across the organization.

* Oversee resolution of HR operations\-related queries (HRIS, documentation, policy clarifications) within defined SLAs.
* Ensure high levels of employee satisfaction through timely and accurate support.


**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Prepare and share HR operations dashboards and reports on employee movements, compliance metrics, and process efficiency.

* Knowledge of statutory compliance and HR documentation standards.

 Aimlay Pvt Ltd is a global educational and writing support service platform focused on empowering working professionals and experiential learners through lifelong learning. **Introduction To Role**
 At AstraZeneca we are guided in our work by a strong set of values, and we’re resetting expectations of what a biopharmaceutical company can be. By truly following the science, we pioneer new methods, new thinking and bring unexpected teams together. From scientists to sales, lab techs to legal, we’re on a mission to turn ideas into life changing medicines that transform lives. We need great people who share our passion for science and have the drive and determination to meet the unmet needs of patients around the world. If you’re swift to action, confident to lead, willing to collaborate, and curious about what science can do, then you’re our kind of person.
   

  

 Are you ready to transform people strategies into measurable business outcomes that accelerate the delivery of life\-changing medicines? This role partners directly with senior leaders to shape workforce plans, elevate performance, and build a culture where bold ideas turn into real\-world impact for patients.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Contribute to and supports the execution of the business area’s strategic direction and HR agenda.
* Lead multidisciplinary HR projects across recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, people, employee relations, and change.
* Liaise with senior management to define business needs and tailor HR and employee relations solutions.
* Act as the main point of contact for complex HR policy issues, advice, and guidance.
* Guide, mentors, and challenges manager on the application of HR and employee relations practices.
* Ensure HR interventions are integrated, consistent, and aligned with organizational objectives.
* Drive and supports the development and implementation of cultural and organizational change plans.
* Ensure compliance with corporate policies, collective agreements, and local employment laws.
* Monitor employee relations trends and resolves ER issues, managing risk and liaising with appropriate experts as needed.
* Review and analyze business unit data to identify trends and recommend solutions to improve performance, retention, and employee experience
* Plan, manage and provide continuous improvement to all aspects of the client organization and leadership review process and the strategic objectives therein. This includes both annual and any adhoc increases which focus on performance management and talent development.
* Nurture Performance Driven Culture \- Consult and Coach Managers on understanding AZ Performance Framework, Driving Performance Discussions and Addressing Underperformance.
* Lead Pulse Survey \& Culture transformation agenda – Ensuring employee participation, Focus Group discussion with employees on Pulse Insights, Action Planning with Leadership basis FGDs and Pulse insights, Handholding Leaders in driving action plan implementation and progress.
* Plan and steer employee engagement initiatives to promote synergies and spirit of camaraderie amongst employees (Employee Connect, Leadership, People Manager Connect).


**Essential Skills/Experience**
* 10\+ Years post qualification HR experience with minimum 6 years in Business partnering
* Postgraduate Degree/MBA in HR from Institute of repute.
* Excellent business insight and the ability to think and act strategically in the deployment of HR interventions
* Ability to design and deliver HR solutions in line with business priorities
* Ability to build \& forge strong relationships with collaborators and the ability to influence change
* Should continually look for opportunity areas \& challenge the status quo to enhance efficiency \& effectiveness
* Excellent communication skills, detailed oriented \& organized
* Demonstrate AZ values consistently
* AI and Digital HR Proficiency

* Experience partnering within IT/ITES and global matrix environments.
* Shown delivery of large\-scale organizational change using design thinking and agile methodologies.
* Sophisticated proficiency with HR analytics platforms and visualization tools.
* Depth in employee relations across multiple jurisdictions and compensation planning.
* Coaching credentials or certifications in organisational change, ER, or OD.


 When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life\-changing medicines. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world.
   

  

**Why AstraZeneca**
 Join a distributed team that fuels the enterprise with insight, innovation, and courage. Unexpected teams share the same space, fueling bold thinking that directly improves how we serve patients. We blend mission with momentum, using digital innovation and data\-driven decisions to simplify, modernize, and scale smarter ways of working. Here, entrepreneurial spirit is real: you’ll own ideas, make quick, ethical decisions, and see your work ripple across the organization. We value courtesy alongside ambition and provide the support, networks, and autonomy you need to stretch, grow, and build an unrivalled reputation while making a relevant difference.
   

  

 Bring your bold HR leadership to AstraZeneca and turn ambition into impact—step forward today to shape a high\-performing, patient\-focused future!

 17\-Sept\-2026

 08\-Oct\-2026

description:
Voyager (94001\), India, Bangalore, Karnātaka
   

  

 Senior Manager, Associate Relations
   

  

 At Capital One, we think big and do bigger things. We were the first company to develop and offer mass customization and personalization of credit card, auto loans and other financial services products, and we have been innovating relentlessly ever since.
   

  

 Today, we are a progressive financial services powerhouse spanning Credit Cards, Auto Loans, Savings, and Commercial Banking and at the same time a high\-tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a well\-recognized brand all in one. We are a passionate and entrepreneurial team with heart – a team that embraces bold ideas, fosters collaboration, and delivers world\-class products and services impacting over 65 million customer accounts. Still founder\-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry and for each other. Our goal is simple – bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change.
   

  

 At Capital One India, we solve fundamental business problems at scale using advanced analytics, data science and machine learning. We specialize in deriving valuable insights about various aspects of the business \- including product and process design, consumer behavior, regulatory and credit risk, and much more \- from large volumes of data to build cutting edge patentable products at an industrial scale.
   

  

 Looking for a role that offers a wide breadth of involvement? Enjoy consulting with the business to assist in problem solving? Human Resources is looking for someone who is motivated and willing to take on new opportunities.
   

  

 The
 **Sr Manager, Associate Relations** 
 provides consultation to internal associates on HR policies and may resolve formal employment complaints. Typically looked to as a subject matter expert to help resolve problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Investigate and resolve manager and associate issues
* Resolve manager and associate issues by acting as a coach and providing guidance
* Help people leaders associates, and business leaders reconcile conflicts and disputes
* Ensure all associates have an objective and knowledgeable resource at their disposal to work through challenging employment, performance and policy issues
* Partner with other departments such as Legal, Benefits, Office of Corporate Investigations and Security Operations to ensure legal and regulatory compliance while identifying solutions
* Investigate and resolve formal employment complaints including harassment, discrimination,wrongful termination, etc.
* Review departmental case data to identify trends and recommend action plans for business units to implement
* Partner with the line of business HR Business Partners to enhance people leader capabilities
* Review policies and procedures that support the associate experience
* Act as role model and champion for Capital One values
* Participate in internal projects that improve processes that require partnership with crossfunctional teams and integrative problem\-solving skills
* Knowledge of employment law and employment practices
* Lead, motivate and develop a team of Associate Relations Consultants
* Examine data at the department, line of business, and division level to identify trends and recommend action plans for business units to implement
* Serve as a point of escalation for investigations into formal employment complaints including harassment, discrimination, wrongful termination, etc.


**Basic Qualifications:**
* MBA or Master’s Degree or PGDM Full\-time
* At least 12 years of client management experience
* At least 5 years of experience as a Human Resources Business Partner
* At least 1 year of experience leading project teams


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Knowledge of employment law and practices
* 10\+ years of experience working in a team environment and collaborating with multiple stakeholders
* 13\+ years of Human Resources experience, with a focus on employee relations


*We recognize that many life paths can contribute to interest in this role. We value all experience, whether gained in a classroom or through other paths, and invite everyone who meets the qualifications to apply for this role.*
*At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.*
 No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non\-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Capital One promotes a drug\-free workplace. Capital One will consider for employment qualified applicants with a criminal history in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable laws regarding criminal background inquiries, including, to the extent applicable, Article 23\-A of the New York Correction Law; San Francisco, California Police Code Article 49, Sections 4901\-4920; New York City’s Fair Chance Act; Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Records Screening Act; and other applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations regarding criminal background inquiries.

title: HR Associate
description:
**About Arbolus**
 Arbolus is the next\-generation customer diligence platform, redefining how private equity investors and consultants access real, actionable and differentiated customer insight on SaaS and technology companies.
   

  

 At the core of our platform is the world's largest database of attributable B2B customer reviews, giving investment and origination teams direct access to unique customer sentiment and a true strategic advantage to run faster, more confident diligence on the world's leading software assets.
   

  

 Since 2018, we've redefined the traditional expert network model with a tech\-driven approach that delivers high\-impact insight at the speed of modern dealmaking. Arbolus stands out through its unique database of customer reviews accessible via the Arbolus Customer Review Library, Canopy, our market\-first automated Q\&A tool, and our unmatched standard of client service — because great technology should always be backed by great people.
   

  

 Headquartered in London, Arbolus is a venture\-backed scale\-up with 170\+ employees across four global hubs, including Barcelona, New York and Gurgaon. Following a $20M Series B, we are rapidly expanding our U.S. presence as we execute our mission: to digitize human knowledge and make it instantly accessible and actionable.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The People team sits right at the core of Arbolus and is responsible for attracting, supporting and retaining the talent that powers our business worldwide.
   

  

 As an Associate in the People team, you will work across the full employee life cycle — from recruitment and onboarding through to performance management and offboarding — partnering with hiring managers to bring great people into the business and supporting them throughout their time with us. You will also play a hands\-on role in building the culture of our Gurgaon hub, from engagement initiatives to the day\-to\-day moments that make Arbolus a place people want to stay.
   

  

 This is a broad, generalist role with real ownership from day one, and plenty of room to grow as we scale.
   

  

**What You'll Be In Charge Of**
* Managing employee life cycle activities including recruitment, onboarding, offboarding, training, performance management, and compensation and benefits administration
* Partnering with hiring managers to write job descriptions, run interviews and hire the right people for our teams
* Planning and running employee engagement activities — celebrations, team events, wellbeing initiatives and culture\-building moments across the Gurgaon office
* Owning the grievance redressal process, handling employee concerns with care and ensuring timely resolution
* Analysing HR metrics to spot trends and improvement areas across engagement, attrition and performance appraisals
* Collaborating with stakeholders in India and globally to implement People strategies that support business objectives


**About You**
 We're looking for curious and ambitious people who are eager to learn, take ownership and contribute to Arbolus' growth. You enjoy working with people, you're organised enough to keep several things moving at once, and you're comfortable handling sensitive conversations with discretion.
   

  

**Requirements To Succeed In This Role**
* 1–2 years of overall HR experience
* Hands\-on experience with recruitment and broader HR responsibilities
* Exposure to the entire employee life cycle (hire to retire)
* Proficiency using an ATS
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to handle confidential information discreetly


**Nice to have**
* Previous experience in a start\-up or fast\-paced environment
* Experience organising employee engagement or culture initiatives
* Intellectual curiosity and a genuine desire to learn


**What We Offer**
* Annual performance\-based bonus on top of your base salary
* 25 days of paid time off per year, plus all local bank holidays
* Comprehensive health insurance and gym membership
* Top\-notch equipment to keep your work efficient and smooth
* Free coffee, tea, snacks and lunch to keep your energy up through the day
* Regular social activities run by our local Social Committees


*We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*
*Arbolus is committed to providing reasonable adjustments for qualified individuals with disabilities, in our job application and/or interview process. If, due to a disability, you need assistance or adjustment in completing your application please email us at* 
*talent@arbolus.com* 
*. Please put "Reasonable Adjustment" in the subject line and provide a brief description of the type of assistance you need. Please note that this inbox is not monitored for application status update requests.*
*We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. All job applicants must be authorised to work for any employer in the country where the position is indicated to be based.*

description:
SmartBear delivers application integrity for modern tech stacks, ensuring continuous, measurable assurance that software just works as intended with governance to operate at AI speed and scale. SmartBear offers deep test automation, API lifecycle management, and observability capabilities. With integrations across the SDLC, it sets a new quality standard for application delivery teams.
   

  

 SmartBear is trusted by developers, testers, and software engineers across 32,000 organizations, including 75% of the largest financial institutions and industry leaders such as Adobe, JetBlue, and Microsoft. SmartBear’s open source tools are downloaded more than 100 million times a month and have earned over 30,000 GitHub stars from the developer community. With its best\-loved brands, including Swagger, TestComplete, Reflect, QMetry, Zephyr, and more, SmartBear meets customers where they are to make our technology\-driven world a better place. Learn more at
 
 www.smartbear.com
 
 , or follow us on
 
 LinkedIn
 
 ,
 
 X
 
 , and
 
 Reddit
 
 . 
   

  

 At SmartBear, you will be part of a dynamic team solving one of the most critical challenges facing modern businesses: ensuring the integrity of software in an AI\-driven world. Whether you are working directly with customers, driving go to market strategies, supporting operations, building products, or enabling teams, your contributions help shape the future of software quality for organizations worldwide. Join us in our mission.
 



**Senior People Partner (HRBP)** 




 This is a pivotal role for SmartBear's India operations, combining hands\-on HRBP partnership with company\-wide accountability for statutory compliance. As HRBP to your assigned function, you'll partner with senior business leaders to align People \& Culture strategies with business priorities, coach leaders on talent, performance, and organizational effectiveness, and drive strategic people initiatives that build high\-performing, engaged, and inclusive teams. You'll also serve as India's statutory compliance expert, owning alignment with Indian labor law across all India\-based SmartBear employees including those outside your HRBP client group, regardless of function or reporting line, in partnership with our Sr. Director of Global People Operations. 
 



**About the Role:** 



* Partner with business leaders to align People \& Culture strategies with organizational goals and translate business priorities into actionable people plans.
* Coach and advise managers on performance management, employee development, organizational design, compensation, and employee relations.
* Analyze employee engagement survey results and develop action plans with leaders.
* Develop and implement talent retention strategies that enhance employee experience.
* Serve as a trusted advisor, influencing leaders through data, business insight, and People \& Culture expertise.
* Collaborate across the People \& Culture organization to deliver consistent, scalable, and impactful people programs.
* Partner with global People \& Culture teams to adapt enterprise\-wide programs to local legal and cultural context.
* The successful candidate will work from our Ahmedabad, India office in hybrid model.



**India Statutory Compliance (all India employees):** 



* Own compliance with Indian labor law — including the Industrial Relations Code, Shops \& Establishments Act, and related regulations — for every India\-based employee, regardless of which function or HRBP they are otherwise supported by, serving as SmartBear's go\-to expert on India employment regulation.
* Partner with the Director of Global People Operations, Legal, and other HRBPs to maintain visibility into employment actions (hiring, compensation changes, terminations) across functions, so compliance risk is caught even outside your direct client group.
* Serve as the single point of accountability and escalation for India regulatory questions raised by other HRBPs or business leaders.



**We are looking for you if you have:** 



* 8\+ years of experience in a senior People Partner or HR Business Partner role, ideally within a high\-growth technology environment.
* Demonstrated success partnering with senior leaders to develop and implement strategic People \& Culture initiatives.
* Strong expertise in performance management, employee relations, and organizational effectiveness.
* Experience analyzing employee engagement data and translating insights into measurable action plans.
* Excellent communication, coaching, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* A passion for building inclusive, high\-performing teams and creating exceptional employee experiences.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian labor law, statutory compliance, and HR regulatory requirements is required, given this role's company\-wide compliance ownership.
* Experience working as part of a global, distributed People \& Culture team is a plus.
* A background in people operations — including HR systems, processes, and policy administration — is a plus.



**Why you should join the SmartBear crew:** 
  
 


* You can grow your career at every level.
* We invest in your success as well as the spaces where our teams come together to work, collaborate, and have fun.
* We love celebrating our SmartBears; we even encourage our crew to take their birthdays off.
* We are guided by a People and Culture organization \- an important distinction for us. We think about our team holistically – the whole person.
* We celebrate our differences in experiences, viewpoints, and identities because we know it leads to better outcomes.



**Did you know?** 



* Our main goal at SmartBear is to make our technology\-driven world a better place.
* SmartBear is committed to ethical corporate practices and social responsibility, promoting good in all the communities we serve.
* SmartBear is headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices across the world including Galway Ireland, Bath, UK, Wroclaw, Poland and Bangalore, India.
* We’ve won major industry (product and company) awards including B2B Innovators Award, Content Marketing Association, IntellyX Digital Innovator and BuiltIn Best Places to Work.



*SmartBear is committed to creating an inclusive workplace for employees where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. We are an equal opportunity employer and make employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other protected status under applicable laws. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that reflects a diversity of thought and experience as well as our values of being smart, open, driven, accountable, and curious.*

title: Assistant Manager People and Culture
description:
Pasban \- The Gatekeeper is hiring an Assistant Manager, People and Culture for our corporate office in New Delhi.
 



  





  





  





 We operate a portfolio of boutique and experiential hotels — wildlife lodges, nature and wellness retreats, heritage properties — many of them in offbeat destinations away from the metros. The corporate office is small and senior; the People and Culture function is being built now, and this is its first operating role.
 



  





  





  





**The Role** 




  





  





  





 This role is the operating engine of the people function. Strategy is set above; execution sits squarely here. You are responsible for the administrative and operational running of the function — the employee and candidate databases, the monthly payroll cycle, first\-round screening and shortlisting, and the documentation and coordination that keep every property serviced.
 



  





  





  





 Reports to the Head, People and Culture — to the Founder until that position is filled.
 



  





  





  





**What You'll Own** 




  





  





  





 • Database and records management — own the recruitment and employee databases as the single source of truth; maintain the candidate tracker, employee master, personnel files and HRMS, audit\-ready at all times.
 



  





 • Payroll processing — run the monthly payroll cycle end to end: attendance, leave, overtime inputs, joiners, exits, increments, incentives, deductions, payroll register, disbursement coordination, payslips, full\-and\-final settlements, and statutory input schedules (PF, ESI, professional tax, TDS).
 



  





 • Recruitment operations and first\-round screening — post and refresh mandates on job portals, LinkedIn and social channels; source and headhunt where required; screen applications; conduct first\-round telephonic or video interviews; record structured screening notes; present a shortlist; schedule subsequent rounds; complete reference checks.
 



  





 • Onboarding, induction and exit formalities — offer letters, appointment letters, joining documentation, day\-one setup (systems, bank, insurance, identity card, unit introduction), confirmations, transfers, and the full exit process.
 



  





 • Employee lifecycle administration — confirmation, increment, transfer, appreciation and warning letters; leave and attendance system; HR calendar; first point of contact for employee queries on salary, leave, benefits and documentation.
 



  





 • Compliance and audit support — statutory registers and documentation across all locations, renewal tracking, audit\-file assembly.

title: People & Culture Lead
description:
**People \& Culture Lead** 




**Hyderabad, India · Reports to Strategy ·** 
**India operations with US entity coordination** 




  





 Own the People function as a true Global HRBP for a 500\+ person India operation supporting a US\-headquartered entity. This is a strategic business\-partnering role first, and an operational ownership role second: you'll sit close to Founders and Function Leads as their HR counterpart across two geographies, shaping org design, talent strategy and workforce decisions in real time — while also owning the full employee lifecycle end to end.
 **Prior experience operating as an HRBP across multiple countries (ideally India \+ US) is required** 
 — this is not a single\-market generalist role.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Global HR Business Partnering (core of the role)** 




 Act as the primary HR partner to Founders and Function Leads across both the India and US contexts — understanding each business unit's goals and translating them into people strategy, org design, and workforce decisions. Advise on organisational design, role architecture, reporting structure and the levelling framework across two regulatory regimes and two talent markets. Bring a comparative lens: know how HR practices, employment norms and talent expectations differ between India and the US, and design policies/programmes that work coherently across both without defaulting to a single\-market template. Be the escalation point Founders and leaders turn to for judgment calls on people issues, not just process execution.
 



  





**Function ownership** 




 Own the P\&C agenda, roadmap and operating model globally. Own the organisational knowledge architecture \- SOPs, handbooks, lifecycle documentation and the knowledge directory \- and keep the documented record current and continuity\-proof across both entities.
 



  





**Talent acquisition** 




 Own hiring across technical and non\-technical roles in India, partnering with US\-side stakeholders on cross\-border hiring needs: requisition governance, pipeline health, interview frameworks and hiring manager enablement. Lead offer construction and closure for senior hires, with awareness of US compensation norms where relevant. Manage recruiting capacity including agency relationships.
 



  





**Compensation and equity** 




 Run the compensation cycle end to end \- benchmarking, band construction, moderation, approval and communication \- with fluency in both India and US market benchmarks. Administer the ESOP programme: grant recommendations, board cadence, documentation and employee communication.
 



  





**Benefits and people operations** 




 Design and roll out benefits including retirement schemes and insurance for the India population, while coordinating with US\-side HR/legal on benefits parity and obligations where applicable. Own payroll governance and vendor performance across employee and contractor populations, onboarding, leave and holiday framework, and HRIS data integrity and access governance.
 



  





**Performance and development** 




 Own the performance and goal\-setting cycle and its alignment to company objectives and board reporting, across both geographies. Design and facilitate manager and leadership development. Run recognition programmes tied to company values.
 



  





**Compliance and employee relations** 




 Hold accountability for statutory compliance across the India entity, including the Labour Codes and POSH, while coordinating closely with legal counsel and US HR/legal on US\-side employment obligations. Own worker classification policy and risk assessment across engagement models in both countries. Manage grievances and investigations, and operate separation processes for voluntary and business\-reason exits across both entities.
 



  





**Data and reporting** 




 Maintain headcount tracking, org charts and workforce data as the single source of truth across India and US populations. Prepare people data for board, investor and diligence requirements, and the analysis behind global headcount planning.
 



  





**Corporate transactions** 




 Support mergers, acquisitions and structural changes: people\-side due diligence, workforce mapping, retention planning, harmonisation of terms across jurisdictions, and post\-transaction integration. Prior M\&A experience is preferred.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* **Required:** 
 Demonstrated HRBP experience, with direct exposure to managing HR across at least two countries — India and US experience specifically preferred.
* Strong grasp of comparative employment law/practice basics between India and the US (this role owns statutory compliance in India and coordinates US obligations, not the reverse).
* Comfort operating as a strategic partner to founders/leadership, not just a process owner.
* Prior M\&A / corporate transaction exposure preferred.

Kroll is seeking a detail\-oriented and analytical

 to support their service line Operations teams in driving operational excellence across a global consulting practice.
   

  

 This role is ideal for an early\-career professional who enjoys working with data, improving processes, supporting business operations, and collaborating with stakeholders across multiple functions. The Operations Analyst will help ensure the accuracy of operational data, support business reporting, coordinate operational activities, and contribute to initiatives that improve the efficiency and effectiveness of their service line.

* Prepare and maintain operational reports, dashboards, and KPIs.

description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Diese Position ist verantwortlich für die Entwicklung, das Testen und die Implementierung von Data Engineering\-Lösungen, einschließlich Datenmodellierung, Datenqualität und Semantik\-/Metadatenentwicklung. Der Data Engineer wird mit dem Team zusammen hochmoderne daten\- und analyseorientierte Lösungen entwickeln und dabei mit GE Vernova zusammenarbeiten, um die Geschäftsanalyse auf eine neue Ebene der prädiktiven Analyse zu bringen und dabei Big\-Data\-Tools und ‑Technologien zu nutzen.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Rollen und VerantwortlichkeitenIn der Position eines Data Engineers sind Sie Teil des Data Engineering oder eines interdisziplinären Teams bei kundenorientierten Entwicklungsprojekten, die oftmals große, komplexe Datensätze beinhalten. Diese Teams bestehen meist aus Statistikern, Informatikern, Software Entwicklern, Ingenieuren, Produktmanagern und Endnutzern, die eng mit Partnern in den Geschäftsstellen von GE Vernova zusammenarbeiten. * Verschiedene Datenladeprozesse und Datentransformationen durchführen.
* Grundkenntnisse von Parsingmethoden, Formatierung und Datentransformation zu Datenanalysezwecken.
* Weist Fachkenntnisse bei der Implementierung von logischen/physischen Datenmodellen auf, die MDM Best Practices unterstützen.
* Durchführen der Integration verschiedener Datenquellenformate in Stammdaten.
* Weist Fachkompetenz in mindestens einem ETL\-Tool auf.
* Kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit (schriftlich und verbal) GrundqualifikationenDiese Position erfordert erste Erfahrungen in Data Engineering. Der akademische Wissensstand befindet sich auf Bachelor\-Abschluss\-NiveauGewünschte EigenschaftenTechnische Fachkentnisse:
* Entwicklungserfahrung mit Scripting\-Sprachen (Pig, Python, Perl usw.)

* Verständnis logischer und physischer Datenmodelle, Big Data\-Speicherarchitektur, Datenmodellierungsmethodologie, Metadatenverwaltung, Stammdatenverwaltung, Datenhierarchie und Datenprofiling.
* Verständnis von neuen Technologien und Technologietrends, selbständig innovative Denkanstöße einbringen.Führungsqualitäten:
* Gute Teamfähigkeit und soziale Kompetenz
* Fähigkeit Informationen verständlich zusammenzufassen.
* Fähigkeit Informationen und Erkenntnisse klar und deutlich darzulegen. Fähigkeiten zur Visualisierung von relevanten Daten und gewonnenen Erkenntnissen. Persönliche Eigenschaften:
* Nutzt Neugier und Kreativität, um den Geschäftswert zu steigern
* Stellt Fragen zu neuen Daten und Projekten. Kann die weitreichenden Folgen einer Idee einschätzen.
* Stellt neue Ideen und Konzepte selbstbewusst vor. FIndet Querverbindungen zwischen bisher unverbundenen Ideen.
* Lust auf permanente Weiterbildung und zum lebenslangen Lernen.

 dnb.com/careers

 The Data Engineer I work as part of an agile team supporting the organization's Research and Managed Services. This is a hands\-on, hybrid, technical, and operational role. The team members will actively write and maintain code to build data tools, automations, and pipelines, while also performing day\-to\-day operational tasks that keep Research and Managed Services running reliably. The role includes identifying and evaluating internal and external data sources to feed AI\-enabled and traditional research workflows. The team member will assess source relevance, quality, coverage, accessibility, reliability, compliance considerations, and applicability to defined business and technical use cases. The role drives best\-in\-class standards and continuous improvement and requires an adaptable professional who is willing and able to learn and adopt new technologies as they are introduced to the organization

**Coding \& Development** 
  

  
* Write, review, test, and maintain code, including SQL and Python, to build data tools, automations, and ingestion and transformation workflows that support Research and Managed Services
  
* Automate manual processes and develop data tools to improve efficiency, accuracy, quality, and throughput
  
* Develop and promote coding standards and contribute to code reviews within the agile team
  
* Build and maintain web\-scraping solutions, API integrations, and reusable data\-processing components
  
* Support scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for structured and unstructured data

* Perform database administration activities, including performance tuning and implementation of best practices
  
* Implement new data\-maintenance processes and provide end\-to\-end process ownership
  
* Ensure data integrity by validating, reconciling, and regularly cleaning data
  
* Investigate and resolve production incidents, pipeline failures, data\-quality issues, and operational exceptions
  
* Follow applicable data governance, security, and operational standards
  


  


**Collaboration \& Continuous Learning** 



  

  
* Evaluate and implement new technology solutions, and proactively learn and adopt new tools, platforms, and methodologies introduced by the organization
  
* Communicate with stakeholders and conduct knowledge\-exchange sessions for technical and non\-technical audiences
  
* Develop and maintain data documentation, including data dictionaries, source assessments, data\-flow diagrams, data mappings, runbooks, and data lineage
  
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams across Data \& Analytics, Technology, Research Services, Managed Services, Product, and Data Governance
  
* Additional duties as assigned.
  


  

  


  




**Key Skills:** 
  
* Strong SQL and Python skills, with demonstrated ability to write and maintain code as a core part of daily work
  
* Experience with Playwright, Selenium, and other web\-data collection techniques
  
* Experience developing and supporting data\-ingestion, transformation, and ETL/ELT workflows
  
* Ability to collect and interpret data from multiple sources, including web scraping and GCS/S3, and formats including delimited files, XML, JSON, and PDF
  
* Working knowledge of data systems and databases used to maintain data pipelines
  
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other dashboard tools
  
* Experience managing stakeholders and project plans
  
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
  
* Willingness and demonstrated ability to learn new technologies as they are introduced
  
* BigQuery experience and knowledge of AWS and/or GCP
  
* Hands\-on experience implementing AI solutions using LangChain or an equivalent orchestration framework
  
* Exposure large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, vector databases, AI agents, or graph databases
  
* Knowledge of Data Operations methodologies, data management approaches, ServiceNow, and/or Jira
  
* Experience with NoSQL technologies, SQL Server administration, R programming, web technologies, and data mapping from multiple sources.
