title: Intern/Apprentice - Learning Management System Administrator
description:
Introduction
   

  

**Job Title: Apprentice \- Learning Management System Administrator**
**Overview:**
 SymphonyAI is a leader in providing enterprise AI solutions to optimize business operations for retailers and manufacturers. Our advanced analytics, planning, and automation products help enhance supply chain efficiency, inventory performance, forecasting accuracy, and customer satisfaction. We aim to deliver measurable client outcomes through innovative technology, deep domain expertise, and robust customer partnerships.
   

  

 We are seeking a motivated Learning Management System Administrator Apprentice to support the management and administration of SymphonyAI’s client\-facing LMS tools, TLC OnDemand and Archbee. This role includes providing training helpdesk support, managing user access, and handling client requests.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**
*LMS Administration*
* Set up and maintain user accounts in the Docebo LMS system, including adding new users, updating support team assignments, and deactivating users.
* Investigate and resolve user\-related errors and process necessary changes.


*Customer Support and Ticket Management*
* Lead the management of CRM tickets for TLC OnDemand requests.
* Maintain and manage the TLC mailbox, addressing and resolving requests, and coordinating with TLC team members as required.


*System and Process Optimization*
* Support the execution of LMS page redesign as legacy tools are decommissioned.
* Perform basic analysis and reporting within the TLC OnDemand system for quarterly, year\-end, and ad hoc insights.
* Regularly review LMS AI\-generated data for accuracy and improvement opportunities.
* Collaborate with the SAI IT team to automate processes where possible.


*Content and Documentation Support*
* Assist with setting up new courses and course materials.
* Help develop and maintain standard operating documents and training materials.
* Assist with developing training documents and Knowledge Base Articles.


*Future Potential*
* Opportunity to expand into programming and managing learning content within the WalkMe platform, including tasks like Shoutout development and publishing (jQuery knowledge required).


**About You:**
* Customer service mindset: passionate about providing excellent support for users, including learners, instructors, and administrators.
* Strong written communication skills: able to explain technical issues in clear, user\-friendly terms and communicate task status effectively.
* Excellent task management skills: able to manage recurring weekly tasks proactively.
* Problem\-solving skills: ability to quickly identify and resolve issues.
* Detail\-oriented: ensures accuracy in reports and double\-checks work.
* Adaptability: willingness to learn new systems and adapt to changes in LMS technology.
* Proficient with Outlook, data entry, and process adoption.
* Highly self\-motivated and confident using AI tools for text, image, and video generation.


**Desired Skills:**
* Proficiency in LMS software (Docebo).
* Basic HTML/CSS skills to customize the user interface or troubleshoot layout issues.
* SQL/Database management skills for handling and querying LMS data.
* Familiarity with e\-learning standards and protocols like SCORM, xAPI, and AICC.


**Why SymphonyAI?**
* Experience a startup spirit within a large international company.
* Engage with exciting technology, including Artificial Intelligence.
* Embrace our core values: Communication, Innovation, and Collaboration.
* We support and encourage innovation: if you have a better way, we want to see it!
* Work with incredibly talented and passionate teams who love what they do.


**Compensation \& Benefits:**
* Comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development within a leading AI technology company.


**Diversity \& Inclusion Statement:**
 We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
   

  

**About Us**
 SymphonyAI is building the leading enterprise AI SaaS company for digital transformation across the most critical and resilient growth industries, including retail, consumer packaged goods, financial crime prevention, manufacturing, media, and IT service management. Since its founding in 2017, SymphonyAI today serves 1500\+ Enterprise customers globally and has grown to 3,000 talented leaders, data scientists, and other professionals across over 30 countries.

Based in Goregaon (East), you will have the opportunity to work alongside colleagues around the world, contribute to meaningful initiatives, and build your career in a collaborative and inclusive environment. The Mumbai office operates with varying shifts to support collaboration across global time zones.
   

  

 For more information, please visit https://www.russellinvestments.com.
   

  

 Job Description:
   

  

 We are seeking a motivated Junior Messaging Engineer to support the administration and maintenance of our enterprise messaging and collaboration environment. The successful candidate will assist in monitoring, troubleshooting, and supporting Microsoft Exchange, Microsoft 365, and related messaging technologies while working closely with senior engineers and cross\-functional IT teams.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone with 1–2 years of experience who is eager to develop technical expertise in enterprise messaging systems, email security, and collaboration platforms.

title: GMS-Staff-SSO-MFA
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**GDS – IAM MS– Staff**
 The SSO \& Access Management Staff are responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day operations of enterprise Single Sign\-On (SSO) and Access Management platforms. This role involves application onboarding, incident and request management, user access administration, authentication troubleshooting, and platform monitoring activities.
   

  

 The individual will work with leading access management technologies such as Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and related authentication and federation solutions, while ensuring secure and reliable access to enterprise applications.
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Support the administration and maintenance of enterprise SSO and Access Management platforms including Okta, PingFederate or similar technologies.
* Provide L2/L2\.5 operational support for authentication, authorization, SSO, MFA, and access\-related incidents and requests.
* Assist with the management of user identities and organization groups within the Okta or Ping platform, ensuring accurate and timely provisioning and deprovisioning of access rights.
* Participate in the integration of new applications into the SSO environment, working closely with application owners and IT teams to ensure seamless Single Sign\-On (SSO) functionality.
* Monitor SSO system performance and logs to proactively identify and address potential issues before they impact users.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of policy documentation, user guides, and training materials to support end\-users and promote best practices.
* Engage in regular security reviews and audits of SSO configurations to ensure alignment with industry standards and compliance requirements.
* Support the implementation of Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) policies across the organization to enhance security posture.
* Collaborate with IT and security teams to refine and enforce access control policies, ensuring the principle of least privilege is maintained.
* Assist in the resolution of tickets and service requests related to Okta or Ping Federate, prioritizing based on impact and urgency.
* Keep abreast of new SSO features and updates, participating in relevant training and knowledge\-sharing sessions to maintain expertise in the platform.
* Provide feedback and suggestions to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the SSO service, including automation opportunities.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Good understanding of identity and access management concepts.
* Strong desire to learn and develop skills in IAM operations and cloud security.
* Good problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within a team environment
* Extensive experience in IAM operations, with a strong focus on Okta, Ping Federate or related technologies
* Knowledge of federation protocols – SAML, OAuth \& OpenID
* Understanding of IAM concepts, cloud security, and operational best practices.


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.


**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts as required
* Willingness to travel as required


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

 Your impact
   

  

 A well\-motivated and creative Post Graduate/Graduate Engineer with excellent numerical, logical, and analytical abilities who is interested in building a career in Engineering, Planning, or Design Consulting on multidisciplinary engineering projects.
   

  

 The Apprentice Program is designed to provide hands\-on, real\-world experience through structured on\-the\-job training within live projects. Apprentices will work closely with Jacobs' senior professionals and project managers, gaining exposure to technical practices, project delivery processes, and organizational culture.
   

  

 This position is an Apprentice role under the Government of India’s Apprentices Act, 1961, and is part of a structured 1\-year training program. As per the regulations and eligibility criteria prescribed under the Act, Jacobs is required to adhere to the government\-mandated guidelines for apprentice engagement. Therefore, it is mandatory for all applicants to meet the specified eligibility requirements.

* Support Senior Engineers in the design, review, and implementation of Telecom and IT infrastructure systems for Data Center projects.
* Assist in the design and coordination of Structured Cabling Systems (SCS), Fiber Optic Networks, Data \& Voice Networks, CCTV, Access Control, PA Systems, WLAN, and BMS interfaces.
* Prepare and update design drawings, layouts, BOQs, technical specifications, cable schedules, and engineering documentation.
* Support Data Center master planning, concept design, schematic development, and detailed engineering activities.
* Assist in rack placement planning, structured cabling layouts, and fiber connectivity design for Data Halls, MMRs, and VNRs.
* Support OSP\-to\-ISP connectivity design through fiber runners, MPO connectivity, torpedo cables, and OFC networks.


 Here's what you'll need

* Academic passing year 2026\.
* No dead or live backlogs/ATKT.
* Minimum 7 CGPA throughout all semesters.
* Candidates must not have any prior work experience.
* Candidates must not be registered on the NATS portal.
* Internship, academic project, or industrial training experience related to engineering design or project delivery is preferred.
* Exposure to international engineering standards and practices is desirable.


**Apprentice Eligibility Requirements**
 As this opportunity falls under the Apprentices Act, 1961, applicants must additionally meet the following criteria
   

  

* Must be eligible for apprenticeship training under the Government of India guidelines.
* Must not have previously undergone apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961\.
* Must satisfy all eligibility conditions prescribed by the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) and applicable government regulations.

description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.
   

  

 Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next\-generation skills.
   

  

 People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Customer Experience Engineering is where customers, product, and engineering meet. As a CXE 1, you’ll investigate real technical problems across our platform, APIs, integrations, data, and customer workflows. You’ll learn to trace issues to root cause, communicate clearly with customers and internal teams, and build the judgment to own increasingly complex work independently.
   

  

 This is not a traditional support role built around scripts and handoffs. You’ll work in one shared CXE queue, use AI as part of your everyday engineering toolkit, and contribute to the knowledge, automation, and product improvements that prevent repeat problems. CXE 1 is designed as a transition into CXE 2 as your depth, independence, and customer readiness become consistently visible.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own standard and moderately complex customer issues from first investigation through resolution and closure.
* Debug web application, API, integration, authentication, configuration, and data issues using logs, developer tools, SQL, and established investigation patterns.
* Communicate clearly and empathetically across tickets, calls, incidents, and internal channels; ask precise questions, set expectations, and close every loop.
* Work with CXE 2 engineers on complex, high\-risk, or enterprise cases, taking on greater ownership as your readiness grows.
* Create structured escalation reports for confirmed product issues and stay accountable for progress and customer closure when Engineering is involved.
* Use AI tools safely to accelerate investigation, validate hypotheses, improve responses, correct support\-agent outputs, and strengthen team knowledge.
* Turn learning from customer issues into better documentation, runbooks, product feedback, and small automation or tooling improvements.
* Protect shared queue health by prioritising accurately, meeting service levels, documenting work cleanly, and helping rebalance work across shifts.
* Participate in rotational shifts and on\-call coverage, including occasional evenings or weekends, to support global customer needs.


**Who You Are**
* A recent graduate or early\-career engineer with up to 3 years of relevant experience. Strong freshers are encouraged to apply.
* Strong programming fundamentals and comfort reading code; experience with Python, JavaScript, Java, or a similar language.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, HTTP, web applications, and how software systems communicate.
* Working knowledge of SQL and an interest in using data to investigate and validate behaviour.
* Curious and systematic: you want to understand why something failed, not just make the error disappear.
* Clear written and verbal communicator who can explain technical ideas in plain language to customers and engineers.
* Comfortable asking for review when risk or uncertainty is high, then applying the feedback quickly.
* Open to rotational shifts and occasional on\-call coverage across a global customer base.


**Even better if you have**
* Built a project, script, bot, or automation that solved a real problem.
* Worked with logs, observability tools, cloud platforms, SSO/SAML/OAuth, or third\-party integrations.
* Used AI coding tools such as Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar and can explain how you validated their output.
* Contributed to an open\-source project, hackathon, internship, or production codebase.


**You will thrive here if**
* You enjoy ambiguous technical problems and are persistent enough to find the real cause.
* You care equally about technical correctness and how the customer experiences the resolution.
* You learn fast, seek feedback, and turn new knowledge into repeatable practice.
* You solve rather than route and take pride in leaving no loose ends.

title: Technical Analyst – Cloud Infrastructure
description:
Shape the future of work in complex industries.
   

  

 At Falkor, we help some of the world's most complex industries operate with greater clarity, confidence, and control.
   

  

 Built on more than 200 years of KONGSBERG industrial heritage, our industrial intelligence platform connects people, systems, and workflows across energy, processing, power, renewables, and other heavy\-asset industries.
   

  

 We turn complexity into clarity and data into decisions, helping organizations improve safety, efficiency, and performance across the asset lifecycle.
   

  

 As industries evolve, we're building the technology that helps people see further, decide faster, and operate with confidence.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for a Technical Analyst – Cloud Infrastructure to join the Customer Support team. This hands\-on support role is suited to a professional with approximately 3\+ years of experience in cloud operations, technical support, or infrastructure support.
   

  

 The successful candidate will support customers with onboarding, troubleshooting, and the reliable operation of cloud\-based services. This role will work closely with Customer Support colleagues and collaborate with Cloud Architects, Solution Architects, Engineering, Product, and Delivery/Customer Success teams as escalation and delivery partners.
   

  

**What You’ll Do** 
 –
   

  

**Customer Support and Cloud Operations**
* Monitor, support, and troubleshoot cloud\-based services across Microsoft Azure and related platforms.
* Support incident response, service restoration, root cause analysis, and follow\-up activities.
* Use dashboards, logs, alerts, and runbooks to identify issues, validate service health, and support customer\-facing operations.
* Maintain accurate handover notes, operational documentation, and support records.


**Customer Enablement and Delivery Support**
* Partner with Cloud and Solution Architects to support effective customer onboarding and delivery execution.
* Assist customers by troubleshooting platform usage issues, onboarding queries, and initial implementation or integration steps.
* Serve as a technical liaison between customers and internal teams to ensure issues are clearly understood and resolved efficiently.
* Contribute to improved customer experience, customer satisfaction, and delivery confidence.


**SLA Management and Support Operations**
* Ensure support requests are managed in accordance with defined SLAs, severity levels, and operational processes.
* Provide customers with timely updates, clear communication, and effective resolution for critical incidents.
* Follow SOPs for ticket prioritization, incident response, escalation workflows, and customer communication.
* Maintain operational discipline to ensure support workflows remain reliable, predictable, and scalable.


**Technical Troubleshooting and Escalation**
* Support Kubernetes\-based cloud services through basic health checks, deployment validation, and first\-level troubleshooting.
* Troubleshoot common issues related to access, configuration, connectivity, workload failures, resource utilization, logs, and monitoring alerts.
* Hands on experience on Grafana, GitOps, no\-SQL DB’s, CI/CD tools, service mesh concepts and hybrid infrastructure.
* Escalate defects, feature gaps, or complex platform issues with clear context, reproduction steps, logs, and diagnostics.


**Knowledge Management and Continuous Improvement**
* Develop and maintain troubleshooting guides, support playbooks, root cause summaries, and customer\-facing explanations.
* Identify recurring issue patterns and recommend improvements to reduce repeat incidents.
* Collaborate with Support, Engineering, Product, and Delivery/Customer Success teams to strengthen product quality and internal troubleshooting capability.


**Shift\-Based Support Coverage**
* Provide cloud support coverage as part of a planned shift roster.
* Work rotational shifts in alignment with Customer Support coverage requirements and business needs. Indicative shift timings include 5:00 AM–2:00 PM, 12:00 PM–9:00 PM, and 8:00 PM–5:00 AM.
* Provide weekend coverage when assigned, ensuring timely handovers and continuity of service.


**What We're Looking For**
* Approximately 3\+ years of experience in cloud support, infrastructure operations, platform support, or a related technical support role.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and foundational exposure to Kubernetes, containers, or cloud\-native services.
* Sound understanding of incident management, monitoring and operational support processes.
* Hands on experience on full\-stack observability platforms like Grafana (including but not limited to querying logs, metrics, traces, setting up dashboards \& alerts).
* Strong ability to analyze, maintain, and develop scripts utilizing PowerShell, Python, Bash, or equivalent tools to streamline operations.
* Strong troubleshooting, communication, ownership, and collaboration skills. Willingness to work rotational shifts and provide weekend support when required.


**Desirable Experience**
* Exposure to AI, ML, data\-intensive workloads, or GPU\-enabled environments.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code concepts (including Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, or Pulumi).
* Experience supporting enterprise, industrial, regulated, or mission\-critical environments.
* CKA certification will be an added advantage.


**Success Measure** 
 s
   

  

* Critical and complex support issues are resolved promptly, clearly, and efficiently.
* Customers experience minimal disruption, timely communication, and high service reliability.
* Customer satisfaction and response times show continuous improvement.
* Support knowledge, troubleshooting guides, and playbooks are structured for effective reuse.
* Recurring issues are identified, escalated, and reduced over time.


**Why join Falkor?**
 You'll be joining a global technology company helping to redefine how complex industries operate.
   

  

**At Falkor, You'll Have The Opportunity To**
 Work on meaningful challenges with real\-world impact
   

  

 Collaborate with talented colleagues across technology and industry domains
   

  

 Learn from experts in software, engineering, operations, and digital transformation
   

  

 Grow your career in a business that is expanding globally
   

  

 Help shape technology that expands human capability in complex industries
   

  

 We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, included, and able to do their best work.
   

  

**About Falkor**
 Falkor is a KONGSBERG company that enables organizations in heavy\-asset industries to expand human capability and redefine how assets are designed, operated, and optimized across their lifecycle.
   

  

 By connecting people, systems, and workflows, Falkor's industrial intelligence platform turns complexity into clarity and data into decisions, helping leading organizations improve safety, efficiency, and performance.
   

  

**Ready to apply?**
 If you're excited about solving complex challenges and making an impact through technology, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 Apply today with your resume.

title: Software Engineer I (SDE1)
description:
**Company Description**
 Abstrabit is a Private AI engineering company building AI\-powered products and solutions for businesses. We work across the AI stack — from deploying and evaluating private and open\-weight models to building production applications, agents, workflows, and integrations on top of them.
   

  

 Our engineering work is organized across two closely connected layers: the
 **AI layer** 
 , focused on models, inference, evaluation, and AI infrastructure; and the
 **application layer** 
 , focused on building reliable, scalable software products that use those AI capabilities.
   

  

**Job Description**
**The Context**
 AI models are only useful when they can be turned into reliable products.
   

  

 That requires strong application engineering — frontend and backend systems, APIs, workflows, integrations, authentication, databases, observability, and production infrastructure that can work reliably with AI inference services.
   

  

 Our Software Engineering team owns this application layer.
   

  

 We are looking for engineers who can independently deliver well\-defined features, understand the systems around them, and grow into broader ownership over time.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Software Engineer I (SDE1\)** 
 , you will work primarily on the application layer of our AI products and own scoped features from implementation through delivery.
   

  

 You will build frontend and backend functionality, APIs, integrations, workflows, and production services that use AI models and inference systems.
   

  

 You will work with technologies such as
 **TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, databases, APIs, and cloud platforms** 
 , while collaborating closely with AI engineers and senior software engineers.
   

  

 This role is suited for someone who is comfortable taking a defined problem, breaking it down, building the solution, testing it, and taking responsibility for getting it into production.
   

  

**What You'll Work On**
 Depending on the project, you may work on:
   

  

* Building and owning frontend and backend product features.
* Designing and implementing APIs and internal services.
* Working with databases, authentication, queues, file storage, and third\-party integrations.
* Integrating applications with AI models, inference services, RAG systems, and AI agents.
* Debugging issues across frontend, backend, APIs, and infrastructure.
* Writing tests and improving application reliability.
* Participating in technical design discussions for the features you own.
* Deploying and monitoring applications on cloud platforms.
* Reviewing code and incorporating feedback from senior engineers.
* Working with AI engineers to convert model capabilities into usable product features.


 Qualifications
   

  

 We are looking for engineers who can independently deliver scoped work and have strong software engineering fundamentals.
   

  

 You should have:
   

  

* At least 1 year of hands\-on full\-stack software development experience, including experience building and shipping web applications across frontend and backend.
* Strong programming and problem\-solving fundamentals.
* Experience building and shipping web applications.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript and a modern frontend or backend framework.
* Good understanding of APIs, databases, Git, and common web application patterns.
* Ability to read an existing codebase and make changes safely.
* Ability to debug problems instead of treating symptoms.
* Understanding of basic testing and software quality practices.
* Ability to communicate clearly about implementation decisions, trade\-offs, and blockers.
* Experience owning a feature or meaningful part of a project from development through delivery.


 Experience with React, Next.js, Node.js, cloud platforms, AI integrations, or production systems is useful, but we care more about engineering fundamentals than an exact technology match.
   

  

**Using AI as an Engineer**
 We use AI tools as part of our engineering workflow, and you are welcome to use them. We do not evaluate engineers based on how much code they can write from memory.
   

  

 What matters is whether you can
 **understand the code you produce, evaluate alternative approaches, identify incorrect suggestions, test your implementation, debug failures, and take responsibility for the final result.**
 AI can accelerate your work. It does not replace engineering judgment.
   

  

**What This Role Is Not**
 This is
 **not an AI research or model\-engineering role** 
 .
   

  

 Your primary responsibility will be the application layer — building the software that turns AI capabilities into reliable products.
   

  

 You will work closely with the AI engineering team and gain exposure to model inference, RAG, evaluation, and Private AI infrastructure, but you will not be expected to own model training or deployment as your primary responsibility.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

**Why Join Abstrabit**
 You will work at the intersection of software engineering and Private AI.
   

  

 You will:
   

  

* Build production software that directly uses modern AI systems.
* Work across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, and AI integrations.
* Learn how application systems interact with private and open\-weight models.
* Work closely with AI engineers and experienced software engineers.
* Own meaningful product features, not just isolated development tasks.
* Receive regular technical feedback and code reviews.
* Grow toward larger feature ownership and system\-level responsibilities as your engineering ability develops.


 Our Interview Process
   

  

 Our hiring process evaluates how you build and reason about software, not how closely your resume matches a list of keywords.
   

  

**Step 1: Application Screening \-** 
 We review your experience, projects, and evidence that you have built and shipped meaningful software.
   

  

**Step 2: Engineering Assessment \-** 
 You will complete a practical engineering exercise based on the kind of work you may encounter at Abstrabit.
   

  

 We care about implementation quality, how you handle edge cases, how you validate your solution, and whether you can make sensible engineering decisions.
   

  

**Step 3: Technical Discussion \-**

title: AI Engineer
description:
About Uplevyl 
 
 Uplevyl builds AI\-powered knowledge and community infrastructure for organizations serving women. Our products include UpGenie (our domain\-specific AI assistant), WeHub (our community platform), and UpSocial (a social platform for women). We work with mission\-driven partners to turn complex, high\-stakes information into clear, trustworthy guidance, and to build systems that create lasting impact. 
 



 We hold a simple conviction: in high\-stakes domains like rights, law, and financial security, a generic AI is not enough. The answers people stake their lives and livelihoods on need a purpose\-built system with verified, native data. That is what we build, and it is why the work is urgent. AI is reshaping how the world learns, works, and earns, and the women we serve cannot afford to be left off that train. 
 



 We have also made a deliberate choice about how we build: a small team of exceptional people, paid well above market, each doing work that would normally take several. We would rather be ten people who move the world than thirty who move paper. That choice sets the bar for every hire, including this one.
 


 About The Role
 
 AI Engineer is the builder of UpGenie's core. You own the AI layer of a production system that answers high\-stakes questions about rights, law, and safety, where the person on the other end may be staking a job or their wellbeing on what we return.
 



 Our system retrieves across tens of thousands of jurisdictions and multiple legal domains, reasons over structured metadata like eligibility thresholds and enforcement agencies, validates its own sources, and proves its accuracy through evals. You will work on retrieval quality, schema design, evaluation infrastructure, and the roadmap from today's pipeline to a genuinely agentic system.
 



 You will ship to production from your first weeks, with real users and real partners depending on what you build.
 


 What You'll Own
 * **Retrieval quality.** 
 The RAG architecture end to end: chunking, metadata filtering, ranking and re\-ranking, and the retrieval logic that finds the right law among tens of thousands of jurisdictions across overlapping federal, state, county, and city layers.
* **The schema and metadata layer.** 
 Design the structured data that makes legal knowledge machine\-usable: thresholds, agencies, citations, jurisdiction hierarchies. This layer is our moat, and you will shape it.
* **Evals as infrastructure.** 
 Build the evaluation framework that proves answer quality: hallucination traps, citation validation, cascade\-logic tests across jurisdiction hierarchies, and statistically defensible coverage claims. If we say the system is right, you built the proof.
* **Source validation.** 
 Own the AI\-first pipeline that decides which legal sources enter the system and which are rejected, and make its failure modes visible before they reach a user.
* **The agentic roadmap.** 
 Move us from hard\-coded workflow logic to schema\-aware prompting and tool\-using agents. You will help define what V3 of the system looks like and then build it.


 Who We're Looking For
 
 We hire across levels. Working systems you have shipped matter more than years. We will ask you to build in our process, because we have learned that talking about AI and shipping AI are different skills.
 


* **You ship working code.** 
 Production systems you built, not notebooks you ran. You are fluent in Python and comfortable owning a service that real users hit.
* **Strong AI fundamentals.** 
 You understand retrieval, embeddings, context management, prompting, and evaluation at the level of mechanisms, and you know where these systems break. You use AI daily to build and you have formed your own view on what is real versus hype.
* **Rigor.** 
 In our domain, a confident wrong answer can harm someone. You test before you claim, you measure before you optimize, and you flag what you are unsure about.
* **High agency.** 
 You unblock yourself. Ambiguous problem, no owner in sight: you scope it, propose an approach, and build.
* **Range, picked up fast.** 
 You move across retrieval, data pipelines, prompting, and evaluation, and you learn a new tool in hours, not weeks.
* **A clear communicator.** 
 You can explain a retrieval failure to a non\-technical partner and defend a design decision to a senior engineer, in plain words either way.


 Even Better If
 * You have shipped RAG or LLM systems that are live in production today.
* You have worked with Vertex AI, GCP, or comparable cloud AI stacks.
* You have built evaluation or testing infrastructure for AI systems.
* You have worked with legal, regulated, or otherwise high\-stakes data.
* You have public work we can look at: open source, writing, side projects that did real work for real users.


 Before You Apply
 
 We want to be direct about what this is. This is a high\-bar role on a small, senior team. The work is demanding, the expectations are real, and the rewards, in compensation, in ownership, and in what you will learn, match them. If you want a defined lane and a slow ramp, this is not the right fit, and that is fine. If you want to build the AI core of a system where accuracy genuinely matters, and grow into the technical backbone of a small, ambitious team, we want to hear from you. Our interview process is thorough, and we will walk you through every step of it in our first conversation.
 


 How We Work at Uplevyl
 * We finish what we start, and we do it well. We follow through on what we say we'll do, and we care about the difference our work makes.
* We listen before we decide. Before we act, we ask who it actually affects: a customer, a partner, a teammate, or the communities we serve. Trust here is built the plain way, by consistently showing up for people.
* We move with ownership and urgency. We don't wait for perfect information or for someone else to raise their hand. If something looks like it could go wrong, we say so early. We make the call, we move fast, and we hold a high bar for quality.
* We're better together than alone. We work across teams, say what we actually think, and go out of our way to help each other succeed. Leadership here is measured by the impact you create.
* We stay curious and keep learning, including how to use AI well. We hold ourselves to the bar we're building toward: questioning our own assumptions and using AI to think better and move faster

* A learning mindset and the willingness to do beyond what’s being told.
* An innate curiosity about how things work under the hood.
* Alignment with our Values.


**What Else?**
 In addition to Postman's pay\-on\-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team\-building events will keep you connected, while our donation\-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long\-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.
   

  

 At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in\-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.
   

  

**Our Values**
 At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity**
 Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. title: Systems Architect – Quantum Neuro-Robotics & AI
description:
**About the job** 



* Proprietary Language \& Platform Engineering: Architect, develop, and deploy a completely custom low\-level programming language, compiler, runtime, and computing platform from first principles to explore alternatives to conventional computing architectures.
* Deep\-Layer AI \& Neural Network Design: Design and implement custom CNNs, deep neural networks, mathematical models, and ML algorithms beyond conventional API\-level AI development.
* Micro\-Scale Robotics: Drive hardware–software co\-design, simulation, control systems, embedded intelligence, integration, and testing for experimental micro\- and nano\-scale robotic systems.
* Biological \& Neuro\-Systems Integration: Explore computational interfaces between intelligent machines and biological systems through neuroscience, neuroanatomy, neural signal processing, brain\-data modeling, and biomedical engineering.
* Advanced Computing \& Systems Architecture: Research operating systems, computer architecture, distributed systems, high\-performance computing, memory systems, networking, compilers, and unconventional computing architectures.
* Sovereign Cybersecurity \& Database Architecture: Design highly secure decentralized data architectures, encryption systems, privacy mechanisms, threat\-resistant infrastructure, and advanced database systems.
* Research \& Experimental Engineering: Investigate problems where established solutions may not exist, build prototypes from first principles, validate hypotheses, and continuously push the boundaries of what current technology can achieve.



  





**Who We Are Looking For** 



* Experience is not mandatory: Exceptional freshers, self\-taught engineers, researchers, and experienced professionals are all welcome.
* Ability over years: We value demonstrated technical ability, intellectual curiosity, problem\-solving, independent projects, research work, and the ability to learn difficult subjects more than a specific number of years of experience.
* Elite Software Craftsmanship: Experience with compilers, programming languages, operating systems, frameworks, runtimes, systems programming, or building complex software from scratch is highly valued.
* Advanced AI/ML: Strong understanding of neural networks, CNNs, deep learning, mathematical modeling, optimization, PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX, or low\-level AI systems is welcome.
* Hardware–Software Co\-Design: Experience with embedded systems, robotics, electronics, computer architecture, edge computing, sensors, control systems, or advanced hardware is welcome.
* Biological \& Neuro\-Scientific Knowledge: Background in neuroscience, computational neuroscience, biology, biomedical engineering, biotechnology, neural systems, or related disciplines is welcome.
* Mathematical Thinking: Strong foundations in linear algebra, probability, statistics, calculus, discrete mathematics, optimization, algorithms, or numerical methods are highly valuable.
* Security Mindset: Knowledge of cryptography, secure systems, distributed databases, privacy engineering, low\-level security, or resilient infrastructure is welcome.
* Multidisciplinary Thinking: The ability and willingness to move beyond one field and learn across computer science, AI, robotics, mathematics, biology, neuroscience, physics, and engineering.
* Mindset: Driven by an insatiable hunger for knowledge, extreme curiosity, disciplined obsession, intellectual courage, and a willingness to attempt problems that may initially appear impossible.



  





**Founder Collaboration** 



* The selected individual will work directly with the Founder on the core project.
* This is not a conventional role where every task is predefined.
* You will be expected to:
* Challenge assumptions
* Research unfamiliar domains
* Design new architectures
* Build experimental prototypes
* Solve problems from first principles
* Participate in long\-term technical decisions
* Work closely with the Founder to turn ambitious ideas into working systems
* You are expected to think with the Founder, not simply execute instructions.



  





**Founding / Co\-Founder Opportunity** 



* For an exceptional individual who demonstrates extraordinary technical contribution, intellectual leadership, ownership, and long\-term commitment, there may be an opportunity to progress into a Founding Architect / Co\-Founder\-level role.
* Depending on contribution and mutual agreement, the founding arrangement may include:
* Equity participation
* Profit participation
* Project\-specific royalty arrangements
* Long\-term technical leadership
* Founding\-team recognition
* Other mutually agreed incentive structures
* Any equity, royalty, intellectual\-property, or profit\-sharing arrangement will be subject to separate discussion, documentation, and applicable legal agreements.



  





**What We Value** 



* Intelligence without books.
* Curiosity without limits.
* Ambition without complacency.
* Experimentation without fear of failure.
* Execution without excuses.
* We are looking for people who don't simply ask:
* “Can this be done?”
* We want people who ask:
* “What would it take to make it possible?”



  





**Important** 



* You do not need to match every skill listed above.
* If you are a fresher with extraordinary potential, apply.
* If you are an experienced engineer looking for a problem significantly outside conventional industry work, apply.
* If you have built something unusual, researched something deeply, developed your own technology, or spent years obsessing over a problem that nobody around you understood — we want to hear from you.
* Mindset and demonstrated ability matter more than a number of years on a resume.



  





**The objective** 



* Build what does not yet exist.
* Explore what others have not explored.
* Attempt what others consider impossible.



  




* And, where the science or engineering proves a limitation, understand the limitation deeply enough to discover what comes next.



  





 The door to Rv5 is not defined by this application. Your journey is much larger than one decision.
 



  





**Rv5 UKSAG** 




*Architecting the Future of Universal Advancement.* 




**Rooted in Wisdom. Driven by Science. Built for Nature.**

title: Software Dev Engineer II, UTR Tech
description:
**Description**
 Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on\-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on\-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on\-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.
   

  

 UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on\-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. As an SDE II on the UTR Tech team, you'll build and scale the systems powering Amazon's fastest delivery promises \- Same\-Day Delivery (SSD), Grocery, and Rush (1\-hr/3\-hr) programs across NA, EU, JP, and the Middle East. You'll own services spanning package injection, staging, sortation, and routing that keep millions of time\-critical orders on\-time, and directly move quality metrics like slot\-level DEA and defect BPS. This role blends deep technical ownership with high operational impact: your code runs in a live, sub\-hour delivery network where reliability and latency are non\-negotiable. You'll partner with product, science, and operations to launch new speed programs and expand grocery (including perishable/chill\-chain) into new regions. We're looking for an engineer who thrives on distributed\-systems challenges at scale and wants their work to be visible to customers the same day.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As an Engineer in the team, you will take part in in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large\-scale and complex software systems. You will get to leverage your experience and expertise to deliver innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will communicate your ideas effectively to achieve the right outcome for your team and customer. You enjoy collaborating with others to increase the effectiveness of the overall team. Your code, design, and implementation decisions should set a great example to other engineers. You will also have the opportunity to impact the technical decisions in the broader organization as well as mentor other engineers in the team.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 60,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty\-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.
   

  

 It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment's notice, and mastering consistency in an ever\-changing world.
   

  

**What We Offer:** 
 At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well\-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.
   

  

 We are building a different breed of BPO , driven by constant innovation and a commitment to excellence in autonomous last\-mile logistics . If you are looking to be part of a dynamic, forward\-thinking culture that embraces technical challenges and masters operational consistency, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

 As a Teammate, you will be directly responsible for remotely operating autonomous delivery robots for a worldwide delivery service. This is a critical role that combines technical operation, safety assurance, and world\-class customer service. You will be a key part of the team dedicated to ensuring timely, safe, and efficient last\-mile service for our customers.
   

  

 In this role, your success will be measured by performance metrics focusing on operational accuracy, efficiency, safety compliance , and providing exceptional service in every remote interaction.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Remote Robot Operation: Safely and efficiently pilot autonomous delivery robots to complete last\-mile customer deliveries, adhering strictly to all traffic laws and operational regulations.
* Safety Assurance: Maintain the highest level of situational awareness and immediately intervene to ensure robot safety and public well\-being during all phases of operation.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve basic, real\-time technical and navigational issues that arise during remote operation.
* Customer Interaction: Provide immediate, high\-quality remote support to customers during the delivery process (e.g., confirming drop\-offs, addressing immediate concerns).
* Communication \& Collaboration: Maintain clear, prompt, and effective communication with Mission Control and team members to ensure smooth handover and operational continuity.
* Process Improvement: Proactively identify and report operational bottlenecks, contributing valuable feedback to improve internal processes and robot performance protocols.
* Documentation: Accurately record operational data, customer interactions, and delivery outcomes.


**Essential Requirements**
* A minimum of a High School Diploma or equivalent .
* Exceptional attention to detail and a high degree of visual processing accuracy.
* Demonstrated knowledge of basic troubleshooting techniques and comfort with complex software interfaces.
* Proficiency in using digital maps/navigation tools (e.g., Google Maps ) for rapid location and route assessment.
* Ability to thrive and maintain focus in a fast\-paced, high\-stakes operational environment .
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to make swift, sound decisions under pressure.


**Desirable Skills (The "Ideal Pilot"):**
* Tech\-Savviness: Quick learner with new technologies and strong fundamental computer skills.
* Vigilance \& Focus: Proven ability to remain alert, responsive, and highly focused in front of a screen for several hours at a time during shifts.
* Visual\-Motor Coordination: Good reaction time and motor skills required for precise robot control and the ability to rapidly process large amounts of visual information (Vigilance/Scanning).
* Reliability: Impeccable attendance record and strong sense of responsibility for your assigned workload and schedule.
* Communication: Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.
* Scheduling Flexibility: Availability to work in nights and rotational shifts.
* Visual Acuity: Ability to distinguish different colors, which is essential for interacting with Operations and tools.


 If you're energetic, deeply detail\-oriented , have great focus, and are excited to help build the future of autonomous last\-mile delivery , you'll thrive in this pioneering role.
   

  

****How We Partner To Protect You:****

title: Electronics Engineer
description:
Company Overview:
 



 Smartivity STEM toys make learning fun as the creators of tomorrow create their toys from scratch. Our made\-in\-India toys help kids aged 6 to 14 grasp the fundamentals of science as they build, break, experiment, tinker, and learn through play. Our toys run on STEM, powering the engine of the mind. STEAM is Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics. We are looking for a talented Electronics Designer who can design electronic components and systems for toys.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 ● Design and develop electronic circuits and systems for DIY toys, educational products, gadgets, and consumer electronics.
 



 ● Independently design PCBs from schematic to manufacturing\-ready files.
 



 ● Develop complex multi\-layer PCBs, including component placement, routing, power distribution, signal integrity, grounding, and EMI/EMC considerations.
 



 ● Select appropriate electronic components based on functionality, availability, cost, size, reliability, and manufacturability.
 



 ● Create schematics, PCB layouts, BOMs, and other technical documentation.
 



 ● Understand and troubleshoot existing electronic circuits, PCBs, and electronic gadgets.
 



 ● Work on miniaturized and space\-constrained electronics, integrating PCBs with mechanical/toy structures.
 



 ● Design circuits involving MCUs, sensors, motors, LEDs, switches, displays, communication modules, batteries, charging circuits, and audio systems.
 



 ● Prototype, test, debug, and iterate electronic designs from concept to production.
 



 ● Perform circuit\-level troubleshooting using tools such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and power supplies.
 



 ● Work closely with product design and development team, QC team, procurement team and production team to integrate electronics into toys and products.
 



  





**Required Technical Skills** 




 ● Strong understanding of analog and digital electronics.
 



 ● Proficiency in PCB design software such as Altium Designer, KiCad, Eagle, OrCAD, or equivalent.
 



 ● Strong understanding of multi\-layer PCB design and complex PCB routing.
 



  





**Good knowledge of:** 




 ○ Microcontrollers and embedded electronics
 



 ○ Power supplies and battery\-operated circuits
 



 ○ Motor drivers and control circuits
 



 ○ Sensors and switches, LEDs and displays, Audio circuits, RF/wireless modules
 



 ● Understanding of PCB manufacturing, PCB assembly, soldering, and component packages.
 



  





**Product \& Gadget Understanding** 




 The candidate should have a strong interest in understanding how electronic gadgets and toys work.
 



 You should be comfortable with:
 



 ● Opening and analyzing existing electronic products.
 



 ● Understanding the function of different electronic components and circuits.
 



 ● Reverse\-engineering simple electronic systems.
 



 ● Identifying how electronics can be simplified, optimized, or redesigned.
 



 ● Converting a product concept into a practical electronic solution.
 



 ● Integrating electronics into children's toys and interactive products.
 



 ● Balancing electronics performance with cost, size, safety, usability, and manufacturability.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 We are looking for someone who is not just a PCB layout engineer, but a hands\-on electronics product designer who can understand the complete journey:
 



**Concept → Circuit Design → Schematic → Complex PCB Design → Prototype → Debugging → Product Integration → Production** 




  





**Qualifications** 




 ● Bachelor's degree/diploma in Electronics, Electronics \& Communication, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field.
 



 ● Minimum 2 years of relevant hands\-on experience in electronics design and PCB development.
 



 ● Strong practical knowledge of electronics and PCB design.
 



 ● Experience taking PCB designs from concept/prototype through manufacturing is highly preferred.
 



 ● Candidates with strong personal electronics projects, DIY products, or maker experience are encouraged to apply.
 



  





 Interested candidates can share their CVs at sakshi@smartivity.in

 Ember is a D2C cookware brand building India’s non\-toxic, ceramic\-coated cookware category \- PTFE, PFOA, lead, and cadmium\-free \- combining Italian coating craftsmanship with everyday Indian cooking needs. The brand has already earned the trust of
 **30,000\+ Indian kitchens**

 We’re looking for a sharp, hands\-on Management Trainee to work directly with the Founder’s Office. This isn’t a shadowing role \- you’ll be embedded in live business problems from week one, working across
 **new product development, go\-to\-market, marketplaces, and supply chain/operations** 
 .
 



 It’s built for someone who wants high\-intensity, high\-visibility generalist exposure at an early\-stage D2C brand, with a clear opportunity to move into a permanent role based on performance and mutual fit.

 Support ideation, market research, and category benchmarking; coordinate with design and vendor partners to move concepts from brief to sample to shelf\-ready.

 Support launch strategies for new products and categories — positioning, pricing inputs, channel sequencing, and launch calendars.

 Manage and optimize listings across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, etc.; track catalog health, pricing, promotions, ad spends, and performance.

 Work with vendors and logistics partners to track production, inventory, and fulfilment; identify and help resolve bottlenecks.

 Build and maintain trackers, dashboards, and reports that give founders visibility into performance across functions.
* **Founder Support:** 
 Take ownership of ad\-hoc, cross\-functional projects from zero to one, acting as an extension of the founder’s bandwidth.



  





**What we’re looking for** 



* Recent
 **MBA graduate** 
 with 0\-1 years of full\-time work experience post\-MBA or equivalent.

 **NPD, GTM, marketplaces, operations, supply chain, and planning** 
 .
* You don’t need to be an expert in all of them, but should be comfortable learning quickly and going deep.
* High ownership mentality and comfort with ambiguity, tight timelines, and shifting priorities.
* Strong analytical and
 **Excel/Google Sheets** 
 skills; comfortable building trackers and working with data.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact directly with founders, vendors, and marketplace partners.
* Bias for action \- someone who would rather try, learn, and iterate than wait for the perfect plan.



  





**Why join** 



* Direct access to the founders and real decision\-making \- not a rotational or observer program.
* Broad, cross\-functional exposure across the core levers of a growing D2C brand.
* Live business problems and ownership from day one.
* A clear, merit\-based opportunity to transition into a permanent role after 6 months.

 NowFloats is focused on improving local online discovery for small and medium businesses by structuring their information so it is easily found by nearby consumers. The company uses a patent\-pending “location\-based SEO” process to help businesses appear prominently in local search results. Its products include an organic discovery model with automated search engine optimization and a hybrid model that combines organic reach with paid channels such as Google Ads and Facebook ads. NowFloats also offers RIA, a Relationship Intelligence Agent that enables businesses to stay connected with customers through automated, low\-effort engagement.  **SEO, digital visibility and AI automation capabilities** 
 .
* Understand customer and business requirements and convert them into clear product features, workflows and use cases.

 .

 to reduce manual work and improve customer outcomes.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an
 **Product Manager with 3\-6 years experience** 
 who can help translate complex healthcare operations workflows into clear, testable product experiences for Provider Passport. This role is especially focused on prototyping: mapping user journeys, creating wireframes, turning ideas into clickable concepts, gathering stakeholder feedback, and helping the team validate solutions before they move into development. The ideal candidate is curious, structured, visually clear, and comfortable working closely with design, engineering, QA, implementation, and operations teams.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Create low\-fidelity and high\-fidelity prototypes that communicate proposed Provider Passport workflows clearly.
* Map user journeys, process flows, screen flows, edge cases, and role\-based experiences for onboarding, credentialing, document review, verification, and reporting workflows.
* Translate product ideas, operational pain points, and stakeholder feedback into wireframes, clickable prototypes, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with product managers, designers, engineers, QA testers, and operations teams to explore options before development begins.
* Use prototypes to support discovery sessions, workflow reviews, usability feedback, internal demos, and requirement validation.
* Document product decisions, workflow assumptions, dependencies, and open questions in a clear and organized way.
* Help maintain the product backlog by refining user stories, clarifying requirements, and connecting prototype behavior to expected system behavior.
* Review implemented features against prototypes, requirements, and acceptance criteria to ensure the intended experience is delivered.
* Analyze user feedback, support themes, workflow gaps, and adoption signals to recommend product improvements.
* Support release preparation by helping with demos, training notes, feature summaries, and stakeholder communication.



**Required Skills and Experience** 



* 3 to 6 years of experience in product management, product operations, UX, business analysis, implementation, or a related product role.
* Strong prototyping skills using tools such as Figma, FigJam, Miro, Balsamiq, Lucidchart, Whimsical, Axure, or similar tools.
* Ability to create clear wireframes, user flows, screen flows, workflow diagrams, and clickable prototypes.
* Strong understanding of how to convert user needs and business rules into product requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Comfortable working with complex forms, dashboards, role\-based permissions, document workflows, status tracking, and approval processes.
* Strong written communication skills with the ability to document workflows, assumptions, scenarios, and expected product behavior.
* Ability to collaborate with engineering and QA teams to clarify interaction details, edge cases, validation rules, and error states.
* Good analytical skills and comfort using feedback, usage patterns, and operational observations to shape product decisions.
* High attention to detail and ability to keep requirements, prototypes, and delivered functionality aligned.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience with healthcare, provider onboarding, credentialing, compliance, document management, payer operations, or workflow\-heavy SaaS products.
* Exposure to UX research methods, usability testing, design systems, accessibility basics, or service design.
* Experience working with Agile teams and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Linear, Trello, Confluence, or Notion.
* Basic understanding of APIs, data models, integrations, workflow automation, or reporting concepts.
* Portfolio or work samples showing prototypes, user flows, workflow diagrams, or product requirements.



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 The right candidate is a hands\-on product thinker who enjoys making abstract requirements visible. They should be comfortable sketching, prototyping, asking detailed workflow questions, and iterating quickly based on feedback. They do not need to be a visual designer, but they should be able to create prototypes that help teams make better product decisions sooner.

* Coordinate cross\-functional activities to ensure alignment between business and engineering teams.
* Support customer meetings, sprint demos, governance reviews, and project updates.
* Serve as the primary Delivery Manager and customer point of contact for smaller engagements, ensuring effective stakeholder communication, governance, and customer satisfaction.
* Maintain a customer\-first mindset throughout project execution.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Promote Agile best practices across delivery teams.
* Encourage knowledge sharing, collaboration, and process improvements.
* Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, predictability, and team productivity.
* Contribute to organizational Agile maturity initiatives.
* Support Delivery Managers in implementing operational excellence initiatives.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Project Coordinator, Associate Project Manager, Delivery Coordinator, or similar role, with demonstrated ability or readiness to independently manage smaller customer engagements.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, Scrum framework, Kanban, and modern software delivery practices.
* Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and managing sprint execution.
* Hands\-on experience working with cross\-functional software engineering teams.
* Good understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Experience using Agile project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of Agile metrics including Sprint Velocity, Burndown Charts, Cycle Time, Lead Time, Defect Leakage, Resource Utilization, Schedule Adherence, and Delivery Milestones.
* Experience coordinating multiple workstreams within Agile projects.
* Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving and conflict\-resolution abilities.
* Ability to work effectively in fast\-paced, collaborative environments.
* Exposure to cloud technologies (Google Cloud Platform, AWS, or Azure) is preferred.
* Exposure to AI, Data, Analytics, or Application Development projects is an added advantage.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), SAFe Scrum Master, or equivalent Agile certification.
* Experience working in consulting, professional services, or customer\-facing organizations.
* Exposure to cloud migration, AI/ML, data modernization, analytics, or digital transformation projects.
* Experience supporting distributed or global engineering teams.
* Familiarity with delivery governance, release management, and Agile reporting.
* Experience independently managing small to mid\-sized customer engagements or end\-to\-end project delivery is preferred.
* Passion for coaching Agile teams and driving continuous improvement.


***Please note, we cannot sponsor or transfer any visas, of any kind, at this time.***

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.*

* Motion: Frequent walking, climbing stairs/ladders, grasping/squeezing, wrist flexion/extension, and overhead reaching; frequent driving

 Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. title: Software Engineer - API Network
description:
**Who Are We?**
 Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million\+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500\. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API\-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.
   

  

 The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore \- where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.
   

  

 P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API\-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.
   

  

**About Us**
 API Network is a one stop solution for discovering, learning about, and using the APIs you need across public, internal and partner workspaces. Postman’s Public API Network is the world's largest network of public APIs. Private Network is a centralized, internal catalog that serves as an organization's single source of truth for corporate APIs, internal workspaces, collections, and environments.
   

  

****The Role****
 We’re looking for a Software Engineer (Full Stack) who thrives in building seamless, high\-performance user experiences and goes beyond silos to deliver value to the users. If you have a bias for action, love solving complex problems, and are curious to products that are used by millions of developers, this role is for you!
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Own and build intuitive, secure, performant, and scalable end\-to\-end experiences for Public API Network.
* Optimize search UX with strong focus on customer needs.
* Collaborate with backend engineers, designers, and product managers to improve Public API Network experience in Postman.
* Be curious and proactive—dive into work beyond silos to iterate fast, and deliver incremental improvements.
* Quickly build functional prototypes to solve internal and external use\-cases.
* Contribute to our engineering culture by sharing knowledge, reviewing code, and mentoring peers.


****What We’re Looking For****
* 2\-4 years of experience as a full\-stack engineer.
* Proficiency with JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, databases (SQL/NoSQL), and web services.
* Strong understanding of software development fundamentals \& infrastructure.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a bias for action—you get things done under constraints!
* Love building products that would create value for our users.
* A mindset for collaboration and experimentation with a willingness to explore beyond silos.


****Why Join Us?****
* Work on a high\-velocity team enabling and improving search for millions of developers.
* Be part of a company that values curiosity, ownership, trust and winning together under constraints.
* We offer competitive salary and benefits, and a flexible schedule and opportunities for growth.


**What Else?**
 In addition to Postman's pay\-on\-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team\-building events will keep you connected, while our donation\-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long\-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.
   

  

 At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in\-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.
   

  

**Our Values**
 At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.
