* Collaborate with global Data Science colleagues to share learnings, improve internal approaches, and support consistent delivery across regions.


**Your Strengths And Skills 🛠️**
* Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field plus a minimum of 3 years of experience in data science, analytics, decision science, applied machine learning, or a related field; or a master’s degree or equivalent experience in a related STEM field.
* Experience building, validating, or interpreting machine learning models in Python.
* Strong data manipulation skills, including merging, cleansing, sampling, profiling, and preparing data for analysis.
* Practical, hands\-on experience using AI tools (e.g. Copilot, Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, etc) to support coding, analysis, or delivery work.
* Ability to balance model performance, explainability, complexity, and business usability.
* Good understanding of common model evaluation concepts such as AUC, precision, recall, lift, stability, and model monitoring.
* Ability to translate analytical outputs into clear insights and recommendations.
* Confident, comfortable communicating directly with clients as well as internal stakeholders, as part of project delivery and discovery.
* Curious, proactive, and willing to learn new business domains, analytical methods, and platform capabilities.
* Organized and delivery\-focused, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-moving environment.
* Although not essential, it would be great if you also have any of these strengths,
* Experience in financial services, fintech, banking, lending, payments, insurance, telecommunications, or another data\-rich industry.
* Exposure to client\-facing work, workshops, product demonstrations, or cross\-functional business discussions.
* Experience with MLOps, model deployment, APIs, MLflow, CI/CD, or production model governance.
* Familiarity with credit risk, fraud, collections, or customer management use cases.
* Experience preparing presentations, technical documentation, or business summaries for data science initiatives.

**The Interview Process Would Typically Be Structured As Follows**
* Initial chat with our recruitment team to get a better understanding of your current situation, what you are looking for, and any questions you may have.
* Technical Challenge. This is a take\-home task where you will solve a typical Data Science problem in your own time. It will give you an insight into the exciting problems we solve.
* Technical Interview. This will be with your Data Science colleagues and primarily consist of technical questions.
* Business Interview. This will be with senior stakeholders from Global Applied Intelligence, and cover mostly business and behavioural competencies.

**Position Summary**

The role will focus primarily on dashboard development, Qlik data modeling, scripting, reload optimization, security implementation, and ongoing production support. You will work closely with business stakeholders, analysts, data engineers, and platform teams to translate reporting requirements into intuitive, reliable, and high\-performing Qlik solutions. Experience with Qlik Cloud is preferred, and exposure to Qlik Answers or Qlik Predict will be an added advantage as the team explores AI\-enabled and advanced analytics capabilities within the Qlik ecosystem.
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad
   

  

 Shift Timings: 11AM to 8PM
   

  

 Experience: 2 \- 4 years
   

  

 Qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* Equivalent hands on experience in business intelligence, data visualization, Qlik development, or analytics reporting will also be considered.
* Hands\-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards in QlikView / Qlik Sense.
* Strong understanding of Qlik scripting, Data Load Editor, data transformation logic, incremental loads, and reusable QVD layer design.
* Experience building efficient Qlik data models, including fact/dimension design, star schema concepts, synthetic key resolution, circular reference handling, and data model optimization.
* Strong dashboard design skills, including KPI reporting, sheet layout, visual storytelling, usability, and performance\-aware visualization design.
* Good SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries, CTEs, data validation, reconciliation, and query troubleshooting.
* Experience implementing or supporting Qlik security concepts such as Section Access, row\-level security, app\-level access controls, and governed dashboard access.
* Working knowledge of Qlik Sense Enterprise administration concepts, including apps, streams/spaces, reload tasks, data connections, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Ability to troubleshoot dashboard issues related to data refreshes, reload failures, script errors, performance bottlenecks, and user access concerns.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving ability, attention to detail, and ownership mindset.
* Good communication skills with the ability to work directly with business stakeholders, product owners, analysts, and technical teams.
* Ability to manage multiple dashboard development, enhancement, and support priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience with Qlik Cloud, including spaces, data connections, reload management, app publishing, access management, and cloud\-based dashboard deployment.
* Exposure to QlikView and experience supporting migration, modernization, or redevelopment of QlikView applications into Qlik Sense.
* Knowledge of Qlik APIs, extensions, mashups, automation, or integration patterns.
* Exposure to Qlik Answers, including AI\-assisted search, knowledge discovery, or conversational analytics use cases.
* Exposure to Qlik Predict or predictive analytics concepts within the Qlik ecosystem.
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms or services such as AWS S3, Redshift, Databricks, RDS, or other enterprise data warehouse/lakehouse environments.
* Understanding of data governance, data quality, metadata management, and trusted data practices for enterprise reporting.
* Understanding of Agile delivery practices, release management, version control, and CI/CD concepts for analytics solutions.


 Key job responsibilities:
   

  

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain interactive dashboards and analytical applications using QlikView / Qlik Sense.

* Create efficient Qlik data models using best practices such as star schema design, appropriate granularity, reusable QVD layers, and elimination of synthetic keys and circular references.
* Enhance existing Qlik dashboards by improving usability, performance, visualization design, reload efficiency, and overall user experience.
* Implement and validate Section Access, row\-level security, and application\-level access controls in partnership with platform and security teams.
* Support Qlik environment operations, including monitoring reloads, troubleshooting failed tasks, managing data connections, validating data refreshes, and resolving production support issues.
* Write and optimize SQL queries for source analysis, joins, aggregations, data validation, reconciliation, and dashboard performance tuning.
* Collaborate with business users, product owners, data engineers, QA teams, and infrastructure teams to deliver reliable reporting solutions within agreed timelines.
* Contribute to Qlik modernization initiatives, including QlikView to Qlik Sense migration, Qlik Sense Enterprise enhancements, or adoption of Qlik Cloud capabilities where applicable.

title: Senior Associate - Data Analytics
description:
**Job summary:** 




 The Senior Associate – Data Analytics, Business Intelligence \& Microsoft Fabric will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting scalable analytics and business intelligence solutions using Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric.
 



 The role combines business intelligence development, big data processing, data modeling, visualization, advanced analytics, and insight generation.
 



 The candidate will be expected to manage analytics deliverables across the full lifecycle, including requirements analysis, data acquisition, transformation, modeling, visualization, validation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous enhancement. The role will also contribute to data governance, documentation, platform optimization, self\-service analytics, and the development of reusable enterprise data products.
 



  





**Location:** 
 Hyderabad/Kolkata, India.
 



  





**Key responsibilities:** 



1. **Business Intelligence and PowerBI development**


* Design, develop, deploy, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical applications
* Translate business requirements and analytical questions into scalable and intuitive business intelligence solutions
* Develop enterprise\-grade semantic models that support consistent KPI definitions, reusable calculations, and self\-service reporting
* Create advanced DAX measures, calculated tables, calculated columns, time\-intelligence calculations, and dynamic business metrics
* Use Power Query and M to ingest, cleanse, transform, and prepare data from multiple sources
* Apply dimensional modeling principles, including star and snowflake schemas, to develop efficient and scalable reporting models
* Design executive, operational, and analytical dashboards that clearly communicate performance, trends, risks, and opportunities
* Implement drill\-through, bookmarks, tooltips, row\-level security, object\-level security, and other relevant Power BI capabilities
* Optimize data models, DAX calculations, visuals, report interactions, and refresh processes to improve performance and usability



**2 Microsoft Fabric development** 



* Design, develop, and maintain analytics solutions using the Microsoft Fabric ecosystem
* Build and support solutions using:
* Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse
* Fabric Data Warehouse
* Data Factory Pipelines
* Dataflows Gen2
* Fabric Notebooks
* OneLake
* Semantic Models
* Power BI
* Develop scalable ETL and ELT processes to acquire, transform, integrate, and publish data for analytics consumption
* Create pipelines and notebooks for batch\-based data ingestion and transformation
* Use SQL, Python, and PySpark to process structured and semi\-structured datasets
* Develop curated data layers that support reporting, analytics, and downstream business use cases
* Contribute to the implementation of medallion or similar layered data architecture patterns, where applicable
* Support development, testing, deployment, and production monitoring across analytics environments
* Implement parameterization, configuration management, logging, reconciliation, exception handling, and restart capabilities in data workflows



**3 Insight generation and Advanced Analytics** 



* Analyze business, marketing, customer, digital, campaign, operational, and performance data to identify trends, patterns, risks, anomalies, and growth opportunities
* Move beyond reporting what happened by investigating
 **why it happened, what it means, and what action should be considered**
* Generate actionable insights that support strategic, tactical, and operational decision\-making
* Conduct exploratory data analysis, root\-cause analysis, variance analysis, trend analysis, segmentation, cohort analysis, and performance\-driver analysis
* Interpret relationships across multiple datasets and connect analytical findings to business outcomes
* Develop hypotheses, define analytical approaches, validate findings, and present evidence\-based conclusions
* Identify underperformance, outliers, emerging trends, measurement gaps, and optimization opportunities
* Develop analytical views that differentiate signals from routine fluctuations
* Support forecasting, propensity analysis, classification, clustering, predictive analytics, and other advanced analytical use cases, where appropriate



**4 Data storytelling and Executive communication** 



* Convert complex analysis into clear, concise, and compelling business narratives
* Create executive\-ready presentations, insight summaries, performance commentary, and business review materials
* Communicate not only data points but also the business context, contributing factors, implications, and recommended actions
* Tailor analytical communication to different audiences, including business users, technical teams, functional leaders, and senior leadership
* Present analytical findings with a logical storyline supported by appropriate visualizations
* Clearly articulate data limitations, assumptions, dependencies, risks, and confidence levels
* Develop commentary that explains the most material changes in KPIs and performance drivers
* Facilitate business reviews and analytical discussions, helping stakeholders interpret and act on the findings



**5 Business partnership and requirements management** 



* Partner with business stakeholders to understand strategic priorities, operational processes, reporting requirements, and analytical questions
* Lead or support requirements\-gathering discussions, discovery workshops, design reviews, demonstrations, and user\-acceptance sessions
* Translate business needs into documented functional requirements, analytical requirements, data requirements, KPIs, and acceptance criteria
* Challenge ambiguous requests and help stakeholders define the decisions or actions that the analytics solution should support
* Conduct stakeholder demonstrations and incorporate structured feedback
* Support user acceptance testing by developing test scenarios, expected outcomes, and issue\-resolution tracking



**6 Data Quality, Governance, Security, and Controls** 



* Embed data quality controls within ingestion, transformation, modeling, and reporting workflows
* Validate that reporting outputs reconcile with approved source systems and documented business rules
* Define and monitor relevant data\-quality measures and thresholds
* Investigate data\-quality exceptions and coordinate remediation with source\-system owners and data teams
* Maintain business definitions, KPI logic, data dictionaries, source\-to\-target mappings, calculation specifications, and technical documentation
* Support data lineage and metadata\-management practices across analytics assets
* Apply appropriate role\-based access, row\-level security, workspace permissions, and data\-classification requirements
* Ensure that analytics products comply with applicable organizational security, privacy, retention, and governance standards
* Promote consistent business definitions and a single source of truth across dashboards and reports
* Prevent the uncontrolled duplication of measures, datasets, transformation logic, and reporting products
* Maintain auditability of transformations, calculations, changes, releases, and validation results
* Participate in peer reviews, design reviews, release controls, and production\-readiness assessments
* Identify governance gaps and recommend improvements to increase trust, transparency, and maintainability



**7 Testing, Deployment, and Production Support** 



* Develop and execute unit testing, integration testing, data validation, regression testing, and performance testing
* Validate data across source, transformed, curated, semantic, and visualization layers
* Prepare test evidence and resolve defects before production release
* Support controlled deployments across development, testing, and production environments
* Use version control and deployment practices to maintain consistency and traceability
* Monitor scheduled refreshes, pipeline execution, semantic model processing, and dashboard availability
* Troubleshoot production issues and perform root\-cause analysis



**8 Continuous improvement and Team contribution** 



* Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting, repetitive transformations, reconciliations, and quality checks
* Recommend improvements to analytics architecture, development standards, delivery processes, and governance controls
* Create reusable templates, code components, calculation libraries, documentation standards, and development accelerators
* Conduct peer reviews for Power BI reports, semantic models, SQL scripts, notebooks, and pipelines
* Mentor associates and junior team members in analytics, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, data modeling, and insight\-generation practices
* Contribute to team onboarding, knowledge\-sharing sessions, technical documentation, and capability development
* Stay informed about relevant developments across Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, cloud analytics, artificial intelligence, and business intelligence



**Education:** 



1. Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or another relevant quantitative discipline
2. An equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience may also be considered



**Professional experience:** 



1. 4–7 years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, data engineering, reporting, or a related discipline
2. At least 3 years of hands\-on experience developing Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, and analytical solutions
3. Hands\-on experience working with Microsoft Fabric or a comparable modern cloud analytics platform
4. Experience working with large, complex, and multi\-source datasets
5. Experience working in an Agile, iterative, or structured analytics delivery environment
6. Experience in marketing analytics, digital analytics, customer analytics, campaign analytics, commercial analytics, or revenue analytics
7. Experience with Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, or related Azure services
8. Familiarity with CI/CD, deployment pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps practices for analytics. Knowledge of Tableau, Qlik, Alteryx, or other business intelligence and data\-preparation

title: Quality Assurance Intern
description:
We are looking for a
 **QA Intern** 
 who is curious, analytical, and passionate about understanding how products work. The ideal candidate should have strong
 **logical and critical\-thinking abilities** 
 , basic programming knowledge, and a
 **product\-oriented mindset** 
 .
 



 This role is suitable for someone who enjoys finding problems, understanding the root cause, thinking about edge cases, and continuously improving the quality of a product.
 



 What You’ll Do
 


* Understand product requirements, workflows, and business use cases.
* Design and execute test scenarios covering
 **positive, negative, boundary, and edge cases** 
 .
* Identify, reproduce, document, and track defects with clear technical details.
* Use
 **logical and analytical thinking** 
 to investigate unexpected product behavior.
* Understand APIs, request/response structures, validations, and integrations.
* Write basic scripts/programs to support
 **test automation and data validation** 
 .
* Learn and work with automation frameworks and testing tools.
* Analyze logs, API responses, and system behavior to identify potential issues.
* Collaborate with Developers, Product Managers, and other QA engineers to understand and resolve issues.
* Think beyond the written test cases and identify scenarios that may impact real users.
* Participate in regression, sanity, integration, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Continuously improve test coverage and contribute ideas to improve the overall QA process.



 What We’re Looking For
 


* Strong
 **programming fundamentals** 
 in any one language such as Java, JavaScript, Python, or similar.
* Good
 **logical reasoning and problem\-solving skills** 
 .
* Strong
 **critical\-thinking and analytical ability** 
 .
* Ability to break a complex problem into smaller, understandable parts.
* Curiosity to understand
 **why something works or fails** 
 , rather than simply reporting the issue.
* Good understanding of basic data structures, conditions, loops, functions, and debugging concepts.
* Basic knowledge of
 **API concepts, HTTP methods, JSON, and REST APIs** 
 is a plus.
* Good communication skills and ability to explain problems clearly.
* Willingness to learn automation and modern QA tools.



 Product Mindset
 



 We are looking for someone who:
 


* Thinks from the
 **customer/user perspective** 
 .
* Is interested in understanding the product, not just executing predefined test cases.
* Can identify missing requirements, unclear behavior, and potential business risks.
* Asks the right questions before starting testing.
* Has the attitude of
 **“How can this fail?”** 
 and proactively looks for weaknesses.
* Takes ownership of quality and follows issues through to resolution.
* Is comfortable challenging assumptions with facts and evidence.



 Preferred Skills
 


* Java / JavaScript / Python
* REST API testing
* Postman or similar API tools
* SQL basics
* Git
* Basic understanding of automation testing
* Basic understanding of CI/CD is a plus



 Who Will Fit Well
 



 A
 **smart, curious, technically inclined problem solver** 
 who enjoys programming and understanding products will be a strong fit for this role.
 



 We value
 **thinking ability and learning attitude over prior QA experience** 
 .

 Job Description:
   

  

 Every day, we seek to improve financial security for people. Joining our Information Technology Applications team means you will be a part of a passionate and supportive team that believes what we do matters to our clients and investors.
   

  

 Data Test Engineer works closely with data engineers, application developers, product owners, data stewards, analysts, and other stakeholders in an agile environment. In addition to defining, documenting, automating, and executing tests for enterprise data platforms and data\-centric applications, they will be involved in sprint planning, daily scrum meetings, development validation, release readiness, and product deployment. They will contribute to both manual and automated test case creation and execution across data pipelines, services, APIs, database objects, reporting layers, data integrity controls, and applications that consume or manage enterprise data.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Data Quality \& Test Engineer II / SDET II to join our Quality Engineering team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust data testing and automation solutions, ensuring data quality across enterprise data platforms and related applications, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to deliver secure, reliable, and trusted data products.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Participate in all phases of the Agile development process, providing input into analysis, design, development, estimation, planning, support, and retrospectives.
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for enterprise data platforms, data pipelines, APIs, backend services, and data\-centric applications.
* Collaborate with data engineers, developers, product managers, business analysts, data stewards, and platform teams to understand requirements and define test strategies.
* Implement automated test cases to validate source\-to\-target mappings, ETL/ELT workflows, data transformations, data quality rules, reconciliations, and business logic.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, system, and data validation testing using automation tools and repeatable test data approaches.
* Ensure test coverage across multiple layers, including ingestion, transformation, storage, APIs, data services, reporting/analytics, UI applications, metadata, and database objects.
* Analyze test results, identify data defects, investigate root causes, and work closely with engineering teams to resolve data quality and application issues.
* Drive continuous improvement in data testing processes, automation frameworks, tools, quality gates, and delivery methodologies.
* Contribute to best practices in test automation, data quality engineering, test data management, and enterprise quality engineering.
* Prepare and deliver status reports on testing progress, data validation coverage, automation execution, defect metrics, and quality trends to stakeholders.
* Communicate risks, blockers, data quality concerns, release readiness, and quality trends proactively to project managers and leadership.
* Maintain dashboards and test execution reports in tools like JIRA, Zephyr/TestRail, CI/CD pipelines, or data quality platforms for real\-time visibility.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 4\-7 years of experience in software testing, data testing, data validations, orchestration tools, and automation, with at least 2\+ years focused on enterprise data platforms, data warehouses/lakehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, or data\-centric applications.
* Strong programming and scripting skills in Python and SQL; experience with C\# or another object\-oriented language is a plus.
* Hands\-on experience building automated tests using frameworks such as PyTest, Behave, Robot Framework, Playwright, Selenium, or similar tools.
* Experience with API and service testing using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, Karate, or equivalent automation libraries.
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines and version control tools such as Jenkins, TeamCity, GitHub, Azure DevOps, GitLab, or similar.
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as JIRA, Zephyr, TestRail, or equivalent platforms.
* Advance SQL skills and hands\-on experience validating data in relational databases, data warehouses, cloud data platforms (Preferred Snowflake), or data lake environments.
* Experience validating ETL/ELT pipelines, source\-to\-target mappings, schema changes, data lineage, data reconciliation, data completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and referential integrity.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail and the ability to investigate complex data issues.
* Good to have experience with ETL tools, data quality, observability, or transformation tools such as dbt tests, fivetran, soda, ADF, airflow, astronomer, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar.
* Good to have experience/exposure to performance testing for data pipelines, database queries, APIs, batch jobs, or large\-volume data processing.


**Candidate Requirements**
* Demonstrated experience interfacing with clients and stakeholders to develop functional, technical, and data validation test cases and communicate status updates.
* Strong domain experience in enterprise data platforms, data engineering, data warehousing, financial services data, sales data, marketing data, or analytics applications.
* Proven ability to learn and deliver solutions in multiple programming languages and technical environments required for data test automation, including Python and SQL.
* Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Data Development Life Cycle, Agile methodologies, and release management practices required.
* Prior experience as QA/SDET/Data Test Engineer on medium to large application or data platform projects, with emphasis on SQL, data pipelines, API/services testing, data validation, and modern web application technologies.
* Strong troubleshooting \& analysis skills and capability to work on multiple projects simultaneously across data platforms and application teams.
* Ability to deliver enterprise\-level automation solutions that enable in\-sprint automation, repeatable data validation, and continuous quality checks.
* Ability to work independently to drive QA and data testing practices while providing clear status reporting to stakeholders.
* Proactively investigates test failures and data discrepancies, logs issues clearly with evidence, and follows up with engineering teams asynchronously.
* Ability to work with stakeholders to prioritize the book of work based on business risk, data criticality, quality trends, and release timelines.


**Soft Skills**
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with clear, concise, and actionable status reporting.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, agile environment with multiple data and application delivery workstreams.
* Strong ownership and accountability mindset with a focus on data accuracy, reliability, and stakeholder trust.


**Core Values**
* Strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication and collaboration skills with all levels of management.
* Strong organizational skills including the ability to adapt to shifting priorities and meet frequent deadlines.
* Demonstrated proactive approach to problem\-solving with strong judgment and decision\-making capability.
* Highly resourceful and collaborative team\-player, with the ability to also be independently effective and exude initiative and a sense of urgency.
* Exemplifies our customer\-focused, action\-oriented, results\-driven culture.
* Forward looking thinker, who actively seeks opportunities, has a desire for continuous learning, and proposes solutions.
* Ability to act with discretion and maintain complete confidentiality.
* Dedicated to the firm's values of non\-negotiable integrity, valuing our people, exceeding client expectations, and embracing intellectual curiosity and rigor.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, or related field.
